reviews.comment: Took for Summer 2. Really funny and passionate guy, wish I was a business major just so I could take more classes with him. AI projects were kinda weird but I like how he had us apply our thinking elsewhere. absolutely love this dude!
I'd absolutely take another class from this professor and I wish I had him in-person. The lectures were entertaining and thorough; it's also very feasible to get a good grade.

Had Roy in-person for Microecon Theory. He was a great professor - very enthusiastic about the material he was teaching, plus he was hilarious. Easy to reach outside of class and fair grader. Overall one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern.

Took this class online for summer 2. Great experience and he had very interesting lectures even for an asynchronous course! I'm sure in person he would be even better. Nice guy cares a lot about his students, would take again!

Roy was the best. Took this as an asynchronous summer course. There are a lot of assignments to stay on top of, but he explains everything in lectures so well, better than most econ professors I have had at NEU. Take him if you can!!

I took online. Canvas was very organized. Work is posted weekly and is manageable. He's understanding and flexible. His projects use ChatGPT which was very interesting. His projects consist interdisciplinary thinking and connects econ with social justice, AI/tech, ethics, etc. I like how he thinks out of the box and branches out beyond economics.

To be honest, he's a dedicated and very helpful professor. I think he does his best with the courses he teaches; while the grading criteria can be a bit complicated, overall he doesn't make things difficult for students. If you're considering taking 2301, he should definitely be at the top of your list.

Worst Professor I've ever taken. Case studies are graded harshly, with unclear directions. Test questions have little to do with relevant content and are impossible to study for even if read the textbook. Thick Accent & Participation Matter. EC only helps participation. Lectures are super dry.
Prof Shan is really a good prof! Lecture is very easy to understand.

You can tell he really wants to be a good professor, always asking for feedback, listening to criticism and will adjust accordingly. He's really passionate about the subject, but since he's new to teaching lectures can be not the clearest sometimes. Get to know him, and you can tell how much he cares for his students. (Knowing Mandarin helps.)

Cons: harsh grader, (especially on case studies), difficult online exams (sometimes unclear, confusing, and with little time), accent heavy so it might hard to understand, mostly reading/explaining off from powerpoint with little class engagement.

Pros: caring profesor, open to feedback, willing to help students outside of class, knowledgable.

Professor has to be my favorite I have ever taken in Northeastern. He cares about all of his students and makes a effort to get to know all of us. His accent may be a little hard to understand but he is extremely accommodating and willing to help anyone. All the exams and quizzes are take home and there are two group projects.

Issues with fairness and professionalism, inconsistent treatment of students, played favorites which affected grading. Also short temper, can be rude, dismissive, acted without restraint.

Professor Giglio is highly respected and professional. His course is thoughtfully organized and intellectually engaging, providing students with both a deep and practical understanding of the subject matter (His course is well worth taking).

Professor Giglio is an excellent professor because of the way he sets up his course. We talked about the cases and shared our insights. he literally thrive off his power, and treats his students like they are less than. first class in and he already made everyone feel bad and talked to us like we did not matter. sadly I can't drop this class - I wish I could

Great Professor! Really cares about his students. Makes you work for the grade but worth the time and effort. Highly recommend if you really want to learn how to create an effective strategy!

Top Strategy professor at Northeastern - only take if you are fine with working hard. Rudest most disrespectful teacher. Teaches horribly and is extremely degrading. His learning atmosphere is not pleasant at all. I would never recommend you to take him.

I didnt find the professor  to be very effective but it may work for you.
Complete idiot.  We were walking back to his office and he said, "I am talking the elevator, (pointed) you take the stairs."  Thinks he is God.

What an ****. A public sector hack who thinks he can teach. He lied on his disposition about grades, tries to be intimidating, doesn't like us to ask questions and acts like teaching us was a huge hassle. Even funnier, we learned nothing about strategy that will help us in the real world, which makes this experience even funnier. I mean, even if
No Comments

This professor was the worst I've had at NU.  He is extremely intimidating, berates you when you don't have the correct answer, and is not helpful when questions are asked of him.  VERY CRITICAL - AVOID!

I am sure that it was Prof Giglio himself who left the smiley face rating.  As a teacher he is intimidating, elusive, and demanding.  Which is not bad if one learns, unfortunately that was not the case.  As an individual, he is misanthropic and bitter.  He has this demeanor about him that makes you want to vomit.

Easily the worst class I have taken so far in graduate school. A bit of an egomaniac- which would be acceptable if he were a better teacher.  Save yourself the headache and find a different professor.
Great teaacher. Has won teacher of the year for the past three years.  That spreaks for itself.  Is in his office for help lots of the time.  One of the best teachers on campus.

The previous feedback is right on the mark.  The semester started on a very positive note, and consistently went down hill from there.  In addition, Mr Giglio missed 5 classes, 1/3 of the semester, for various reasons.

As a businessman, Mr. Giglio is extremely qualified, knowledgeable, and experienced. His teaching style, however, is intimidating and discouraging. Students are not encouraged to ask questions or seek meaningful feedback on their work.

Prof. Kimball made stats really easy to understand. This class is based on 4 exams (online) and 4 homework assignments, which were all pretty light. I've never taken stats before, but Prof. Kimball made it seem really easy. He goes over the lectures in depth which made the subjects so much easier to understand.

Prof Kimball made stats very easy to understand! He was very nice and clearly wanted his students to succeed. Class was pretty easy, exams were online/take-home, and grading is based on 4 exams and 4 homework. As long as you pay attention I didn't really have to commit too much time to do well outside of class. Definitely recommend taking him!
I enjoyed Prof Kimball's class. I'm usually not too good with math, but I'd definitely say he made it accessible. His feedback was a little bit vague on homework, though.

One of the most straightforward and simple professors I have had at Northeastern. Very nice guy. His lectures usually end early and the grade is based on take home quizzes and homework assignments. I am not good at math at all but he made stats easy and fun. If you have the chance to take him for stats please do!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was great. Lectures were on interesting topics and he did a good job of including other materials like videos and documentaries to expand on his slides. Had a couple exams and then group and individual projects due at the end of the semester. Nice guy and I enjoyed attending class even though it wasn't mandatory. Textbook was his published book

I took PSYC2315 with him, the online psych stats supplement. Syllabus is very clear about the grading criteria, and the class is very self-paced after he posts each module. His recorded lectures are very helpful and the assignments are easy after watching them. I'm glad I took it with him because his teaching style is very in-depth even on video.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He cares a lot about his students. We only had 4 homework assignments and 4 quizzes, and that's all he graded. Attendance was not mandatory, but his lectures were really helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing, super nice and caring!!! Class was easy and super interesting! Take him!

Run of the mill professor. Grade comes from homework and online quizzes. Homework was a direct indicator of the quizzes. The class was average, but an okay option for when you're choosing your stats course. Stats was easier than foundations, and I'm afraid it won't prepare me for upcoming lab courses.

I truly would have failed any other stats class not taught by him, he made learning stats easy and I am not a numbers or math person whatsoever. As long as you do the homeworks, the quizzes are basically the same. Quizzes are take home and you can do it during any time in the day , as long as it's before 11:59pm. Take this class 100%!

Prof. Kimball is a great prof and makes stats easy even if you don't like math. There's 4 hws, 4 quizzes and a reflection paper. Quizzes are open note and no time limit, just do it within 24 hours. Super clear on what questions will be on the quiz and very similar to hw problems. He cares about his student and very accessible outside of class.

He was an amazing prof. Super kind, class is based off of a few assignments that are really now difficult. He is a very fair grader, always available outside of class, and made this class fun for everyone!

Prof Kimball was a great professor! He was extremely reachable outside of class and made stats easy to understand for students that have zero background in stats, like me. He started from the bare bones of stats and made it very easy to follow. Be prepared to pay attention because you'll get lost if you don't.

Great professor. Makes stats very easy through lots of examples and practice problems. Grade comes from homework, a short reflection paper, and online, all-day quizzes. Very accessible outside of class as well. Highly recommend him and the class to balance out harder classes.

Was dreading taking stats, but he assuages your fears almost instantly. Super nice guy, funny, and his lectures are so engaging that he somehow makes stats interesting. If you have to take stats, seriously take him.
Dr. Kimball was great. The workload was super light but the weeks you have an assignment/exam they each take almost a full day to complete. He tried his best to make stats easy.
He's so chill and the class is so interesting. Do your GPA a favor and take him.

Prof Kimball made statistics easy and enjoyable because he assumes no prior knowledge of the concepts. All of his lectures are thorough and clear and you can access them for HW and tests. If you do the work, the grade comes easily. He cares about his students learning and is easy to talk to
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is one of the easiest classes provided at NEU. The professor is pretty chill, just submitting the assignments will get you an A. Take this class to balance with your tough classes during a semester.
This was such an easy A. It was an interesting topic, but overall the professor and the class were below average I would say, especially in the online zoom format.

Dr. Kimball is a great lecturer and this class was very interesting (even to a person who has no interest in sports). The quizzes were straightforward and the essays we had to write took minimal time and effort. Take this class if you are looking for something interesting and laid back!

I thought that the class wasn't too bad as long as you watched all the lectures and understood the content. Even if you didn't understand, the textbook and office hours are helpful as supplemental tools. Some of the questions on the quizzes were a bit confusing at times; but overall, the class was pretty straightforward and I knew what to expect.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bless this dude! Truly so supportive during COVID even when no one had their camera on. Just take good notes & try to truly understand the concepts. You can't bs your way through. He constantly opens the floor to questions & is there for you. Grade  2 quizzes, 4 data analysis assignments, & 3 discussion papers. Pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I don't recommend taking his class online. I'd heard great things about his in-person teaching, but due to covid, we've been online. I understand online teaching is tough, but he made this class awful. He is not accommodating to students with disabilities & can't explain clearly via Zoom. If you have the option to wait to take him in person, do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor. His lectures are clear and they tell you exactly what you need to know for the homework and exams. Straightforward class and he's always there to help if it's needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Kimball is a fascinating guy and his course was an easy A. Quizzes are straight off the ppts and papers are graded easily. However, it is still a very interesting and valuable class. Although you can easily get an A without going to class, would highly recommend going because he has a lot of knowledge and is a great connection to have

This class is well designed, and while it was super easy I still learned a lot. The homework is a great indicator for the quizzes so if you take your time to do well on the homework you barely need to study. I'd highly recommend taking his class.

He is truly one of the nicest Professors. Im not into sports at all but I took Sports Psychology because I needed an elective. Can I say youll love his class whether you like sports or not. Even though its a lecture heavy class he makes it super interesting and always answers questions with such enthusiasm and respect. Gotta love this guy!
Amazing professor, great lecturer and makes you want to do well in class

Super great guy. He does a very good job of explaining the material, his expectations are clear, and he's very fair. If you need to take psych stats, definitely try to take it with him. The class is super easy if you pay attention/study his slides.

Love him! My favorite prof in NEU. He clarifies everything very well and makes the material not as dry as it supposed to be. He can always answer my question in an understandable way. I would recommend everyone to take his class
Really chill guy in general. He's a Deadhead so manages to bring the Dead up every other sentence even if it had nothing to do with sports. Easily one of my favorite professors at NU
His lectures are very clear and he manages to keep things interesting even though it's a pretty dry subject. Would recommend! (PS save some money and don't buy the textbook)

Great professor, easy class. Honestly too easy. At times, felt like a joke of a class. Still loved it though. Talking about sports and performance? Doesn't get better in my book. Attendance isn't mandatory and all of the slides are on blackboard. Basically just a really fun elective. Recommend it.

The class could be monotonous, but that was just the material. Stats was very easy, with just four quizzes and four homeworks, no midterm/final. Professor Kimball was very easy to understand and would answer any questions you had. The PowerPoints were very comprehensive and you didn't really need to attend to do well.
Easiest class I've ever taken in my life. Very nice guy and makes everything simple and easy to understand. Would recommend to anyone.

Professor Kimball was calm, direct and sometimes funny. He made sure to go slow enough that you grasped the info, but didn't drone on forever. I loved his Sports Psychology course. It was very intuitive. There was no final exam, only three quizzes and two papers. The grading of the papers seems to be pretty laid-back. I can't wait to take Stats.

I had Dr. Kimball for 9 months straight in my masters program.  This man has mentored me, taught me, encouraged me, understood problems I was going through, was interested in the details of them and helpful.  I have never had a better professor!
Super easy if you go to class and study his slides. Even gives extra credit at the end if you need it.

He is a very approachable teacher, makes learning statistics fun and interesting. His powerpoints are great, but try not to skip class because sometimes he'll throw in useful info that you can't find on the slides. No final in his class, just 4 homework assignments and 4 quizzes. Easy to get an A!

Kimball is great- calm demeanor, nice guy. Made statistics as easy as could be with lots of powerpoints to take good notes. Reading the textbook and powerpoints really contributed to my getting a good grade, but if I was ever confused he was really willing and understanding to help.
Great professor, super easy class.

Joke of a capstone class. Professor uses ChatGPT to generate EVERYTHING. Besides the class sides that he took from another professor, all of the assignment instructions and feedback on assignments are painfully obviously generated by AI (even quiz questions most likely are). This is an insult to the students who are paying to take this class.
He's a great guy, and if you care about the course and create an interesting product then you will be successful.

He is a great guy ignore any bad reviews. There is quite a bit of homework but its really easy and the class was a easy A as long as you did all of the work. He has pop quizzes once in a while but they are super easy. He also really gets the class to interact with each other and there was a great sense of community between us by the end of semester

Good teacher overall, kind and cares about his students. The class is a semester long project with a group that you are assigned in the first week. Pop quizzes every once in a while, HW is not that hard.

Good teacher cares about his students. Whole class is just a year long project with a group assigned at the beginning of the semester. Reading quizzes every once in a while otherwise your whole grade is made up of the group project.

reviews.comment: Don't take BUSN1101. It's not required. Unless you're someone who is interested in creating your own product/startup don't take this class. reviews.comment: Very good Professor, better than most of the other BUSN1101 Professors. Class was easy to get a B+ in and all of the stuff we did in class was interesting and engaging. As a person who doesnt enjoy school, I enjoyed his class.
You will learn nothing in this class with this professor. Either take the class with someone else, or better yet just don't take the class at all since it isn't required for business majors.

reviews.comment: Just an overall horrible professor. No clear guildine and many projects we had to work on with the same group for the whole semester. reviews.comment: Majority of class lecture is spent watching other people's presentations/ debates, so be prepared to have a lot of free time during class. 3 tests worth 15% each consisting of 30-45 MC, but the lowest one usually gets dropped. Very invested and caring professor, class was not mandatory towards the business curriculum but I still thought it was interesting to take. Semester starts with a few pop quizzes and longer busy work assignments but then gets very manageable though the semester. Not the most important class there is but still somewhat engaging.

He's not the worse professor and definitely better than some of the other INTB 1203 professors. He doesn't give out that much work. And the work he does give out is pretty easy. All 3 exams were online and were all multiple choice. He seemed pretty disorganized but was an easy class overall.

Do not take! BAD BAD BAD :O! Not a required class and there are no clear grading criteria. One semester-long group project that pretty much determines how you do. He is also extremely harsh in grading.
amazing teacher and class
The professor is knowledgeable but every assignment outside of midterms is a group project. Lots of lecture time will be spent listening to debates from other groups. Grading is somewhat unclear.

I enjoyed the content of this class, but the professor did not do a good job of teaching it. Very kind person. lectures generally were fine, though he was rambly, but rather than focusing on lectures we had pointless debates. The final project was supposed to be worth a large portion of our grade, but he never graded it.
Don't take this class. Not required. Very hard to get a good grade. This class will not help you whatsoever. Stay away. Professor does not give any care towards this class. No clear grading as well.

A useless class where you learn nothing. You do nothing in class, but then have loads of work outside of class. One group-long semester project where barely any good feedback is given. Prof gave me a random grade at the end of the semester without even having graded the big semester project. This class is a joke.

Beware, BUSN 1101 is not a requirement for business majors, so think again before taking this class. The prof barely provides any good feedback on assignments. In class, useless assignments were completed and homework was graded harshly. Prof may seem chill, but he's not. In the end, he didn't grade half of my assignments. Don't take this class

HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE. Did not grade all assignments and decided on a random grade for the transcript. No feedback on projects and assignments. Supposed to be a "easy" class but will hurt your GPA. AVOID!!!!

This class is not a requirement for business majors. Basically a semester long project where you have to present the same thing three times. Received little to no feedback from the professor and he also seems like he doesn't know what he's doing most of the time.

Professor Elias needs to have better time management because half of my assignments are still not graded when the semester is over. He doesn't give anything above a 75 on homework assignments and doesn't give any feedbacks. Overall a very useless class.
Great professor

reviews.comment: I love Professor Elias as a person but I don't think I learned anything in this class. We did have a lot of interesting discussions but they were often unrelated to the material. This class was almost too easy as we didn't really have assignments besides 2 simple group projects. Overall, he is a very kind person and understanding.

I don't think I learned anything in this course. The professor never expanded on any of the news article readings, all of which did not explain how these factors could impact business. The class was very group project heavy. I would avoid this professor if I could. He seems nice, but he simply did not teach.
Lots of reading and a couple of group projects, decently manageable tho! Definitely do not misinterpret quietness for lack of kindness, truly a very nice professor!

reviews.comment: Great intro class. Class are discussions which he makes interesting. Gives good feedback on the semerster-long group project.
Very nice guy but I haven't learned anything from this course and he will not help you with anything. Recommend not having this professor.

reviews.comment: Great guy, great professor
Lots of discussion in class, lots of group projects, and only two tests that are largely based on discussion and the vocab in the book. Super nice guy and shows personality which is nice
Great guy, you learn a lot. Good structure for an intro course. He offers a lot of valuable insight and you get a bloomberg certification by the end of it.

He is an amazing professor that really cares about his students and treats them like equals. He wants you to learn as much as you can in his class and you can see that in every discussion. His class is run like a discussion so make sure you do the readings. As long as you work well in groups and put in effort, you will do well. Work slow on BMC!

Loved this professor! Expectations were very clear and possible to achieve with a little hard work. He really wants you to understand the concepts, as well as be able to solve problems. Office hours were helpful and fun, he explained things very clearly and made it all feel very approachable. I would take him for all of my classes if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Every day I left class more confused than I came in. I didn't even look at his notes when I studied because it was so confusing. Midterm was fine, final was hard: Mean70 Med75 High 94. ILS quizzes were difficult. Barely offered any office hours, especially for the size of the class. Wasn't willing to be accessible outside that one weekly session.

This man is lowkey so boring. I had taken physics before but was forced to take calc based in this class, and he made everything so much more complicated than needed. In all that he said, 10% was important but that got lost in the 90% of yap. I gave up trying to follow along and just taught myself the main concepts later. Very lowkey class overall.

Took Phys 1 and 2 for engineering with him. He teaches these classes like you're going to pursue a PhD in physics. He makes everything as complicated as possible because he probably doesn't realize most (if not all) of the students he's teaching are going to take Phys 1 and 2 and not take another physics class for the rest of their degree.

Good guy, really cares about his class. If you haven't taken calc 3 the class can be a bit tricky but with the HW and Lab propping up your grade you'll do fine. Lectures are bit confusing and goes in depth on derivations that you might use once in a HW. But overall a really good professor.

He's super passionate and cares that his students understand the course. However, you definitely have to put in the work if you want to do good on the final/midterm (mostly just based off of in-class/hw problems). You'll only get the full worth out of the class if you go to office hours, do the hw, and read the textbook every now and then.

The lectures move way too fast, but he normally explains the concepts somewhat well. the lab reports every other week are HORRIBLE and ILS is meh. The homework is very difficult, even if you understand the topics.

Lectures move very fast and aren't very clear at all, especially if you haven't taken calc 3. ILS is helpful, Lab reports every other week are awful, weekly homework is very difficult but if you try to understand it is helpful.
He was helpful during office hours and over email. However, he goes very fast during lectures, which makes them hard to follow—I usually leave class more confused than when I walked in.

Professor Camille was a very good professor for Physics 2. He's very caring and helpful (especially during ILS). Read the textbook before his lectures (the readings will help you understand what's happening in class) and the group work in ILS will help you prepare for the quiz. Overall, great professor and I would take him again.

Camille was a solid professor for Physics 2. He is definitely passionate about the subject and likes to demonstrate a lot of the concepts in class. A lot of the homework that was assigned was confusing, however, and did not always reflect the material covered in class through the lectures. The quizzes were also sometimes misleading and difficult.

Lectures were rushed and many topics weren't explained clearly. Sometimes the course went way too in-depth. Be prepared to read the textbook. There is one homework per week; Camille is super helpful at office hours. 
Exams were ok, mostly based on quizzes and problems done in lecture. Camille is a great person, just not the best lecturer!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: camille was hard to talk to. in class, he always seemed rushed for time and didn't seem to like when students asked questions, since then we would be "wasting time". outside of class, such as in emails, i felt that he would put me down and make me feel worse about myself than i had going into the interaction (probably not intentional). wouldn't rec

Really decent guy. Cares about his students and how well they're doing in his class. It is challenging though and there's not a lot of grade booster opportunities if you start off struggling. Decently fast paced lectures so make sure you are paying attention or be prepared to teach yourself a lot.

Definitely a great professor if you're a physics major or if you have a higher-level class with him, but for introductory level physics, the class was very confusing. A lot of the equations used in class had lots of subscripts that were hard to understand compared to the equivalent AP Physics C - Mechanics class I took in HS.

Professor Gomez-Laberge always came into class with enthusiasm and encourages questions during the lecture. He is always available for some time after the lecture for questions and he sets clear expectations for the midterm and final.

Passionate about what he is teaching and gets excited when people ask questions, however, sometimes he uses math that goes beyond what is expected for this course. The grading criteria is extremely fair and I always felt like on the quizzes/tests a lot of partial credit was given. Lectures hard to follow at times but activities in class helped.

I want to give him a 4/5 so badly because he's clearly a great teacher and passionate about the subject, but the reality is his homeworks and lectures are far more advanced and difficult than they need to be for the class.

Super nice person and eager to answer questions, but not the best at teaching. He often goes off on tangents and more in-depth than required. Lectures can be hard to follow, so reading the textbook beforehand helps. Quiz questions come from lectures and activities, and tend to be conceptual. Go to office hours because it helps with the homework!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Camille is possibly the sweetest prof I've had in years. Not the best at teaching, but he answers questions in class and seems very accessible outside of class, even with a massive lecture hall. Homework is often harder than anything in class or on the tests

He is a nice guy who wants the best for his students, but I think he should be teaching more advanced classes. The homework "goes a little beyond in-class material" and is impossible to do without going to office hours/looking online. All the in-class lectures involve useless derivations and problems solved in the most complicated way possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you've never taken Physics before, this class will be terrible for you. He flies through his lessons, barely even explaining. He goes really fast and assumes you've already taken physics before. There's a quiz and homework every week but it doesn't even reflect what we do in class. If you take this class, get ready to teach yourself the lessons.

Camille is a pretty great professor overall. His course is pretty lecture heavy due to the nature of the class but he does a great job building in review and answering student questions. I also had Camille for ILS and he is helpful when it comes to answering questions and has good availability for office hours. There's 1 homework per week, ~2hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Camille simply does not teach things that are on the homework. He barely covers a concept in class, and we have to teach ourselves everything else. And the homeworks have almost no clear example to base off of from the text, meaning we have to guess if we are doing something correct. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Gomez-Laberge is easily one of the coolest professors I have ever had. His slides and super clear and he does a great job of explaining the course content. He is a really chill guy and is very approachable if you need extra help. Overall physics 2 is a challenging class but he makes it fun and enjoyable. Absolutely recommend this guy, he is awesome

Dr. Vonstruck is a super professor. This is my 3rd class with him. Extremely funny guy and love his suits. He can be a bit scarcastic at times, but it's more in a fun way. You will learn a lot, if you put the time in. He doesn't share his slides which means you have to come to class and take notes. Best dressed professor, as well as funniest.

love him, such a funny guy, made going to class eazy. exams can be a bit challenging, but if you study you should be fine. take him if you want to learn something. somewhat suprised by the negative feedback here, if you can't get along with prof Vonstrunk then i don't know with who you can.

AI slides he's never seen before, AI tests he never reviews, poor communication, and passive aggressive emails. He seems nice enough to make jokes in class, but when I asked him to clarify a scheduling error he made, he basically gave me a snide urge to recheck canvas. Only upside is that tests are easy since the AI-made answers are obvious.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is the class that really broke my spirit. I wanted to go into clinical, and taking this course felt like the right step forward. Not only were lectures him reading off of a large document, but he had AI-generated slides, AI-generated emails, and AI-generated tests. The tests were incredibly lengthy, but there was no chance to review them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I wanted to like him but I just can't. He puts absolutely no effort in. Everything he presents is AI generated. I am pretty sure one of my exams was completely AI generated as well. I feel like I have barely learned anything in class, so don't waste your money.

Slides are AI and every class is the first time he's seeing them. Nothing on Canvas, so take notes! Exam questions are subjective multiple-choice questions! Won't go over exam questions with you, when you ask questions in class,his answers are opinion. I can't believe I paid for this course, the lectures are literally Cluad!

reviews.comment: Genuinely I wanted to drop out of this class. Severely disappointed by the lack of care and teaching quality from a class that I had such high hopes for. Do not take this class if you can avoid it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: An intro class should not have been this difficult. He always contradicted himself and often let his own personal feelings affect the test answers. If you want to remember random stats in the textbook and his own facts that he made up in class, then take the class. I wanted to drop out everyday.

He is quite boring when lecturing, and often just reads off the powerpoint. There are 5 exams in total, 4 midterms and one final. Your final grade is purely based on how well you do on all the exams, there are no chances for extra credit. Group project was easy to complete. It is a content heavy course and requires lots of memorization!!

Very long and unnecessarily detailed exams with fill-in-the-blank questions that could be random adjectives. His lectures would not tell you much, as he would just read from a long note sheet. Office hours were not very helpful, and he would not allow us to view previous exam performance at all. Your grade won't reflect your level of understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm sure he's better in other classes, he's a nice guy I enjoyed his lectures, but this course genuinely gave me gray hairs. It was impossible to get even an A-. I poured hours into this course as I love the topic, but it would've never been enough as his exams were unpredictable--completely new info, subjective answers, or just incorrect answers
Save yourself. The moment I was done from the final I saw god and I'm not even religious.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I fought tooth and nail in this class and I'm not dumb. Slides are poorly made. Was a little bit rude in the emails I got from him. Exam questions were crazy specific (random stats or names of people from an event). I didn't even know what to study since his lectures sometimes contradicted the textbook. Refused to round grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exams are loosely based on the lectures, even though he says they are entirely based on them. It makes it hard to study for exams, and the questions are crazy specific. Overall, not a horrible professor, but would absolutely not be my first pick.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is soooo easy! Yes he goes off-topic in class and makes the same jokes over and over, but his tests are so easy it doesn't even matter. He also gave almost everyone 100% on a group project worth 20% of our grade. He changed the course over the last couple years so only look at the more recent reviews to get a real understanding of the course.

Honestly, he was a fine professor other than his slides and exams. He taught course content very well, however slides weren't organized, and exams often included typos, were wordy, or covered info not found in exams or in the textbook. He's ok professor if you need to take psych foundations, but there are definitely other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a professor he did make lectures very interesting and tried his very best to be engaging, which had made goiing to class less of a chore. Tests align more with the textbook and often focus on the small details you would least expect. Chapters in the textbook are very long and sometimes feel tedious to read. Exams are your only real grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely one of the worst professors I have had at NU. Very challenging tests that often don't follow the notes presented in class (which by the way were literally a word document that he would just read off of during lectures). Yes he is funny, but funny doesn't make up for bad teaching. Avoid him unless you want to dedicate yourself to his class
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Professor Von Strunck pays for reviews on Rate My Prof, all of the reviews are the same but in reality he is a mediocre professor who struggles to convey ideas effectively. 

He often puts answers on quizzes that contradict the textbook and align with his personal views, making it impossible to study. The hardest Psych 1101 class for sure.

one of the best profs. i had at northeastern. highly intelligent and knows his stuff for sure. i just signed up to take another class with him. come to class, do your assignments, and you will do great.
tx for a great semester prof. VonStruck. Really loved your class. keep wearing those nice suits.

Finished the final today! Amazing class, and such a great professor. Goes above and beyond to help students. I found him to be available outside of class, and his jokes are great, sarcastic, but makes you laugh every lecture you attend. Test are easy, but some questions that are discussed in class, will show up on the test, so you should attend.

I stopped reading the textbook halfway through and I still did great on tests/final. Easy class if you're willing to take your own practice tests. Group project was graded easily. I would attend class, you're gonna end up doing less work if you do. He has a very specific way of writing tests that make it easy to detect the right answers.

Loved this class. He's a funny guy, but the material covered in this course is a ton! The class attendance was very low, and no one really participated. Felt bad for him as he tried his best, but could not do more then basically read of the slides. Most passive class I ever encountered. You can learn tons, if you do the work and attend classes.

i'm surprised by the man negative comments. dr Von struck is one of the best professors i've ever had. he is very intelligent, funny, cares for students, and gives more of his private time to students like i have evern seen any professor at a different school do. i strongly recommend taking his classes if you want to learn something. hes awesome!

von Strunck is funny, but very disorganized. He relies heavily on old slides and notes that he doesn't fully understand. He goes off-topic, and exams can be unclear. The textbook ends up being the main guide. He can be hard to approach, and had many issues with my accommodations. This class is graded by only five exams and a group-graded project.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm really confused by all the people saying this class was difficult? It was extremely easy. The exams were a breeze, all I did for most of them was read the textbook chapters. There is also a group project at the end of the year (worth 20% of your grade) that he grades EXTREMELY EASILY. My group got a 100. He is also very funny and knowledgable.

This class was truly fun. He knows what he is talking about and makes classes really, really funny. I loved going to class as you always have a few laughters here and there, which makes the class much more enjoably. 
If you want to learn something, take this professor, you will love him.

AMAZING prof!!! yu can tell he loves teaching. he is very energetic and makes a lot of jokes in class. im a bit surprised by the negative feedback prof Van struck is getting, as i truly find him to be an amazing teacher. you learn a lot. sure, the tests can be challenging but study, come to class, and pay attention you and you will do well

WORST CLASS EVER. Doesn't teach anything and reads off slides that are terribly made. For one of the units he used AI to make the slides.... LOTS of reading to do. 90% of the questions on the exam make no sense and are worded in the most diabolical way. Grade is HEAVILY based on the exams and no extra credit. Does not care about the students.

If bad test taker avoid, 5 exams including final and a final project. Took class above this and got an A, the structure of his exams were ridiculous and almost impossible (90 passage q's/100 min)
Told students if they had a problem they could review their exams in office hours then sent an email saying "too many student are going to office hours"??

Only four exams throughout the semester. 100+ questions in 50-60 minutes.. The only way to get a grade. No graded homework, no group work, no other opportunities to get credit for anything. He does not take attendance and goes through things very quickly, and gives a very quick explanation of topics.
all exams are based on readings, which his powerpoint never includes
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Von Strunck is the best! He is super funny and engages with the class. His lectures can miss some info for the exams, so make sure you read the textbook. Lots of easy assignments to boost your grade and all MCQ exams. Make sure to attend because he gives surprise in-class assignments. This was a super easy and enjoyable class! :)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Professor Von Strunck! He is super funny and engaging and he is a really sweet guy. Talking in class is definitely helpful and it's good to make sure he knows who you are. Attendance isn't technically mandatory, but I enjoyed the class I didn't really want to miss it. The class grading is exam-heavy, but if you study you're good!
he was the bomb! super cool prof, knows his stuff

Amazing Professor!! I just really enjoyed his lectures. Such a funny and caring guy. A bit sarcastic and witty, but makes lectures truly interesting. He definitely knows his stuff and may be too smart for his own good. Tests are challenging but if you study, participate in class, and do your homework you can definitely get a good grade!

Yeah I wouldn't really recommend. He was funny and the lectures seem to make sense but the tests are randomly very hard. Tons of reading if you want to be fully prepared. NO makeups allowed for tests, homework grades are strict w/ no extension. He gets the job done and the class is doable, but if you have another prof option take them instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's genuinely one of the best professors I have seen in this field. Very good at passing on his knowledge to us in the best, simplest way possible. Attendance wasn't mandatory, didn't give notes outside of what is in the tb, but his excellent humor made me want to attend class every time. Would take a class with him again if he held more of them

i enjoyed my two courses with dr. von Strunck. he is very funny, compassionate about what he is teaching and psychology and makes lectures really interesting. i loved going to my morning classes as there was always something interesting that he had to tell, always including current events. he also wears nice suits, never seen a professor doing that

Lectures just reiterated what we were assigned to read in the textbook but sometimes he contradicted what the book said which was very frustrating. Tries to be funny and witty but sometimes comes off as inappropriate. Tons of reading (if you actually read the textbook) but exams were not too bad if you do the learning curves. Graded mostly on exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Awful teacher. He offers no flexibility or understanding to his students whatsoever. He is very rigid and makes everything harder than it needs to be. an A in his class is a 94, but it is a 93 in all other classes.  Offers no make-ups no matter the circumstance. I Learned more from just reading the textbook on my own than I did attending lecture.

The tests are all based on the random stats in the textbook which are meaningless. He keeps on joking TREMENDOUSLY about how we chose psych because we cannot do math or any science field, which is very cringe. ( I am an international student coming from a public school in Japan so I pretty sure I can do math pretty well compared to him at least ).

Lectures are pointless if you did the reading (which you should do). A LOT of achieve textbook assignments. They are fast and easy but you should pay attention to the textbook because he pulls test questions from there. Class is a waste but you have to go because of randomized writing assignments in class. Just do the reading and follow the book.

He is a very nice and funny guy which makes his lectures pretty fun and engaging. The only thing I really didn't like is how heavily the course relies on the Macmillan textbook. All homework assignments are through Macmillan, of which there are a lot and most of the questions are very statistic based, which is not reflective of content on exams.

He is a super nice guy and funny, but the lectures are a copy-and-paste from the textbook, so you don't learn anything by going to class. This is annoying because there are pop-up writing assignments. He is very strict on grading, too, so don't expect any extra credit assignments.

Incredibly frustrating waste of money, his lectures rarely help you understand further. People stop taking notes after the first few weeks basically. I LOVED the textbook, the material + practice exams on it are incredibly informative. Great course, just take it with someone who will write fair, relevant exams and expand on the material in class.

I found his classes pointless and if it wasn't for his in class writing assignments I wouldn't go. Nothing he teaches in person is of value, as most of the test is compiled of random stats and obscure questions from the textbook. The writing assignments tend to be pointless, useless, and a waste of time. He merely would just read off the slides.

Assigned so many little assignments that did little to help me learn. It was just a bunch of busy work, just like my community college prior to coming here. Exams tested information not found in lectures. I had hoped that this course was taught by an actual clinical psychologist with experience in the field.

not a super hard class, mostly just memorization. prof is a bit uptight and some test questions are about things not covered in class. had to read the entire textbook and memorize the smallest, irrelevant details to do well (for example, what percentage of people have a certain disorder). also, we had a total of 87 assignments which is insane.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Von Strunck is a great professor. A lot of your grade is based on achieve assignments and all his tests and assignments are MCQ based. He's quite funny and cares for his students. Attendance grade is determined through writing assignments that he randomly gives. If you read and keep up with coursework, you will be fine.

AVOID! This course was frustrating due to the professor's 100% reliance on Macmillan Connect, with excessive homework and exams based on heavy textbook details. Lectures were unhelpful, slides were rushed, and writing assignments are random. Electronics weren't allowed for notetaking. Avoid this disorganized class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Says no laptops which is frustrating because it's hard to take handwritten notes and catch everything he says - but he forgets about this as class goes on. Doesn't take attendance until he realizes no one's showing up, then he starts. All homeworks are due by final day of class, which is nice but does not incentivize students. Lectures are boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really good professor. Taking another class with him starting next week. Very caring when something comes up and supportive. Knows what he is talking about and makes class super fun. Always wears nice suits.
great prof. looking forward to being in his class this fall again. gives homework assignment witch are part of your grade, 4 exams and a final. do the homework and you do well in this course
Great professor. Taking another class with him this fall.

Exams covered material that wasn't talked about in class or in the study guides. I had to scour through the textbook for hours because I never knew what would be covered on the exams. He threw a tantrum when I asked him to give me a retake exam after he forgot to give me extra time. He didn't relent until DRC forced him to. Avoid if possible.

The tests and final exam were made by the online textbook. When asked about content on the exam, he said he did not know what would be on it. Lectures were boring and mostly unhelpful. You'd be better off skipping and reading the textbook instead, but he took attendance randomly some days.

Thank you for a great and challenging semester Dr. VonStrunck. He does a lot of assignments that you can learn from for the test. If you study with Connect, go to lectures, and read your text, you will do well in this class.

just finished my final and loved this course. prof. Vonstrunk makes lectures really interesting with many case files from which you learn a lot. does a lot of group work that helps understand the material. def. knows his stuff and often too smart for his own good. ;) take him if you want to know more about disorders in psych.
Truly a nice and caring guy. Truly enjoyed this course.

prof. where were you at the final today? i had mike and ikes to give you. :( your ta was very nice but we  missed seeing you.  thank you for a great semester. really enjoyed your teaching style. have a fantastic summer.

Tough class but I learned a lot. He brings tons of books with case files to class that he reads and you have to find out what disorder it is. Laughs and says they are hard, when he well knows we'll figure it out easily. lol If you learn with Achieve, do your homework and come to class, you can easily get an A. See you in the fall prof. VonStrunk.

There's truly no need for him. Fails to communicate anything in lecture if you miss it (i.e., documentaries referenced on the final and whole in-class projects) and contradicts the textbook despite letting McGraw Hill make 100% of the tests and assignments. Succeeded in making an easy and interesting subject difficult to like, avoid if possible :)

Half textbook Connect other half himself. I know he can add questions of his own since he put a joke from lecture in there, just wish he would add more things from lecture as everything was from the book. Has really great lectures and is funny and can be deep about topics unexpectedly but its hard to focus knowing I have to read 40 pages later
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wohoooo. We made it. Dr von strunck os truly an amazing teacher. So much knowledge. I learned so much about disorders and how to apply dsm criteria. He does a lot of case studies. He reads them and then you have to figure out what the disorder is. Truly enyoyed the class. If you want to learn take his classes.

Great guy ans knows his stuff. Unfortunately there was almost no participation from the class who made it akwaed at time. I felt bad for him at times as literally people did not engage. Funny guy with lots of good life examples. Going to take another course with him in the fall.

He is very nice, but his teaching style is extremely ineffective. His class is based on Connect; the textbook and assignments are there. Exams are taken on Connect, and the questions are generated from the textbook, so if you don't have the whole chapter memorized, you'll never get a 100. He often contradicts the textbook and confuses us.

Super nice and funny guy! Engage in his class and read the textbook and you'll be fine. DO YOUR ACHIEVE!!! Achieve is the main basis for tests and assignments and if you don't understand it you will not do well!! Otherwise, very easy to get a good grade.

While Dr. von Strunck is kind and humorous, these qualities are not enough to make up for his unfamiliarity with the course material. Every test and assignment for the class is generated by the textbook website, so reading the textbook is sufficient to do well in the class. The lectures are entertaining, but not useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Von Strunk is a really nice guy but his lectures can be a little disorganized. However, towards the end of the semester they improved. Most of the grade is determined by tests, but 40% is through unlimited attempts on homework. Be ready to read your textbook and do the homework before the test since they are often on them.

Professor Von Strunck is a very funny and intelligent guy. He reads case studies and the lectures are interactive and fun. The tests are easy if you do the work on the textbook website. The workload is very manageable and it all relates back to the tests. He really relates himself to the discussion and interacts with the students.
Very Intelligent and funny guy. His test can be a bit hard but you lean a lot in his lectures. He really makes the material in class interesting with good examples so you better understand.

This class isn't for everyone. If you need structure like study guides and slides to learn, or if reading the textbook isn't enough, be aware that you might struggle. Exams are challenging, and the textbook costs around $100.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Von Strunck is a really funny guy who definitely wants his students to learn. However, all of the work he assigns is quizzes and assignments through an outdated textbook that are not relevant to the content on the lectures at all. Still a fun class.

He basically just read off of the slides, which seemed a bit old (ex. graphs from 2015). If you keep up with the homework you should do fine, but try to actually do the readings as well. I felt the tests had very random questions on them that no one would know the answer to, since it was never gone over in class.

Prof. von Strunck was funny and an entertaining lecturer, but the lectures themselves were pretty useless in the grand scheme of things. The tests came directly from the info from the textbook -even the smallest details you may skim over- so reading the book is extremely important to do well in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor von Strunck is an amazing Professor. Very intelligent guy who really makes you understand psychology stuff very well. Takes time to explain to students when they have questions. He asks a lot of questions during lectures and keeps the class engaged.

Great guy but terrible lectures. All the homework is based on the textbook and all tests are generated through homework questions. Fun and entertaining class, however don't rely on his lectures because they can be incorrect. He doesn't ever know how to answer students questions based on the lectures either. He'll make you laugh though.
Amazing professor. Made class fun and enjoyable. Really engaging and well in explaining difficult topics.
Just finished my final exam with Dr. Von Strunck. Great experience, and such a funny guy. Also probably best dressed professor.
Do not take unless you want to memorize a textbook in order to do well. Exams have NOTHING to do with lecture.
loved him. taking another class with him next semester.

One of the best professors I have taken at NU. Very knowledgeable, caring, and knows how to engage students. This is my third class with Dr Von Strunk, and I can only recommend him. If you want to learn, take his classes.

Had him freshman year loved him so I retook him this year for 3406. Tests are not hard at all, the rest of the grade is based on you showing up to class and completing some online activites to completion. Funny guy too always likes a good laugh and will challenge you when you are confident in your claims to push you to give a real explanation.
Prof. Von struck is awesome. Had fisrt exam yesterday and scored well. Lots of homework but counts to your final grade. It also helps on the exams. Funny guy. Knows his stuff, and super smart.

Amazing professor! Funniest guy I've ever been in class with. Makes lectures very fun and intresting. Gives good examples so you understand the material better. Lots of homework, but it's part of your grade and will help you on the exam.

Highly recommend him!
Terrible. Don't take him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I started writing down all of my issues but ran out of words pretty quick. In short, Prof Von Strunck made many mistakes (directly contradicting the textbook) which he refused to correct or admit to, was very difficult to reach out to for help, and generally made class very unenjoyable. I have never hated psychology more.

I absolutely loved taking this course with Dr. von Strunck. A very insightful Professor with much knowledge and plenty of examples during class so you can understand and learn the different concepts of psychology. Funny guy as well with a very sarcastic humor. 5 exams determine your final grade, and the final is not a cumulative one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: great professor. made concepts easy to understand. so enthusiastic and funny. thanks for a great semester!

Try getting any other professor for psych but him!! I walked into class expecting it to be enjoyable, but it wasn't. His slides had mistakes in it, and when corrected, he wouldn't admit he was wrong. Very ignorant to social justice issues as well. Grade based off 5 hard exams that are textbook-based. Rude teacher who didn't want to see us succeed.

I think he is very overrated. There is no incentive of going to class because the textbook company makes the exams. The entire grade is based on 5 exams, 20% each. I attended maybe 5 lectures in total. You have to know everything on the chapters to do well in the exam. He is funny but that wasnt enough for me
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Truly an amazing professor. Dr von struck is funny and hilarious. Though lectures can be long he makes them very interesting, he knows his stuff and his knowledge is scary at times as he can always relate the info to every day life. Take his classes if you truly want to learn!
do not take any of his classes. very unhelpful and not a good teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Von Strunck is a very funny and good lecturer. He provides many examples that help to better understand the concepts. Your entire grade is solely based off of 5 exams which can be very frustrating. If you read the textbook and do the practice exams you should be fine, but beware that the exams can be very tricky.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So far i realty like his development class. He knows his stuff and is super funny. He explains the material in a way you can relate and understand. Thumbs up!
amazing professor. looking forward to taking another class with him starting tomorrow.

Very thoughtful person and educator. He would like all of his students to attend so that they can engage with the material, but he is understanding of life unfolding and barring attendance. Be sure to communicate with him if you are not able to be the best student you can be, he is there to hear it. Will miss learning from Dr. Von Strunck.

There was no point in showing up to class. He just lectured on small ideas from the textbook. The tests were made from specific details about the textbook. You had to read the textbook and do the practice Hw that's not even graded repeatedly to do well on the tests. Mcgraw Hill made the tests not him. Might as well had been an online course.

This was an absolutely great experience. Professor von Strunck was so enthusiastic about the subject and I learned a lot from him. He is funny, caring, and has a great personality. Great knowledge and you will do great if you read the book and pay attention in class.

truly an amazing professor. very funny, caring and helps students outside of class as well. his lectures are funny and you need to attend and study to do well on the exams. i would definitly recommend dr. van strunk again.

Dr. Von Strunck was fine, generally just inoffensive as a professor. He's funny, which can make his otherwise pretty dry lectures tolerable. Entire grade was based on 5 tests, all of which come directly from the textbook company. Read the chapters and do the practice problems and it's impossible to get anything below a 90.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: only graded on five exams and there's no hw besides reading. you do have to read the entire textbook to do well. tests are the same as practice questions.Professor von struck is a little witty old man and he is super sweet but he refuse to give out lecture slides. please von struck they would've been so helpful for studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really bad teacher overall. Final grade determined by 4 midterms and 1 final, so very test heavy class. He doesn't curve and doesn't round. Seems like his slides are very old and sometimes have wrong info, so studying for the test was fully based on textbook since his lectures are so unhelpful. For a psych class, it was unreasonably hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It seems like he cares about his students, but that is not reflected in the grading. I went to him one day and he told me that tests are not representative of someone's knowledge but still refused to change the grading. The averages were terrible and there was no curve. He also doesn't post his presentation notes and blocks them while in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really good professor for a beginner psychology class. His lectures are engaging and he is always open to questions and further discussion of certain topics. He is a very caring professor and really wants his students to do well. As long as you study with the resources he provides the tests should be pretty simple, 10/10 recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was a solid professor and had enjoyable lectures. His tests were tough though and averages were often in the high 70s low 80s. For a class that is only graded on exams that is pretty scary. If you study the textbook you should be good though but even with that I still did not do great on the exams.

Not a fan of this man as a professor. He seems really nice, but he just cannot teach to save his life. In order to do well in this class you have to read the textbook and even then the tests are pretty hard. Don't take this class if you are bad at test taking.

Unhelpful. He puts up slides and reads them. Half the time he goes too fast and stands in the way of the board. He doesn't post the slides afterward. Everything is based on the textbook-generated exams and if you meet with him you can tell he has never even seen the questions before. Exams are 100% of your grade so you just have to teach yourself.

Dr. von Strunck is an amazing psych professor. This class is all about putting in the work. Exams are difficult. You have to memorize everything in the textbook and be able to apply the knowledge on the exams. Heavy on memorizing but exams aren't too bad. Exams make up the whole final grade. 5 exams each 20%. Very engaging and classes are fun.

Von Struncks's developmental psych class is the hardest/most involved psych classes I've taken. You have to do the readings to do well in this class, and they are pretty long. But it's so worth it, because it ended out being my favorite psych class ever as well! Von Strunck is the best. He's super funny and caring.

He was the worst professor I've ever had! First of all, he doesn't lecture at all. Divided us into 8 different groups and make us teach in class while he sits at the back listening to the presentations. Quizzed/tested us on content that he did not teach but insisted that he taught them. Anyone in that class can agree that he did not teach at all.

Attendance was "mandatory" but not graded, yet he targeted people who chose to not attend class by reporting us at risk to fail & emailing counselors (regardless of grade). Taught 1 lecture himself, the rest were student presentations (again, required but not graded). Tests are made from infinite (not graded) connect questions/assignments.
He's very nice and truly tries his best to make psych interesting. Tests are not too bad, just be sure to review the textbook beforehand. He tells the best jokes also!

Truly passionate about psych, tried to engage with students. Homework is time consuming but easy, lectures and practice tests are exactly like exams, and exams take max 30 mins. Posts everything online, accessible after class, but very strict about grades (no curving or leniency). As long as you do the practice tests, you will do great in the class

The most amazing professor!!! Super smart and it shows, he really knows what he is talking about! Also super funny and engaging, makes you want to come to class. The online learning structure is great and the practice quizzes are just like the exam. Loved it so much I am taking another class from him in the fall!

Professor Von Strunck loves psychology and you can notice this through his lectures. He truly loves what he is teaching and it makes the class even more engaging. The final grade is based on 5 exams and homework. As long as you pay attention, and practice before exams, you should be good!

I had Dr. von Strunck for both Abnormal and Developmental Psychology, and his teaching style is pretty much the same across both courses. He's very passionate about psychology and encourages thoughtful discussions in class. Lectures are very important to exam material, but the homework/practice quizzes are equally (or arguably more) important!

Highly recommend reading the textbook. Lectures are directly based off of the textbook; however, in class he breezes through the slides and skips important information and explanations. Exams are just like the practice quizzes. Sometimes there are a few questions that seem random, but they are definitely fair.

He is an awesome professor. He knows what he’s talking about and really wants his students to do well. Exams were online and were very straight forward if you studied by taking the practice quizzes. Always had funny stories to say and was very enthusiastic about learning!

Amazing professor. Cares so much about the well-being of all his students. Lectures were great as well but not mandatory. Showed up every day with a smile on his face. Intriguing lectures. Only grades were 5 tests which were identical to the practice quizzes. Totally recommend. Awesome guy.

Dr. von Strunck really does care about what he teaches and that makes his lectures enjoyable. The syllabus is what we stuck to the entire semester and it's important to keep track of. In Foundations, exams are 100% of our grade - however the required textbook has practice quizzes and they're basically the same as the test. Would take him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Absolutely love him he's so sweet and really wants you to learn. I remember reading somewhere that people found him tough so I was skeptical but I got to know him and he's super friendly and easy to reach out to. He replies quickly to emails and puts your mental health first, he really does care about you as a person not just as a student.

Highly recommend Professor Sadaka. He has his own teaching style, and I really enjoyed it. His lectures are clear and easy to follow, and he does a great job of helping students understand the material. I learned a lot from his class. Would definitely take him again!

I genuinely don't understand the hate on this rate my professor. Sadaka is a very passionate teacher and actually cares about his students' progress.
