Your grade is entirely dependent on 5 take home open note tests and he is likely to drop your lowest of the 5, plus your "final" isn't cumulative its simply the last test.

Professor Melloni is a great lecturer! He explains neuro in detail and goes over and over challenging topics. Great at answering questions. Lectures almost always end early bc some of the material is heavy. 5 exams including the final that's not cumulative. Ended up dropping the lowest grade. All exams are mc, online, open note but time-limited.

Melloni is the man!! Genuinely a GOOD lecturer. Grades are entirely the average of five multiple-choice exams on Canvas, and the final is just the 5th exam. Would give points back if he felt an exam question wasn't fair. Likes to end classes early too. Take his class if you actually want to learn something and also get an A without too much effort!
Good lectures and nice guy. Four online tests about 40-60 questions each. Exams had some tricker questions but overall not bad. The content was very interesting
Psychopharmacology: 4 online exams (open note + book). Some questions are from textbook readings, not in lectures. 50-60 question exams in a little over an hour (but final was 2 hours).

I had Melloni for 3 classes, clinical neuro, biopsych, and psychopharm. I loved him for every one of these classes. He's such a funny guy, and will answer any question with enthusiasm. For all these classes, he had around 4-5 tests through the semester, either open note or open note + take home. No cumulative midterm or final.

Super interesting lectures + course material. Cares a lot about what he's teaching. Very funny + engaging. Questions on tests are sometimes confusing, but he goes back and gives pts back for problems a lot of ppl got wrong. Tests were all online - even final. Ends class early a lot
This class is difficult so it's important you go to all of the lectures, but Professor Melloni is truly one of the kindest, most accommodating professors I have had. Great teacher and person
Dr. Melloni is very caring and simplifies complex anatomy for the undergrad level, however is pretty unresponsive and there are errors are many tests.
Dr. Melloni does an excellent job of simplifying complex topics and makes lectures interesting, however he isn't very responsive and there were somme errors on ever test.

- 5 tests in all: all are online and you do not have to be in the room during the test

- he makes the toughest topics seem so easy

- his grading is fair: if you mess up, then it is entirely your fault

- he is reasonable with his test dates: a week after the content is done (btw it is not cumulative)

- I highly recommend him
Super passionate about what he's teaching and also very understanding. I definitely enjoyed the class

I really enjoyed taking this class with Professor Melloni. He is very passionate during his lectures and takes the time to answer questions. This class covers a lot to find what you are passionate about in psych. The only thing is your entire grade is based off of 5 exams, but you definitely feel prepared for all of them.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: professor melloni is one of the most compassionate and considerate professors i have had. he makes sure that everyone understands each topic before moving on. he opens a for students to then critique his test/teaching format to make sure we are getting the most out of the class. 5 exams, MC, online, open note, but timed so study b4. flashcards help
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: professor melloni's class was super fun. grade is determined by 4 exams. exams are all multiple choice and not hard as long as you go to class and take notes. he does offer extra credit for participation, so make sure to ask questions during class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor melloni is such a great lecturer, makes sure we understand the material and willing to go in depth with any questions we had Goes over clinical applications of everything (he taught medical students) Passionate about the course material Tests are fair and he boosts your final grade if you participate a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Had Spring 2020, so half online. Only graded by tests, which are 65 multiple choice questions and included info from the textbook as well. Overall vibe: good guy, wants you to succeed, has some favorites but u can go unnoticed if u want, jokes around, has a lab & teaches medical students. A LOT of information. Have a good note-taking system.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Melloni was great. Tests won't trick you if you are prepared (read the book to clarify power points) and is fair about giving points back if most of the class struggled on a question or two. He drops the lowest exam grade which wasn't on the syllabus. Overall, I would take a class with him again and recommend him to others.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Melloni is by far my most favorite teacher that I've taken. His powerpoint lectures are very straight forward and clear, and the discussions in class are very knowledgable. He's pretty funny, and as long as you go to class, you should at least get a B or higher. His tests are straightforward with no trick questions, but still hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: His tests are not very fair, sometimes they are on very minor details he skimmed in class, and he rounds down. However, I did learn a lot and I don't regret taking the class. If you study hard (AKA memorize the slides and read the book) then you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He will bend over backwards for a student. People saying he wont help outside of class are too timid to get the help. He treats students with the same respect that the student give to him, very much like a real world boss. go to him with specific questions and he wont let you leave his office until you 100% understand. BNS/psych: TAKE HIS CLASSES!!

The tests are not very fair. He sometimes writes questions that are clearly not covered in the slides. Also, he rounds down: if you have a 89.7 on a test, that becomes a 89. It makes a difference in the final grade.

Each lecture throws a lot of information at you, but it is presented clearly. There is a lot to learn, but Professor Melloni will answer your questions. The tests are pretty tough, you definitely have to study, but it is nothing he hasn't covered in lecture. The PowerPoints are comprehensive and the lecture notes are essential.

VERY difficult class. Dr. Melloni is not available for help, and not interested. He goes over an INSANE amount of material, and doesn't have much patience for questions. No book; material is entirely based off his PowerPoints. 3 tests per semester, and he drops the lowest score, so each of the two remaining tests  50% of your grade. NEVER AGAIN!!!
Really interesting and engaging lectures. He's super smart. Tests are straight forward, all materials from the slides. Provides slides with great notes. Fun class.

Your entire grade is based off 3 exams, but then he drops the lowest grade so it's really 2 EXAMS... 50% each. That's just insane. I feel bad for all the other people like me who get test anxiety and don't perform well that way. Hardest class, but coolest material. Fascinating! I suggest getting a tutor... don't expect ANY help from him at ALL.
Amazing professor and a great guy. Fascinating material. He always made the extra effort to answer someone's question and made sure the class understood. His tests were straightforward.

Great teacher! Really enthusiastic and knowledgeable. He really gets the class involved and tries to make lectures engaging. He doesn't use a textbook and everything from the slides are on the tests. I would highly recommend him!
Loved the class. Interesting material. Easy tests. Eliminates questions no one gets right. No book. Explains everything in depth. I would take another class with him in a second.

LOVED THIS CLASS! If anyone is really interested in the biology part of psychology take this class. Professor Melloni is an amazing professor and makes the class extremely interesting. HIGHLY recommend this class.

He is a great professor! He doesn't use a textbook, so you have to go to class to get the notes. He makes his powerpoints available online so you can print them out. He answers all questions very clearly and makes sure that people are understanding the material as class goes on. He lets you out early most of the time, too! :)

Very interesting class although the first sections can be boring. One thing I found is that although this class is HUGE at 200+ students, Melloni manages it very well and engages the entire class with a conversation-style lecture. Exams could be a bit tough but are manageable and he's very helpful if you need any sort of clarification.
Great class, the information is interesting and Melloni is engaging when he teachers, made me want to go to class. He clearly knows what he's talking about.  Highly recommend!

Easy class. I skipped most of the lectures and did very well. You just need to memorize the slides he asks you to print out. Don't ask dumb questions. He's also very hard to get a hold of so if you have a question ask him after class.

He is very passionate about what he teaches and definitely knows his stuff. There's no textbook, so you need to show up to class. I tend to fall asleep when he goes off on a tangent because someone asked irrelevant questions, but the information is very interesting, so it's great most of the time.

One of my favorite classes at Northeastern! Professor Melloni knows just about everything about Psychobiology but he can be a little condesending if you ask stupid questions, don't come to class, or aren't paying attention. I loved his teaching style, no textbook and the students print out his slides to bring to class and take notes on.

Really interesting class. It's straight forward and pure memorization. I loved having no text book. Melloni knows a lot about neuroscience and makes it very evident. He's a good guy, I envy his knowledge. Memorize the slides and the exams will be a breeze.

He's an awesome, funny guy and he's on top of his game. He's a BIG **** if you seek help outside of class, or ask dumb questions. Essentially if you do your part, he'll do his. Don't look for an easy way out. The class is a joke if you're a BNS student. The exams are legitimately right from the slides.

Dr. Melloni is amazing. The class is really interesting, exams are a little challenging, but if you average a 94 on the first 2, you can skip the final. He is super ridiculously smart - pretty much knows everything about everything, except what happens when you eat a jalapeno..hah. There's no textbook, class only meets 2x a week, and fun lectures!

Really enjoyed going to this class and found it very interesting.  Its not the easiest class, but its worth it.  My piece of advice would be to go online and by the text book that the class is based on, it costs $2 and explains everything with color pictures.

he is okay, he makes everything really clear and is a good teacher. he is also a very busy man, who is doing tons of research so you won't get a lot of one on one time with him. his tests aren't easy but there are not surprises just make sure you know EVERYTHING on the slides
I don't have a good background in Bio which made this class challenging, but I also have never been this interested in going to class. I'm going to take all the classes he teaches.
all slides used in class are available online...tough class, but if you put in the study time you can pull off a good grade. dont need extensive background in biology

Professor is a great teacher and really funny. He'll keep you paying attention to the entire lecture, he's not boring at all. He gives you the notes, there is no textbook. You just have to understand/memorize them. His test questions are straight from the text. They are mostly multiple choice questions and a few matching. He's AWESOME!GO TO CLASS!
With a science background, easy A.  Very interesting and fun. 3 exams. Can skip final if ave of first 2 is 95. Melloni is impossible to get a hold of outside of class
This is a great class and I found dr melloni to be very clear, although some students think he goes fast. His powerpoints have everything you need to know already on them.

This class was team-taught with Lesley Ricci, and they were both great.  Very interesting, gives lots of examples.  I had zero bio background, so it was the most difficult class I have taken at NU, and he made it much easier to understand. I heard that students with bio background found it easy, though.

Really intelligent guy, he def knows what he's talking about and his lectures keep you awake.  The material itself isn't that easy but it's still really interesting, and he makes everything easy to understand.  Easy grade if you study!
This man is the love of my life hehhee but seriously... The class is great.

awesome class! SO interesting. potentially a difficult subject, but prof melloni is such an effective teacher it was a breeze. the assistant teacher that comes in a lot, lesley, is also cool. both very knowledgable and pretty funny. highly recommended!

Prof. Melloni was very straightforward, funny, and well spoken in psychobiology. I took the class as a freshman and it was still very manageable because the notes are written by him and he allows you ask any questions, etc. Also, his assistant who comes in to teach is very knowledgable in the field and offers tutoring to students who need help.

Allows you to be exempt from finals if you have an A (94) NOTHING LESS. Don't try w/a 93.5. Won't happen. But I never took a final in either of the 2 classes I had with him. Very knowledgable. Never had to find him outside of class but I hear he is a ghost. Wouldn't doubt it. But I would take him if he taught other higher courses....
He is very smart and states everything clearly. Very interesting class. I learned a lot. The tests can be hard but there are no tricky questions. Every question will be laid out in the book.

Have had him both for Psychobio and psychpharm. Although I enjoyed both classes, I felt I could have learned much more. He frequently canceled classes and let class out early by 30 mins every time. If thats something you like, then go for it, but I am actually interested in subject material and we didn't cover a lot of what he said we would. He's also very arrogant and don't ask him for a recommendation because he won't remember to send it.

Prof Melloni is an excellent teacher IN CLASS.  However, it's almost impossible to contact him outside of class (at least was my experience.)  This class is really interesting, and I learned a lot.  But when it comes to getting extra help or really anythin
enjoyed both psychopharm and psychobio very much, tests can be difficult, but he usually gives u all his lecture notes so that makes it a lot easier.
No Comments

Probably one of my favorite classes.  He is an awesome professor and is very knowledgable and understandable in his teaching.  I would recommend this class to anyone interested.  Some of his test are a little hard, but I feel that I've learned so much!
Good class. Does good job though he can be confusing. Would be better if he was a bit less arrogant.

my favorite class so far.  difficult at times but if you pay attention and read the packet which has everything! that will be on the test you'll be fine.  his passion is very apparent, he knows his sh*t and he loves it.  absolutely amazing class, i'm almost sad it's over

One of the best teachers I've had at NU. Knows the material inside out and has a passion for the field.  Also has the ability to make information that can be boring interesting. His skill is readily apparent when the TA teaches and there is such a deviation in quality.

Melloni is beyond cool. Knows his material to each and every point. Likes to answer questions and is very willing to help those in need of it. The tests are moderate but they do require a fair amount of reading over and over. No book. A powerpoint packet which has EVERYTHING that will be on the test

Let me just say that I hate science, which is why I'm a psych major.  The course is really challenging, but just as long as you study and pay attention in class, it's not that bad...  though the tests he gives have been known to give it's takers migraines.
Challenging tests, but an awesome professor!  Great info and very humorous.

Good class...Melloni is a really good teacher, and this class covers of material but if you go to lectures and study the way he tells you to, you will be fine...I got my first 99 on a college exam in this class

I think Melloni is awesome. He really knows his material well and is great and making it seem down to earth. He presesnts the material in common terms that everyone can understand. I really recommend taking at least one of his classes!

Melloni knows his *hit... but he is a bit arrogant and I was not treated with respect in his class. Also, if you're a neuroscience major and have  alot of psych people in your class.. get ready to learn all about action potentials..

Makes everything sound so simple.  His tests are hard, but if you learn the material, it isn't so bad.  He uses powerpoint but explains it in full in class, constantly asking if anyone has any questions.  The powerpoint was a classpak, the only reading.
tries to make the class simple although the subject is somewhat complicated.  good teacher, wants everyone to understand.
No Comments
I looooove Melloni!

This guy is pretty cool and laid back. The tests are challenging, but he makes the material really easy to understand. He's one of the best profs i've had. He is loaded with info related to the course and is happy to share his knowledge.
He is a really hard professor, and does not give many assignments.  He is kind of intimidating at first, but if you show that you are trying hard, he will pass you.

Totally cool guy, more like a football coach than a professor. But, don't let his relaxed attitude and humor fool you he is one of the smartest professors out there. All notes are in Powerpoint and posted on Blackboard which is a big help.

Prof Prakash really cares about his classes and wants everyone to do well!!  He really wants feedback and to improve his class/ the teaching.  Pretty easy A and there is also extra credit chances if you go to class.  Def one of the best upper level econ elecs to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Day 1 was intimidating but in a good way. Prof. Prakash didn't even introduce himself, he jumped straight into a challenging assignment on a real socio-economic problem. Set high standards immediately, but you can tell he genuinely cares about students and wants them to succeed. Tough, but in a motivating way. Can't wait to see how this sem ends!

Professor Prakash made this class truly special. He cared deeply about us, often checked in, and shared real-world policy stories that made learning engaging. He was always supportive, even outside of class. His kindness, insight, and passion for teaching made him one of the most inspiring instructors I've ever had.

Professor Prakash made this class so special. He actually cared about us, always checked in, and shared cool stories from his real-life policy work. He made learning feel real and fun. Honestly, he's the nicest and most inspiring instructor I have ever had. He also was willing to help us beyond classroom.

I joined this class unsure of what to expect. At first, I feared it might be boring, but I was so wrong. The course's strong connection to real-world challenges in development economics made it fascinating. What truly made it special was Professor Prakash—new to Northeastern, yet the best and most caring & knowledgeable professor I've had!

This class is entirely him presenting his own research, which is hyper-specific and doesn't teach about the field as a whole. Is basically all on South Asia; disappointing that a course on development Econ hasn't mentioned LatAm once. Grading criteria is not super clear and is only done by the TA who also gives limited feedback

Professor Prakash is very sweet but does not teach the subject. He treats class as a time to talk about his research projects. While some do have to do with Developmental Econ, they do not give you a good understanding of the subject. He also has everyone say something at least once per class. Waste of money
Nah don't take him for this class

from the moment you walk into class everything is about him. given his rich background and expertise, he can't teach even if his life depended on it. there is so much ego in the classroom and there is no other way to describe how futile this class was. definitely do NOT recommend the class!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There is so much ego in the classroom.  It drips with his importance.

Naeem is incredibly well-versed in VC, and gives great lectures from an insider's perspective into the startup ecosystem in the Bay. Guest speakers were few but good. Take this class with a willingness to participate and soak up everything you learn. Be prepared for cold calls. Group project represents over 50% of class grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easily the best professor I've ever had. He's certainly a bit of a hardass but he's got the track record to back it up. Goes above and beyond but can be difficult to please. Keeps you on your toes and your head on a swivel. Be accepting to learn. Overall 10/10 and I wish I could take every business class with him. This man is a wealth of knowledge.

I would highly recommend taking any class by Naeem! I absolutely loved his entrepreneurship class, and his lectures were engaging and interesting. His class is geared to prepare you for the entrepreneurship process, and it is very well structured. Naeem is an awesome professor who cares a lot about his students - take his class (buy his books)
Naeem may have cold caller, but was an amazing professor in the long run. He ingrained the entrepreneurial mindset into our heads.

I loved this course and Naeem! He is extremely passionate about entrepreneurship which made the course so much more enjoyable. It was a heavy course load and content heavy but it was so worth it. I learned so much from this course because of it. The group projects were fun and helped you learn the material.
dont do it
Difficult, but doable and very informative. Go to office hours, she is generous with revisions on tests and quizzes.

Her lectures are not helpful because she has a thick accent and moves very fast. She tells us what to study for tests and quizzes, but I still did not do well on them. She lets you do test corrections to boost your grade. She gives us finals and answer keys from previous semesters, and the final is the same with changed numbers.

Don't get me wrong, Natalia is a very sweet professor. However, her class sucks and she's not very good at teaching. She makes a lot of mistakes and skips a lot of steps and information. Office hours are slightly better and she's very flexible a lot of the time if you're sick. Final and midterms are hard. Take at your own risk.

Very difficult, but good teacher. Lecture style is hard to follow for some, but not extremely difficult once you focus. You need to go to office hours, she is strict on grading but generous with revisions.
Please do not take her.

I was in the trenches the entire semester. Her accent isn't even the problem, it's the way her lectures are structured that was so chaotic and confusing. One of the worst professor's I've had at Northeastern. If she is your only option then drop.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Go to class, and go to office hours

Professor Ptitsyna is a very nice and caring person. However, her teaching style for Diff. Eq. was overall too difficult, very theoretically heavy and not enough application of formulas. I had prior experience with Diff Eq. and Linear Algebra and was still struggling through the class. I wish everyone the best of luck!!

She has a very thick accent which makes it hard to understand. However, this class is easy, everyone who has a bad grade in this class doesn't try. SHE GIVES U PRACTICE EXAMS that are the same as her tests. Her multiple-choice tests are hard but she has no homework. I didn't take any notes and got a good grade, it ain't hard

Her lecture style is very difficult to learn from; she goes at an extremely fast pace, and spends the entire class time going over theoretical things, only ever briefly touching on the actual formulas and their applications that will be seen on the quizzes and exams. Be prepared to teach yourself if you take this class with her.

This was my second time taking Calc 2 so I might be a bit biased but she wasn't the worst teacher I have ever had. She does truly care but it just a bit unorganized and rushes sometimes. She has an accent but you get used to it. If you can, switch professors.

Her lectures consist of copying and pasting the notes she posted online onto the white board. She is so slow at them that we did not finish all of the content by the end. The quizzes and tests were all made by her and were harder than other sections (with the exception of the final). Expect to study most of it on your own and still not understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took AP Calculus in High school so I came into this class with background knowledge, and I also know how easy Calc 1 can be. However, she made a subject that was easy to me 10x harder because she does not know how to teach, she reads off of her papers and only gives theory, and her tests and quizzes are much different than her classowork.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor P is so sweet and is extremely nice and caring, however, she is not a very good lecturer. The topics are often more confusing they need to be and difficult to understand. The weekly quizzes are not great and you have to learn a lot on your own. She is very helpful in her office hours though and gives a substantial midterm curve.

Professor P is a very nice and caring lady. She seems so genuine and really does seem so sweet. Unfortunately, she can not teach. She is extremely misleading on the test subjects and does not provide adequate practice and leaves the test very unclear. Its really confusing why someone would not explain how to properly study. Sweet Lady, Bad Prof.

Many of the other reviews you'll see here are spot on. Such a sweet lady but just a terrible educator. Hard to understand, lectures way too fast, inefficient communication, and way overcomplicates otherwise simple concepts. If you take her class you'll have a pleasant experience, just be prepared to do everything yourself.

As someone who isn't the best at math, she definitely did not make it any easier. Her lectures are fast paced and confusing, and doesn't give good answers to questions. Give quizzes/tests every week. Test content isn't always what's reflected on the practice. If you aren't a math/engineering/physics person, avoid her.

Weird class as the test were very difficult with retakes but the final is rather simple. I would not recommend if math isn't your thing as she is very theoretical. Quizzes are rather straightforward however practice test were much harder than test. Has an accent too so is hard to understand but is funny at times. Recommend going to lecture too.

Professor P is very sweet. She is passionate about the subject. Lectures give a lot of info and can get confusing at times, but office hours are very helpful. The class does have a quiz every week but half are take home. Her midterms also have test corrections or retakes. All the practices posted are almost identical to the tests quizzes.

Professor Ptitsyna is really sweet, but not the best teacher. She gives way too many notes during lecture, to the point where it just is the textbook regurgitated. I really struggled in her class and found that self-studying was more successful for me, but that doesn't help for the final; beware of her class.

She's nice and passionate about what she teaches but isn't good at teaching. Lectures aren't easy to follow as she explains the concepts in a difficult way. Office hours are helpful. Test prep barely prepared us for the tests. Class did so poorly that she did retakes/corrections. Only reason I passed was because I had to teach myself everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unless you're only taking this class as a refresher, switch. She has an accent that makes lectures hard to understand, notes you take will not be clear. She makes the easiest concepts difficult. Some of her tests are similar to the practice, but not always. If you don't have the discipline to constantly teach yourself, just don't take her.
lectures are hard to follow, incredibly strict grading, unapproachable. I completely relied on YouTube lectures provided in the syllabus.

Poor lecturer, spends 90% of class deriving formulas then proceeds to do half a practice problem. Online material is hard to read, basically have to self study. Gave us lots of points back on test corrections to make up for bad test scores.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The fact that everyone in the class had taken calc 1 before, yet everyone still struggled says a lot about her teaching. She is such a sweet person but is a harsh grader and doesn't adequality prepare you for tests. She does a lot of proofs which don't help your understanding and won't get to the point until the period is about to end.
Lectures do not help at all, she just talks and reads off of papers in her hand. Gives practice quizzes for tests and quizzes. Overall not a good professor but class is not hard

Professor Ptitsyna is so funny and nice. Sometimes she is hard to follow, but if you pay attention, you can definitely succeed. You are only graded on tests though, so do not take if you are bad at tests and quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Natalia is a very caring professor. Although her lectures can be very theory heavy; a math class mostly comes down to practicing problems. She is very approachable in office hours.

Professor Ptitsyna is a lovely lady; however, she is a horrible lecturer. I have not understood anything in any of the 100-minute lectures I have attended and I have learned all the material from online resources. This being said her quizzes and tests are graded generously and aren't always as difficult as expected if you can teach yourself calc...

Dr. Ptitsyna is a great person, but a mediocre teacher. Although she is helpful after class and gives good explanations, she doesn't ask students questions. Furthermore, she rushes through lectures and doesn't get through them on time. If you go after class for explanations, she does a fine job explaining concepts. Good teacher, also a tough class.
An awesome professor who always focuses on the teaching content. Showing up at her office hour is also very helpful.

She wasn't that great with technology since it was hard to see what she wrote on the board through zoom and her lecture notes are way long and dull. Also it's hard to hear well especially with her accent which I don't blame. But the best pro is her exams aren't difficult as long as you know the basics from her lecture in which she goes overtime.

Nice and caring professor. Her teaching speed is slow with every detail explained. No attendance is required but I still recommend people who never learned calculus in high school to attend every course. Not difficult compared to other math courses. No homework and only quizzes and tests are counted in grade, which are fairly easy to get full marks
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Took calc 1 with her last semester. She went a bit too fast and I often just went over her notes online instead of listening in lectures. Tests were a lot of the grade, but most of our quizzes were take home so not as bad as they could be. Seems like a very sweet prof tho, just not for me personally.
Had her for calc 1. Lectures are fast and kinda hard to understand, I ended up doing better learning on my own. Quizzes and exams are okay, sorta predictable. Homework not mandatory, but helpful.
Avoid at all costs. You will not learn anything from her and learn everything from the textbook/internet.

Although she is enthusiastic about the material, she does a terrible job of explaining things. The homeworks were terribly unorganized and it was unclear what we should do. Her lectures a dull and staying awake was very challenging. If you have never taken Calc before, she is not the professor for you. She struggles to solve the problems she gives.

Although her homework is optional it is best to get some practice down. As well as taking notes during the lectures. Although her grading is sometimes late, she will do her best to explain when asked to do so. Pretty lecture heavy so it is best to do it in the afternoon rather in than in the morning where you might be quite tired.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: The GOAT. Attendance isn't mandatory and everything was online/ take home. This class IS a guaranteed A. Lectrues were a bit fast-paced, but he was happy to answer any questions that students had. TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HIM!!!

First time teaching so he was def learning how to teach the class. I enjoyed his lectures as he was passionate about the course, but a lot of people found it boring. Class was very easy with the take home tests.
His classes were lecture dense and not very engaging. However, everything in this course is take home, so it's not a hard class as long as you complete all the assignments online.

He's knowledgeable in his field, but his lectures can sometimes be repetitive and also fast-paced. Everything in the course was take-home (including midterm and final) so it's basically a guarenteed A in his class. As long as you complete all assignments, quizzes, and tests, you'll do good.
40% final 30% midterm but both are take home. No attendance required, which is sad bc only 10 people would show up. A bit backloaded but a fun class, good content and good professor. Fair grader.
Nan zhou is the goat. Easiest A.
more profs should be like nan

Everything in this class is take home, including both the midterm and final, so it is a pretty light class in terms of work. Prof. Zhou gives interesting lectures as well, so if you are interested in the material, going to class is nice. Attendance is not mandatory as well, so if you don't like the material, you dont have to show up

super easy class. all of the assignments are online and open note, no textbook required, and attendance isn't mandatory. econ is generally super boring imo but he does a pretty good job using engaging examples. def recommend if you need an easy econ credit
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: really easy A. all of the quizzes and tests are online (midterm/final). he is a nice guy and great teacher, he uses a lot of interesting examples to explain the concepts. however, because attendence wasnt mandtory no-one would show up to his lectures 3 weeks in.
Nan is so chill. Sometimes the take home quizzes and assignments were a bit tricky but nothing that couldn't be figured out. Cool dude and really is so lax. Would recommend
Easy A dont sleep on him

Such an easy A, don't ever go to class... take home midterm and final. All the homework's and quizzes are also online. The TA literally says it's impossible to get less than 80 on the assignments/midterm/final as long as you complete it, as well as impossible to get less than 50% on any problem even if you are completely wrong. Such an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy A, take home midterm AND final, it's so free
Absolute Goat
Absolute gem of a Professor. Attendance isn't mandatory, all assignments including the Midterm and Final are administered online. Easy A for every freshman taking this course with him.
take it. surface level lectures and speech pattern that will put you to sleep. But trust me, take it.

He is a quiet teacher, but he really knows what he is talking about. His classes are very lecture-heavy, and even though he says to get the textbook, you do not really need to buy it. Everything in the books is what he talks about on his PowerPoint in class. Would definitely take classes with him again. He is very easy to reach outside of class

Prof. Khatchatryan was great! His expectations were extremely clear and relatively easy to meet as long as you look at/attend the lectures. Your grade is made up of 5 quizzes, 2 midterms/tests, a term paper, and participation. Overall a super kind professor and very responsive to his emails.
waste of time and money. for a class that could be so interesting and motivating all he did was read off the slides.

Super easy class if you show up and take notes. He posts the slides beforehand and the quizzes only cover stuff in them. Sometimes, there are bonus points for something he says in class. Funny guy and wants everyone to do well. The midterm and final are both online, take-home, so they're very easy. Fun field trip to a jail aswell.
Great guy.

Professor Katchatryan's lectures were often dry and unmotivated, he spoke with a monotone voice that was very difficult to pay attention to. That being said, class assignments were not hard and were very fair. Not hard to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy classes but lazy lecturer in my opinion, no passion and he's a quiet speaker. He is super kind though, grades fairly and cares about his students. I found this class a little frustrating as it only looked at russian/italian org crime and it seems outdated and stereotypical - I think there is more to talk about specifically in the US.

Professor Katchatryan is such a kind professor! He was very helpful with any questions I had throughout the semester. A lot of his class is him reading slides but he also added in a lot of class discussions and encouraged us to have thoughtful conversations about topics which I always enjoyed.

Laziest professor I have had at Northeastern, he just read off the slides everyday in the most monotone voice that it became difficult to stay awake. I did not learn anything in this course, and I do not fully understand why students or faculty like him. Easiest A you will ever receive, but at what cost.

Has this class over the summer online -- He is caring and always put in work to make sure we felt prepared for quizzes. Not graded on many things, but always very fair. Not a difficult class, but still was very interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Katchatryan's class is pretty easy (the quizzes are taken directly from class slides and the midterm + final are online) but his lectures are extremely boring. I didn't know it was possible to make a class on organized crime boring, but he managed to do it. Seems like a nice guy tho, just so not engaging.

Dr. Katchatryan is one of the sweetest professors I've had at Northeastern. His quizzes are very straightforward as long as you review the slides he presents during the lectures. There are three writing assignments that I found very interesting but also weren't too difficult. The midterm and final are both online and open-note outside of class.
Very sweet guy. Course was easy if you read the slides and complete the writing assignments.  His smile lights up a room!
If you go to class and read the slides you will get an A

He made this class very easy, there is a textbook but it's honestly unnecessary. Everything you need is on the lecture slides which he will post after the lecture. If you take notes on the slides you'll be fine. There are 5 quizzes throughout the sem. but they are not hard. Take notes for the open note exams and you'll be fine.

Very kind professor! The class was all lectures and a bit of discussion. 3 writing assignments, 5 quizzes, and a midterm and final (both online). Participation is graded, but if you go to office hours you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You go to class, type the notes he gives you, you have about 5 quizzes that are on one chapter each. 3 writing assignments that are 3-5 pages each with their own requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor is a genuinely nice guy, and if you have a general interest in criminal justice, his class offers a pleasant and laid-back experience. His teaching style is straightforward, mostly consisting of reading off slides. Exams and quizzes are very easy and the final paper is very easy especially if you start right away.

Prof Katchatryan is a solid professor. He reads off the slides that he later posts, so it's pretty easy to refer back to them in prep for the online exams, though the lectures can be boring. There is a final paper that I found very interesting and he reminds you of it often. This was a course I could rely on to be easy, so I definitely recommend.

Reading heavy, as to be expected for a theorys class. While the materials are engaging, Professor Bormann style isn't. The classes are mostly comprised of long, dry lectures. Hard to stay focused. The class being comprised of ungraded and graded parts makes grading vague. She grades on her own personal opinion. Wouldn't recommend.

Absolutely wonderful woman!! She is so sweet and so kind, yet can still discuss difficult topics analytically and with grace. You will be graded on only a few assignments, however, she gives you enough time and clear rubrics. Her class was very meaningful and I feel like I learned a lot.

Clearly cannot handle the workload of being a department chair and a POLS professor as she cannot give feedback/ grades or email back in a timely manner. You will not get anything out of her classes. I think her being the department head shows how bad the POLS curriculum is at Northeastern University.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: god awful. super annoying and boring lectures. horrible grading feedback and grades based on her own opinion
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class itself is easy, pick 2/4 essays, groups project, final paper, and bi-weekly module posts. Personally, Prof Bormann's teaching style is not my thing. Its giving the whimsical philosophy teacher from a sitcom. Sometimes was annoying with grading/ gave vague feedback. The lectures are long but no attendance taken.

Professor Bormann is fantastic! She was frequently available for in-person or online office hours to further discuss readings, assignments, etc. She is very passionate and knowledgeable in her field and respectfully pushes students to challenge and discuss topics that might be uncomfortable.

The class is fairly simple: 2/4 essays to align best with your schedule + 1 group presentation. Professor Bormann is very kind and caring to each student. Class topics and get a bit argumentative and dark as you discuss topics of genocide (Ex: Israel vs Palestine, Turkey vs Albania) though she allows you to step out of class if you need to.

Graded on 1 group presentation, 2/4 essays, and discussions (full credit just for attending). Very easy class and you do not need to go to every class nor does the class meet every block; attendance is only taken on discussion days. She is super nice and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Natalie is an amazing professor. She gives you the option of writing two papers out of five potential options for each unit of the course. I got a concussion before spring break and she gave me nearly an extra week to submit one of my papers. She is extremely caring and empathetic to her students. Her mindfulness sessions are very nice as well.

Professor Bormann is a good professor. Her grading criteria is clear and she's not a tough grader if you follow her instructions and understand the course material. If you aren't familiar with the subjects, she is a great professor, but if you're looking for something challenging, she can sometimes go too slow. I'd recommend.

Hands down the best professor I have had, by a long shot. The class had no exams, only papers, and relied on the interactivity of the class to function fluidly. This was made easy with the amount of interactive group work that was required. As someone who has taken many pols thought classes I highly recommend hers.

Shes really nice and great to talk to. However, I felt it was a waste of time and I didnt get much out of it. I felt I didnt learn much about the topic of genocide instead just discussed it. While she is super nice, the lectures were a complete waste of time and the class was poorly set up. Its easy to get a good grade but you may fall asleep.

There were a lot of wasted class days (e.g., 3 classes on student introductions, 4 as extra office hours, etc.). The lectures and readings are repeats of one another--there is also zero primary source material. Professor Bormann is not a tough grader at all and the feedback is minimally helpful. It's an easy course but it's also a quite boring one.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. You learn a lot from her and she helps you understand the material better than anybody. Extremely accesible, will help you with any questions or concerns and makes you feel comfortable. Lots of papers and a semi tough grader, however her feedback was extremely helpful and she was always extremely fair. All in all a great prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Boremann is phenomenal. She is a great lecturer and clearly very knowledgeable. Not only that but she is incredibly sweet and always willing to chat and help out her students. In this class the grade consisted of 2 papers, 1 small group presentation and a final project non of which were especially difficult. Very doable and interesting class

A super knowledgable and effective scholar and lecturer. She does at times push her own perspectives almost as facts to her students in class, but that doesn't mean she's close-minded. While she may disagree with you, Professor Bormann encourages and supports her students to have their own points of view.

Here's the thing about Dr. Bormann, if she has a TA you get an easy A, if she is grading the papers herself you will have to work hard for it. Although she is EXTREMELY knowledgeable on Holocaust content, she is very stubborn to allow student points of views and ideas to succeed in papers. Being too politically correct is also her visible weakness.

Prof. Bormann is super nice, and clearly knows a lot about political science, but her Modern Political Thought class was pretty surface. Would not recommend taking if you've taken social & political phil, it's mostly the same authors. If this class is required for you though, you can't go wrong with her.

Professor Bormann is extremely knowledgeable. The thing I like the most is that she understand you take other courses and thus gives you a reasonable amount of papers for you to complete. She is nice and if you work and understand the material you definitely can get an A

Lectures are never boring, her accent and sense of humor make it interesting. Papers are fairly easy, but she can be a kind of tough grader on them. She lets you be creative with the final assignment, so if you're not a big writer there are opportunities to boost your grade.

Great professor, very enthusiastic about the subject and good sense of humor. Class wasn't hard to go to ever. She knows what she's talking about and it doesn't hurt that the class was only 4 1000 word papers
Absolutely fantastic member of the PoliSci department. Love love loved her class.

Class grade  4 papers (each 1000 - 1200 words) worth 20%each of grade and 10% attendanceparticipation. No tests, no surprises, no busy work!  One extra credit (5pt value) assignment.  Great class and professor!
Overall great teacher! Always promotes a positive and engaging learning environment. Her accent is pretty awesome.
She is so great.  She leads an amazing discussion and her accent is fun.  She is very intelligent and really encourages thinking outside of the social norm.  Love her!
Great professor, super helpful, knows what she's teaching. Also, quite funny.
She is a really good professor. She takes time to help, and is always available when you need her. Make sure you hand your work in on time and you will be fine.

Dr. Nancy is great. She is super kind and approachable and wants you to succeed. The exams aren't cumulative which was super nice and she provided exam prep material and will review anything you want. Hw and lectures were super straightforward and she loves to tell stories and was very efficient with her lectures
She's a nice person, but I just don't get what she's teaching

Dr. Nancy is great! She is kind and understanding, for ex the whole class struggled with a hw problem, so she didn't include that stuff on the test. The tests are not cumulative, so there are 3 midterms - no final. The class is totally manageable and super interesting because she is clearly passionate about what she is teaching!

Dr. Nancy is really great at explaining concepts. She is super down to earth and easy to talk to. Go to class and take the practice exams and you will do fine in the class portion. The project portion is an added burden over the semester but is a great grade boost. I found the homework to be the hardest part of the class.

His class does not have much writing and no in-class essays, which I liked. But he does not really teach writing or give feedback on the many small assignments. He also does not post on Canvas, and nothing I've done has been graded yet. As an engineering major, I think the class is okay.
Grades off vibes, AVOID
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Noonan is awesome. I enjoyed his new way of teaching the course, a way that doesn't involve strict assignment-based grading. Show up to class and do the work on time for credit. The final project was also fun and unique.
I took this class while on co-op. A much bigger time commitment than I thought. The readings were geared more towards English majors.

Honestly I really liked Prof. Noonan! He was very easy to talk to and made the classroom environment very comfortable/friendly. The grading was very holistic and it was based a lot on individual effort put in. If you try your best and you show up to class consistently then you will get a good grade. Take Noonan! He may be strange but he is fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Noonan is a very nice man, his class environment is welcoming and encouraging. This was my favorite class and I recommend everyone to take this class. The class was not that hard but taught me valuable insights and was overall very fun.

I had him for Honors First Year Writing. He was unorthodox with his loose grading and conversational class. I enjoyed it and grew as a writer. He made the course relevant by presenting the concept of audience to us in the context of AI. Some assignments were worded vague. The final project was too involved for a required FYW class.

Fine professor - relatively easy grader as long as you put in effort. However, the class is excruciatingly boring and pointless. The assignments are a complete joke and you will learn nothing useful in Adv Writing Arts/Media/Design. Put in decent effort and you will get an A, but be prepared to roll your eyes every assignment.

Doesn't seem to realize that Advanced Writing in the Disciplines isn't necessarily a class for English majors. Assigned readings (of which there will be many) are dense pieces written by and for academics that wax poetic about "genre" while teaching nothing relevant about writing for your discipline.

Professor Noonan is the worst professor Ive ever had. His assignments are extremely open-ended, not in a good way. He does not give clear answers but instead writes in circles, never telling you what he wants. He only hosts office hours for 30 minutes and is so rude and condescending if you ask questions or challenge him. Avoid at at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: So disconnected from reality. Acts as though the assignments are open ended but will then harshly grade for going somewhere off of his 6 page prompt. No changing of the class layout for COVID. Snarky short comments on pieces don't help to improve your project for the next assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Doesn't teach during class. Assigns 10 paged papers a week before they're due. His assignment documents are 6 pages in length; you have to dig to just find the prompt. Gives no rubrics, no information on how you'll be graded (which assignments are worth more than others), and no course calendar. The only thing I've learned is to not take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's awesome!

Noonan is certainly a challenging professor. His "vagueness" is admittedly on purpose. The assignments are very broad, and his vagueness is an attempt to give the student the ability to choose how they take on the assignment. It is accurate that he tends to ramble, and feedback is sometimes lacking, but he makes it a point to ensure everyone learns
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: 1 Noonsky is the man 2 He definitely makes you work for it. There are three projects that are particularly long. It takes a while to write them but if you don't procrastinate, make a plan, and churn it out the grading isn't that harsh at all. Attendance is non-mandatory but participation helps your grade. 3 I AM a better writer after this class.

Professor Noonan was by far my worst professor at NEU. His weekly letters are so condescending and rude, its like they are his own personal vanity projects. His assignments have nothing to do with writing in the disciplines and his expectations are maddeningly vague. He leaves short, pompous comments on peoples work publicly that offer no help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: No respect for his students. Rude & condescending, he attacks students if they have questions. His weekly letters have no clarity, tend to ramble, and are very difficult to understand. He's another example of the disappointing NEU English department. It is nearly impossible to succeed in his class because of the lack of direction and rude feedback.

Horrible professor. AVOID at all cost. Was not clear on our assignments and definitely pointless course. Does not apply to business knowledge / further development. Students are majoring in business not reading or english or journalism.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Noonan was great. A gifted writer and experienced teacher. Really good at getting you to think in the right ways. Tough grader but his assignments are fun if you get into it.

Noonski is the man.  At first I was apprehensive about the course as I heard he wasn't very clear, but I learned to embrace it.  He's a fun guy to have teach a class and his dry sense of humor was pretty great too.  Be sure to talk to him in class during the workshops and discuss the direction of your project and you should be fine.

Difficult professor, definitely do not recommend. Assignments are pretty vague, poorly timed (day after Super Bowl), hard grader. Places a lot of emphasis on post-paper reflections rather than paper itself. Pretty pompous guy, doesn't really teach just has class break into small groups.
Very hard and confusing, I dont recommend him at all
Excellent professor.  Made a dreaded AWD class very enjoyable.  Don't be shy about playing around with him in your work either- he's open to wit and humor.

Advanced Writing in the Disciplines. Difficult Class. Super super nice guy! He wants you to work, he wants you to think. Don't be lazy and you'll do fine. Haven't gotten my final grade yet but I worked really hard on our first three big projects and got either A or A-. Sometimes frustrating at how much work was required but no regrets on keeping it

Out of four of my classes Noonan's class is the worst. He is not clear with the projects, he asks for way too many assignments and is never satisfied. I do not recommend any one to take his class it is a nightmare

Ridiculous amounts of work.A lot of all nighters devoted to him. Very unclear when you ask for help.Honestly gave this class my all and still ended up with a C.Transferred schools and asked him to write a recommendation thinking I demonstrated hard work, his response "do you really want me to write a recommendation? You didn't really do well" PRICK

He is a strict and hard professor. I got crazy for this course at the beginning. It was hard for me to catch uo with him. And also ,like most people said, he may not usually tell you what is good and what you should do etc. H e prefer to let you think by yourself more. I can felt that he had definitely helped me improve my ways of thinking.
Had him for college writing. I hated him at first because he is a difficult grader and requires a lot of work, but he is a great teacher. I learned a ton, and I put in the work to get a good grade.

Not a class for the lazy. I hated the hard work at first, but grew to really love and commit myself to the projects. The class is a student workshop, I hate seeing people get upset that he's not doing the work for you. It's college. Grow up and put a little effort/thought into your work. Great Guy, always available for help/questions.

When he talks about the course matter, he's very ambiguous with words! Will never tell you straightforward what to do and what Not to do, juggles a lot with words and mostly bs-ing!! Attendance is "Extremely Mandatory" in this class and even though it's 10% of the grade he won't stop at failing you for that. Horrible Teacher, HIGHLY UNRECOMMENDED!!

Took the class a year back. Definitely worked for my grade. My writing improved drastically thanks to his class. Not for the lazy by any means. He genuinely wants students writing to get better. You just have to think outside the box for his assignments. Don't be afraid to experiment. I did not pay for NEU to watch monster movies in an Eng. class.
One of my favorite teachers. Noonan's class is hard, but he's always willing to help you as much as you need. And trust me, you will use the tools you learn in his class in real life.
Extraordinary amounts of work. Yes, practice makes perfect but this is way beyond the limit.
Professor Noonan is a great teacher- I took his AWD class which I was hestitant about taking, but he turned out to be a great professor, and the class was fun!

I love Noonan!!  I was so nervous about being in his class but we only have class 2 out of the 3 days we're supposed to and he usually lets us leave way early.  He's super nice and really wants to help you do well and explore your major and interests.  Awesome professor.

Amazing teacher! This classes really helped me define which area of my discipline I want to pursue. The class is a lot of work, but it's worth it in the end - TRUST ME. He's a really cool guy who's approachable and friendly. If your work ethic meets his expectations, you'll have no problem. The reviews before this are misleading, don't listen.

I had this guy a couple years back..at the time I thought life couldn't get any harder with his ridiculous papers but in all honesty I have used those papers since, for jobs and for transferring schools. Mr. Noonan is deff. a different style of teaching but I loved it.... Put in effort and he is the man and it will reflect in your grade! I miss him

Despite the class being hard as balls, he is the absolute man! and I love his bow ties and he is classy for not wearing a clip on, he ties that sh*t everytime he wears it. Keep it up Mr. Noonan, dont listen to the other D-Bags on this list.

this guys pretty much the hardest teacher I've ever worked with, and I'll tell you why: he's not teacher material. He knows his stuff, no doubt, but he's not committed to helping students, and not understanding of their occasional difficulties. He asks a lot from students in a short amount of time. And the whispering-while-talking thing. not cool

This class was so aggravating... He assigns a bunch of work that is supposed to help you but he doesn't check them or give credit. The work is tedious and he assigns huge essays. He tries to make it creative but he just makes things more difficult. I love English but he's the type of English teacher you don't want.

for an freshmen english teacher, he's is one of the hardest. with that being said, he is also one of the best. his style of teaching is very different compared to the rest of the teachers you will ever encounter. the work is hard, but its college.  as long as you ask for help and use his advice and don't wait til last minute you'll be fine.

All of these comments make it seem that it is Noonan's teaching that makes the class difficult. Yes the papers are hard, but not impossible. If you do what I did and work hard, while involving him in the writing process, you will do well. He makes time for all of his students and will help if asked. Just don't leave your work until the last minute!

you know hes really not as bad as all these comments make him out to be. its clear that he must have read this at some point because he didnt wear a SINGLE bow tie all semester, although there are some excruciatingly bright shirts for 8am. as long as you take all suggestions he makes about your paper and write about how they were genius, youre good

To get a good grade: 1: let him feel that he is soo smart at all times. 2: ask for his help a lot (office hours etc..) even though he won't do anything. 3. WRITE AS MUCH AS YOU CAN! number of pages mean the world to this dude.. for example if he want's 8 pages write at least 12!! if you want to get over a C of course!

he is not very helpull, if ur in is class, leave!!!!!!!!!, he is very very very hard and if you are an engineer you should never even think of taking this class with him, he never tells you what your supposed to do you go to class or you dont you still wont understand what the hell is going on, essays 8pg min and for some 15pg min, he is the worst.
DONT take this class. He is a nice guy, but teaching wise, he SUCKS. He will not help you on his essays, just give you bad grades, and explain afterwards why the paper sucks.
NEVER AGAIN!! its simple, DONT TAKE HIM!

NO NO NO NO!! if you want to have the worst experiance take him! i was so stupid not to have listened to this webstie in the begining! i seriously regret it. dont put yourself through his class if you dont have to!
Do not take his classes! Horrible, lots of work. Useless classes, you will have to write about philosophy... and not really learn how to read and write.

Please take my word seriously. If you are in his class, get out as soon as possible.  If it's too late, here are some advice.  Write much more than you should (if you want to get an A).  ex: If it's 8 page due, write 14+.  Next, KISS HIS ASS as much as possible.  Show him that you admire him and always ask for  help even though he gives you none.
Great professor. Work is extremely time-consuming and longer than most other classes, but truly pays. Get ready to write, but the writing is creative and fun.

i have never worked so hard in one class in my entire life. the grades you receive feel like they are lower than should have received. he is a really nice guy with a sense of humor.  I highly suggest getting out of this class if you can. way too much work for one class. way too hard. i was ALWAYS working on writing this semester. not fun.

Terrible, I have never seen in my live so much incompetence. Never and I repeat never have a class with him. He is insane. One essay need at least 20 hours work and you should do at least five of them in a semester. I'm writing  an encyclopedia of stupid things and this is a problem during busy weeks with really iportant subject.
hell no.....dont even set ur self up for failure!!!!!

Actually, a great teacher I though. Really pushes you. No bull sh*t type of guy, if you're not bright, he will let know, which is refreshing. If you see him during Office hours, he helps a lot. Bottom, if your intelligent and motivated . . .easy A, no problem. I'm a business major and I got an A.
AHHHH KELLY CLARKSON
what are you guys talking about? he is definately the best teacher ever!i mean come on, he cnat be that bad.....wow, thats a lie, he is the worst ever, i could brely control myself.

got a c- on the last paper, don't even think he read it. gives us 3 days to write 15 page papers while other classes are watching zombie movies and writing 3 page papers on them that they have a week to do, and yeah he does wear bow-ties.
In one word, no.

the guys loves assigning absurd amounts of work.  if you are scheduled for this class..switch out NOW. ive never had more work that doesnt make any sense. The worst part is even when you write a 30 page paper he doesnt even really grade it...just arbitrarily gives you anything under an A..and by the way bowties went out of style a LONG time ago
Too much rediculous work. Get out while you still can...and take off the damn bow tie.

He is definately the worst teacher ever, he doesnt care about you at all, or how much work he gives you.  he is an idiot who only cares about getting his point across and making himself look good. get out of taking his class if at all possible, again, he is the worst professor ever, and the bow ties are a freaking ratarded
noonan is insane, pretty much the worst prof ever. does not care about work load or clarity on when things are assigned/due.

way too much work for engineers who dont care about writing in depth stories on what other people think they are trying to write baout.  I mena, teach me to write a lab report, not a freaking life story, dam those long papers
his ego is out of control. he thinks he's The Man but he's a pup.

DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS!!! I took it regardless of these ratings and it was terrible. He isn't knowledgeable and has a huge ego. He's also a terrible teacher and tries to make his office hours at times when noone will come. He also has no idea what he's teaching. Waste of time, didn't learn anything and hated him.

He is a challenging professor and expected more from my class than the other College Writing professors, but I'm glad I took his class because he pushed me and anyone who cares about developing their writing skills and being challenged should take him.
No Comments

He may be good in other classes, but DO NOT take him for Middler Year. He demands way more than any of the other profs & doesn't provide any concrete suggestions. I never knew what he wanted from me even after talking to him. Save yourself alot of stress and don't take this class with him.

dont ever take him for middler writing! middler writing is stressful as is and he doesnt make it any easier or less stressful or more helpful. he critiques without legitimate suggestions. very vague with his responses. huge power trip. dont take any class with him.

One of the best prof. I have ever had. He pushes you and holds you to a higher standard and good students appreciate that. The people who I have heard say negative things about his teaching style are, to put it mildly, not very bright. If you work hard, there is no reason to not get an A.
He sucks balls. please do not take him. you have been advised.

This dude is horrible

Here's the ironic part. Class only met for 1-2 days a week on average out of 3.  Most classes were only 15-25 minutes long.  On the other hand, I did more work for this class than my others combined. Prof. Noonan was a lot of help during class. The course structure was presented well.
hes the man and hes so hot as balls

I had Noonan my freshman year and he was the hardest teacher I have EVER had, I learned so much from him, I would probably be a different person than I am today with out his constant pushing. Thanks Mr. Noonan!
He's so ****ing hot, and he is the bomb. Meet him in office hours and he is so nice, like Jeckyl and Hyde.

I thought he was a great professor.  He's very professional. He was very helpful, if you are the type of person who gets your work done, he'll be the best prof.  If you are a slacker you'll hate him.  He's always willing to help, but doesn't like excuses.

Well, to be honest with you guys you really work over time for this class and you dont get the grades you deserve. Other freshmens dont have to work half as hard as us! they say he is the hardest professor! and i do agree.

NEGATIVE! this professor licks nuts! honestly you write over 100pages in this course. Other students get to write 5-7page essays, while this professor desires 14-16! DONT TAKE THIS GUY!
great guy, somewhat hard work but cares for his students

I took his class 2 yrs ago, but i don't get why some ppl don't like him. He's def. a professional teacher who answers any Qs very coherently and I enjoyed being there..Top it off..he's one of the HOTTIEST prof. on campus!

he is an ****! trust me!
Dont take this professor! Trust me! he is horrible!!!

Freshmen Class! Trust me do not take this professor. I write fairly well but he is a dick! Dont take this professor he makes the class much harder than others. He is Boring, and never gives "A"s. In general he sucks!

He is a really tough grader and the writing topics are ridiculous, and hard to get interested in. He's also a dick. Try to switch teachers if you get him, otherwise you're semester will suck writing 7 page papers in a style you will never use again.
He tries...but the assignments are all very hard. He is a tough grader too.
Terrible teacher. makes it so hard. does not do anything in class. Took eng2 with him. bad grader too...
Good guy, relates well with the students.
