He is a very lenient grader and understanding in general. The homework's have multiple attempts and he often pushes back quizzes. Although he is highly educated in accounting, he talks very fast and lectures could be boring/hard to follow. Taught myself most of the material but he is always open to help.
I hated this class, too much work, and teacher had favorites.

BUSN1101 is a lot more work than anyone realized going in, and it is a group project with the same group the whole semester. Sven is a really cool professor, but the class as a whole takes a lot more time and effort than an 1101 course should have. If you get a bad group your just kinda screwed. I probably would not take this class take another one

Sven Olsen is an amazing professor. With a Northeastern accounting degree and real-world experience, he makes even hard material easy. Everyone I know in other sections says the class is difficult, but everyone with Sven finds it manageable and fair. He truly cares—best professor at NU, absolutely take him.

Grading was super subjective; no clear rubric or guide for any assignments. (BUSN1101 is not even a mandatory class; feel free to take another class to fulfill and NU Path Diversity requirement.) Olson was biased in terms of grading. Grade depended a lot on how your teammates graded you. The course lowers your GPA, and it is a huge time commitment
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: ACCT1201- I don't see why he has such low ratings; he is a very good professor for accounting. Although he can be hard to follow when going through the slides, all you have to do is ask. He is cool and flexible, never be afraid to ask him for something. My only and biggest complaint is the homework, it is very long, but willing to give extensions.

Need to read and understand textbook before every class to even follow along to what he's saying. Required to participate if you want to get any value from him. HW is long as hell too. He skips around the presentations a lot, talks fast, but is extremely knowledgeable and understanding, maybe a little too knowledgeable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Olsen was by far my favorite during my MBA. His real-world experience set him apart from the other professors at Northeastern. Listen to what he has to say and you'll take quite a bit from his classes
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I was less than 0.05 away from a B+ and he did not round up my grade, but he grounded up someone from a B to an A. Do not take him if you want fair and equal grading.

The class did help me with learning aspects of business through a project. I think Sven himself was very unorganized and impossible to reach. I spent weeks trying to reach him about fixing grades or posting things on canvas and he would never respond or say "shoot me an email". His grading is harsh so it is hard to get an a. Take his wife's class.

Sven is a tough grader, but the amount I learned made it completely worth it. He's very knowledgeable about the business world, and if you pay attention and put effort into his class, you'll benefit. Make sure to use strong outside references in assignments. While it was my most time-consuming class, it was also the most rewarding at Northeastern.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Sven is a very knowledgable business man and I learned a lot in his class. However he is a harsh grader, canvas is unorganized, and hard to reach outside class. The group project aspect and the disorganization added unnecessary stress. I don't think that this is all Sven's fault I think a large part of it is the course itself. I don't recommend.

Sven is a cool guy but not the best prof. He doesn't give clear grading guidelines and gives out lots of Bs. His canvas is also rlly disorganized and he never grades stuff. But, if you ask questions and show overkill effort you can do well. Material isn't hard just a lot of busy work, and he can be a harsh grader. It was an ok class for me tbh.

I took him for accounting 1201 and he my favorite professor I've had. If you ask him questions and participate you will do well in his his class. He does make his quizzes and tests very hard, but usually curves. You need to build a relationship with him to do well, but he's really funny and kind when you do.

So many people get caught up in Sven's tough grading and harsh feedback that they fail to see how much they are actually learning. Sven makes it so clear that he would rather you learn everything and get and B than to learn nothing and get an A.I learned the most in his class than any other at Northeastern so far. He is also an amazing businessman.

For ACCT1201: Was his first time teaching accounting and he was given the class a matter of hours before the first lecture, so for the circumstances Sven was not bad. He runs his own business and is very knowledgeable about accounting but he understandably was not great at teaching it yet. Can self-teach yourself with the textbook.

AACT1201Not sure why some people rated him so low. He is knowledgeable in accounting and cares about his students. He emphasizes that he is always available if you need help or are stuck. He does a lot of slide reading during class but if you pay attention it's fine. He also assigns a decent project that is pretty impossible to do badly on.

Having a relationship outside of class is crucial. He is flexible as long as you communicate beforehand.He prepares you for the real world unlike any other professor. The negative reviews are just students who didn't put ample work into the final project. Start your pitchbook early. Make sure you back everything up with sources and you'll be fine.

Honestly, such a bad professor. he is a cool guy outside of teaching, but he grades so difficultly, and if you follow guidelines you get an 85. his canvas is disorganized and will post huge deadlines the night before and will expect you to get It done.  i didn't believe the rating until I took the class. AVOID
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Took him in the fall, he's nice and class is interesting, but his canvas is disorganized and he's sometimes hard to reach outside of class. Also tough grader, but if you put effort into assignments you won't get lower than a B+.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Just brutal...

Sven was a great professor. I wish I would have gonna meet with the peer mentors more because they gave good feedback. His Canvas is disorganized and he does not really understand his assignments, but just makes sure to use a ton of sources and you'll be fine. Read the readings really carefully and you do okay on the quizzes they are all useless.

Sven is passionate about entrepreneurship and cares for his students. be prepared to meet with your project group a lot outside of class. There are pop quizzes with really specific questions which made it hard for me to do well even if I did the readings. Canvas dates can sometimes be disorganized or posted at late notice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Honestly, Sven gets such a bad rep, he's not a bad professor at all. Sven himself is a very funny guy who seems involved with his students as well as knowledgeable about the business world. Downside is he is a tough grader, so cite sources often! This entire class is very presentation heavy, so be ready to do tons of public speaking.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I do not quite understand why many of Sven's reviews to be negative. His course places a heavy emphasis on Entrepreneurship from a top down view, touching upon all aspects of the core makeup of a business - It was pivotal for me and steered me towards building my own venture successfully. Take him if you are genuinely interested in business.

A lot of busy work and his grading did not make sense. Would not recommend taking his class as a professor, he is all over the place and his grading is not clear at all. He is kind and funny, but don't take him if you want to know peace!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had! DO NOT take his classes unless absolutely necessary. He provides no clear guidelines, grades unfairly, and expects you to write a could be 100-page final project. Grades your writing tougher than College level English classes. He is not responsive and not flexible. If you have an emergency, forget about your grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Developing a relationship with him outside of class can greatly benefit you in terms of both his attitude towards you and his grading.
No clear grade standards, useless instruction, late feedback. DON'T TAKE HIS CLASS!!!!!!
Terrible management of canvas along with very poor instructions for assignments.

Grades everything at the latest instant possible - had a 97 in the course and grade was dropped to a 92 during the last days before grades were due. Grading was arbitrary and based on opinion. Don't understand how you can incorrectly grade a response that was based on a factual documentary video. Spend the entire semester presenting every 2 weeks

- Tough grader
- Cannot explain business concepts well 
- Strict when it comes to attendance and participation
- Really bad at giving feedback
- Nonexistent office hours
- Does not respond to emails
- No one gets an A in his class

Conclusion: Don't take him for BUSN 1101, you'll regret it for the rest of you life...

Mr. Olsen was caring and friendly. He actually got to know his students and wanted to make sure that they were doing the best they could. He stood out in the fact that he was the one who would reach out to make sure the student was ok. Although he isn't the easiest grader,  The workload is manageable, and there is a lot of extra help if needed.
Skip once, and you cant get an A for participation. This professor is really bad avoid avoid , brongs random people into class. Very weird

DOES NOT RESPOND TO EMAILS, AWFUL PROFESSOR, NO CLEAR GRADING CRITERIA, BRINGS PEOPLE TO HIS CLASS AND VERY UNPROFESSIONAL, CHILL GUY BUT VERY UNORGANIZED, INACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE OF CLASS. INCONSIDERATE! CALLS  YOU OUT AVOIDDD AVOOID AVOIDD. YOUVE BEEN WARNED..

Please do not take him. I seriously regretted taking his course as he gives you too many work for an unimportant course. I would recommend not taking this course altogether even if you are a busn 1101 major as it is not a core requirement and the things you learn are taught in the other core requirements. Overall, seriously awful professor, AVOIDDD

DO NOT TAKE HIM, I AM SO SERIOUS ABOUT THIS. HE IS NEVER CLEAR ABOUT GRADING CRITERIA, ALWAYS GOES ON A TEANGENT IN CLASS. NEVER STAYS ON TOPIC AND OVERALL A TOUGH GRADER FOR NO REASON. WANTS YOU TO DO OUTSIDE RESEARCH ON 2 MIN ASSIGNMENT OR YOU'LL GET A B. EVERYONE STRUGGLED IN MY SECTION. I REPEAT, DO NOT TAKE HIM.

Homework & readings are meant to help with understanding of the content we are learning and are not quizzed on. Primarily conversation-based class, conversations often based around business-related current events! Professor gives incredible feedback, is understanding, and gives adequate time to complete assignments and the group project.
Great professor and very engaging!

tests are very vague and he often didn't seem to understand why one answer works better than other himself. he did give lots of partial credit though. didn't really teach the slides (which he didn't make), just chatted. i'd say if you want a chill class with a funny guy, take him. but if you want to learn a lot about marketing take someone else.

Pathetic experience, totally inaccessible outside of class, does not reply to emails, no feedback at all, no interest in students' growth during a course, doesn't teach, tests are online but tough, unorganised.

Sven is an OK professor when it comes to Marketing. Has his own business which is cool, however, he often rambles about it and forgets that he's supposed to be teaching us. The course shell is not his so sometimes he is confused as to what he's teaching. Exams are all online but still difficult.

Tests are hard but lots of partial credit is given (talk to him for points back) Not a lot of feedback. Great guy but content is taught by a conversational discussion and some slides with simple definitions. If you're not into marketing it is great, but if you're highly interested maybe take a more interactive professor to get something out of it.
he takes no interest in a student's performance. not at all approachable outside class for doubts. tough grader and does not respond to emails. do not take his class if you get the chance
Professor Olson is a great person and has a lot of knowledge about the business world. However, he is a really tough grader, and I don't think anyone got an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Horrible professor. Doesn't put in any grades until the end of the semester and gives no explanation at all for any grading. Would recommend taking another professor for this class if you care about business at all.
Overall good experience. He owns his own company and referenced that a lot, which was very cool in my opinion. The only thing is that the feedback could be a bit better and more consistent.
Tough grader and gives little to no feedback. I had him for an intro class, intro to business, and I don't think anyone got an A. Also takes a long time to respond to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Olson is a great teacher. He is enthusiastic about what he is teaching so the lectures are more like interesting conversations than anything else. As long as you do the readings and homework he assigns before classes, you will be in good shape. He cares about his students and tries to engage with everyone! Take him, you won't be sorry.

I took this class because I needed it for an NUPATH course elective, and I thought it was just a silly class, but NO. I learned a lot about managing stress, some cool yoga moves, and managed to REACH ENLIGHTENMENT (somewhat). Tako is an amazing instructor/professor and he's super chilllll.
AMAZING, HE combines mindfulness and Yoga so well, assignments are manageable

Tako is amazing!!! He is so sweet and cares about each individual in the class. We got to learn yogic history and also practice the movements. He is a super easy grader and genuinely wants you to grow and succeed.

Tako is great! He's caring, understanding, and super chill! His yoga tradition class is synchronous on Zoom and includes some out-of-class work. We learned about yoga's history, religion, and weekly practices. He gives SO much extra credit and is a very easy grader. All quizzes are open note or in a group-created yoga sequence.
Such an amazing professor, and looks out for you and cares for you as a person as well.
Tako is an amazing professor! He is considerate and kind, and the class was very interesting. I would highly recommend!
Mad chill. His Managerial Accounting was much better and improved than his Financial. Tests are easy if you study, very similar to his handouts.

This professor was nice, but his tests were harder than the practice, be ready to practice a lot and to teach yourself because that's what you will be doing. The homework's were not helpful, but easy A. Hope to get a good group for the group project or else you won't do well.

This professor was very sweet and approachable, but where things fell short was when it was time for the midterms. The handouts were very clearly written and made sense. I just wish the same could be said about the exams; they were worded very confusingly. The McGraw-Hill homework wasn't helpful at all. It was honestly a pain to do every week.

Slides, Handouts, Quizzes, Homework, and Tests were all well done. If this were a rate my course, it would be a 5. However, be prepared to be called out in class when he thinks he can make a joke out of you. About 80% of the things he says in class to try to be funny are unnecessary, disrespectful, and overall awkward. Def potential to be better.

Extremely nice professor. His lectures are just reading off the slides so it may not be everyone's style. Required to buy Mcgraw Hill Connect for ~$100, but the questions on them for HW aren't very helpful. Handouts he gives are extremely similar to the exams. Repeatedly doing those question will help you ace exams.

The professor just moved to America and taught ACCT for the first time, but did very well. Accessible outside of class and cared about the students. However, classes were mainly just reading off the slides with not a lot of proper explaining.

Very kind and approachable professor who clearly cares about students. The course is lecture-heavy and business/accounting just wasn't for me, so I withdrew late. If you stay on top of notes, attend class, and care for the somewhat care for the subject, you'll be fine. McGraw Hill is required and costs around $100.

If you pay attention and complete the handouts, you'll do great. The handouts are extremely extremely helpful. Fully understanding them WILL help you ace all exams. He just moved to America this semester and takes the bus to campus daily. He really deserves no hate. He's kind, respectful, and a great professor if you get to know him.

Had the privilege of being in Solomon's accounting class as a freshman. I will say he is a very sweet man, but his lectures make no sense. He reads off slides. He gives exam prep questions but the exams are entirely different. Sometimes difficult to understand through accent. Make sure to do good on your randomly assigned group project.
Lectures are very informative, class work and assignments are not hard. McGrawhill needed. Classwork and quizzes are easy, midterms and finals are fair if you studied.
She is really nice, the class is not too hard and I spent most of my time on the labs. The lectures got a little boring sometimes but she explained the topics clearly and was overall great.

GO TO CLASS! thats really all you need to do well in this class, attendance really really matters. Find a good group for lab and the final project and you will be set. The labs are really intense first few weeks and then it gets so chill. One big homework assignment a week that takes about an hr. Exams are not bad, she always gives a study guide.
good amount of work specially the labs, but for the most part very chill class.

Lab once a week(find a good group). Very clear on what to study for test/quizzes. HW once a week about an hour. Super nice, lots of easy participation grades. YOU HAVE TO GO TO CLASS. its a nice easy class to start the day and honestly pretty fun. lots of real life applications, and physical results that make you feel accomplished.

Professor Ondemir is Great! Her lectures are really helpful for leaning and really keep you engaged during class time. The homework and labs are also very helpful for leaning and prepare you well for the exams, which are not too bad in themselves. Would highly recommend this class.

Genuinely the sweetest professor I have ever had. Attendance is part of grade but skipping from time to time won't hurt your grade at all. Study guides are just like the tests, lectures are easy to understand, and studying is barely needed if you use lecture time correctly. Overall the blueprint for a perfect professor who wants you to succeed.

A very good professor,who has videos of lectures and who is not required to mandatory attend and will even give you examples to practice before the exam,too bad she's not in or's electives or I would have kept taking them

She is the best!!!!!!!! The most genuine and caring engineering prof by FAR. If you ever need help outside class, she is always available and excited to help. She is understanding of any issues you may have with submitting assignments on time and will allow for extensions even for the whole class. Her slides are so thorough, makes the content easy
Excellent Professor!
She is a great professor and this class is very easy and interesting! She prepares you very well for the labs/homeworks/tests, and there are lots of opportunities for extra credit.
He is THE guy you want to take a class with. Great slides, clear expectations, and will crack a good joke every once in a while. Fantastic prof, and I wish I could take more classes with him!

Very lecture heavy. Although he does post slides, you do miss out by not showing up to class. He gives a lot of opportunities to ask questions or comment so come prepared with the reading to participate. Not too harsh of a grader if you follow all the instructions. Very passionate in his work and inspiring. Highly recommend taking his class.

He's really funny, and a super intelligent person. He knows what he's talking about so he talks a lot but you learn so much. Not test or quiz. You have to do a debate, 3 papers, a presentation and a group discussion. Just start writing ahead of time because the first paper takes a lot of work. He is also always available.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a pretty straight forward guy, lectures can be a bit boring at times but as long as you look through the content of the Powerpoint before a test you're good to go. Group assignments aren't graded too harshly, but be prepared to be put on the spot with tough questions from him. Just show up to class and give him respect and you're good.

3 quiz (lowest drop), 2 midterm, 1 final, 3 part group project, HW every sunday but easy & multiple tries. Attendance matters. Sweet professor — explains well, cares abt students, helpful. Quiz/midterm are straightforward just study. Gives good study material. A is achievable w/ decent effort but i messed up on a midterm so i got A-. Take her!!

Professor O'Kelly is extremely passionate about what she teaches and cares for her students, I loved the class towards the beginning of the semester, but the pace of the class became much faster when we got to more complex concepts...There's hw due every Sunday night, and there are quizzes in between midterms (she drops the lowest quiz)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Peggy is really kind and shows a lot of care for her students. Her explanations always break things down in really simple ways that are easy to understand. This was easily my favorite class this semester despite it being an 8 am. The 8 am part is kinda rough, but honestly I think if there is a professor worth taking that early it's definitely her.

I would die for her, quizzes are more exam "quizzam" as she calls em but like super fair where nothing is blindside but you should def know if you paid attention. Textbook lowkey doesn't matter if you can follow lectures and in class assignments. Show up only on lectures and solid 60 guarantee on any quiz TwT.

Don't take Acct 1209 asynch in a half summer class if you plan on doing anything else during those months. Condensing this regular class into 2x speed and offering it online seems nice in theory, however by the detailed math nature of the class, in-class Q/A time and days to study/learn the concepts is just missed in this format : (
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lectures go by really slow and makes concepts harder than they are. Doesn't curve anything but will drop your lowest quiz score (only 4). Read the textbook and pray that's enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Prof. Peggy! The class itself is difficult (content-heavy and fast-paced), and my top recommendation is that you read the textbook before class lectures. Do practice problems as much as possible; that'll help most with quizzes and exams. Peggy is so sweet and extremely helpful with answering questions. Difficult class, but great professor!

Well-spoken, knowledgeable teacher who cares about her students and will take the requisite time to explain things personally. Lots of office hours, TA office hours, and stays after class. I found reading the chapter before class very helpful but I know a lot of people who didn't and still did well in the class. Would take again.

Professor O'Kelly's ACC1201 class is challenging but rewarding. She holds you accountable, but provides great resources. I found unstuck study really helpful for exam prep. Overall, a tough but worthwhile class.

Peggy O'Kelly was easily one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. She is understanding of students' outside circumstances and makes herself easily available for help. The content of the course is difficult but she clearly outlines expectations and ways to succeed in her class. She genuinely wants her students to succeed.
Peggy is a great accounting teacher. FR2 is a pretty heavy course, but the exams/quizzes are easy if you can work through in class examples and the homework.

peggy was undoubtedly the best professor i've had at NU. im not math/finance-savvy but peggy held my hand and worked with me privately to make sure i succeeded as best i could. she is extremely supportive+a good prof. if you miss a lecture, you will fall behind. take good notes, and study the worksheets given in class bc its identical to the tests
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: FR2 is just hard. She's a great teacher and was very clear for what you need to know for the test. The class is very tough as it is the final acct class but it is rewarding to finish with her. The Project, Participation and HW grade act as a curve for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is really kind and she cares a lot about her students, however she's not a great teacher but her slides are good. The quizzes are really hard and long, so were the midterm and the final but there's a big curve.

Took her for 1201. there are 3 quizzes + 1 midterm + 1 final. ALL of that with homework due every Sunday and a 2 part group project. On top - attendance is marked and class participation matters. All exams are in person. She is a good teacher if you can keep up . You will miss homework at least one with no chances regrade.

Professor O'Kelly was the lecturer (not facilitator) for my online accounting class and was really sweet. I wish she was the facilitator (Annie Witte) as she was pretty brutal/condescending/would almost go out of her way to not help.
I failed ACCT 1201 the first time I took it, I got an A with Prof O'Kelly and it didn't even feel like trying. Amazing. 5 stars.

Lowkey a harder professor, but the best one you will receive. You need to know the information taught in the class for future classes. She also won't let you slack off so be prepared for her class. Class is curved a little bit and extra credit is offered.
Great teacher but the class was pretty difficult. She gives you a lot of resources to study and makes efficient use of class time.

ALOT of individual work, but I'm usually fine with that. However, she doesn't reall prepare you for the tests because they are always questioned weirdly, when you studied your ass off for them. She a nice person, but she talks rlly slow in class so context seems 1000x harder. I def think she could've prepared us alot better with practice questions.

Professor O'Kelly was a very good teacher and offers a lot of outside help. The class material is difficult and it is not a easy class, but it is explained well and there is lots of materials provided to help.

Professor O'Kelly was kind and caring. I left the class feeling like I learned a lot. She taught the material we needed for the exams, and didn't make us memorize ratios/ parts of the course we didn't need to know

There are many assignments and a lot of midterms and quizzes. She gives you the opportunity to receive good grades, but mainly if you study on your own and independently learn the topic. Her in class lectures are sometimes very brief and confusing. Overall amazing teacher and very patient. Goes out of her way to help a student if they need it.

There's a reason why there are so many great reviews of her. If I could have taken her for every single accounting class, I would've. I've never understood material the way I did when I took her class. Love her!!

I don't think I would have passed with any other professor. She is an extremely caring person and truly puts effort into every student. Her classes are a positive environment, and she will always be available to help you. She turned a relatively difficult class into a great learning experience. Love you peggy

peggy is so so sweet!! she is an amazing lecturer and explains complicated concepts super well. she is available outside of class to help and explain in depth. she held extra office hours before each exam. the material and tests are hard but fair and there is a participation grade too. no graded hw, but def do it for practice! 12/10 recommend!!

i love peggy!! she was so sweet and absolutely amazing at explaining concepts when we were confused. every class, she'd take the time to check in with almost every student as while we were doing the in-class problems. i genuinely learned so much. she had her funny moments too, a queen

Truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She's very responsive to her emails, and makes it a point to ensure the whole class knows both her and the TAs have office hours. She happily takes time to respond to any questions in class. Very organized. Homework is due weekly, and is through the texbook. Absolutely loved her!!
Very understanding and knowledgeable teacher. Grading standards are clear, and preparation for exams is done really well. One of my favorite accounting professors hands down.

Professor O'Kelly's class was so enjoyable and informative. She has a ton of experience in accounting and it definitely shows through her lectures. She is a sweet, caring woman that really wants to see her students succeed and will take the time to make sure that students really understand important concepts in the course, truly a great professor

She is such a great professor. She inspired me to add a concentration in accounting to my major. She is so understanding and really wants to see her students succeed. She loves participation and fosters a safe talking environment.

Professor Peggy cares about her students. I personally dislike accounting, but having her didn't make it worse. I'd recommend. Accessible outside of class. When we were remote, our homework was due at 11:59PM on Saturday, thus not promoting a healthy school/life balance, which I really didn't appreciate. Other than that, only good things to say!

Great teacher. Really brings up the value of our school. Responds to emails quickly, understanding of different situations, and truly cares about her students. 1 homework assignment a week in two parts, but really helps learn and is just like the quizzes and midterms. Love her! If you want a good environment to learn online and in person, she's it!

Peggy is amazing. You have to buy a classpack which has all the slides and is way better than the textbook. Homework is very manageable. Only one group project, which isn't too hard. Lectures are very helpful and she will remember your name and answer your questions. Must take!

I currently have professor Kelly and she's honestly one of the sweetest teachers I've met. You can tell she really cares about both her job and the students. The class itself also isn't hard. As long as you follow the lectures, do the worksheets that we do in class anyway, and the required homework assignments, you should be able to get a good grad
I really enjoyed taking the class with Peggy. I find her to be very inspirational and a great teacher! She has made me want to pursue accounting!

I had professor O'Kelly for Financial Accounting and she was amazing. Accounting can be difficult to learn for the first time and she does a great job communicating complex topics and making sure you are prepared for the exams. You have to work for an A, but it's definitely possible if you show up and do the work
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Don't take her class. Tough grader.

She puts up videos and her TA's are amazing they reply instantly. It's a good introductory course to fin acct. I suggest taking it online as it pushes you to actually learn but at the same time have the confidence of support from your TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Peggy is very caring and accommodating with her office hours. She even offers extra help if you are willing to learn. I took 2 courses with her and absolutely she wants her students to succeed and offers her best! Thank You Professor Peggy!

The tests in the class are difficult. Results aren't great, but I understood the material. Never really had to use the textbook because everything outside of the textbook could be used and were more helpful. Prof and TAs weren't very helpful. I recommend taking another prof.

Financial accounting is the most difficult class I've had at Northeastern, but I'm glad I took it with Peggy O'Kelly. She's an excellent teacher who makes you appreciate the topic, helps you learn, extends generous office hours, and offers lots of material to study from. Still, don't expect accounting to be easy, even with a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor O'Kelly is the best professor I have had at Northeastern thus far! She is very articulate and clear in her lectures, and makes it a point to solidify our understanding with worksheets in class and Connect homework outside of class. She is helpful with office hours and she's extremely nice. Her tests and grading is fair!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was a great professor. She knew what she was doing and explained things well and really wants you to pass. She gives you a lot of optional things to practice with which is really helpful for the final. Her class is top notch.
It was a fairly easy class but not taking anything away from the professor. was recommended by a friend am glad i took her class. explains well and comes prepared.

Best professor I've had at NU. Take her class! She teaches in a way that makes the material so much more understandable than it is in the textbook. Go to her office hours and homework help sessions if you are struggling and she will focus on the areas that you are struggling with. Focus on her class problems to do well on tests.

Peggy is the best accounting teacher there is! She really knows the information inside out and is extremely helpful. All the accounting sections learn the same thing and have the same types of quizzestests, but there is no question that she teaches the material the best. She is the most professional teacher I've ever had! Definitely recommend!

Accounting shouldn't be taken online, and Professor O'Kelly herself seems very uncomfortable with the format. That said, it's laid out fairly well, with reminders for all the homework that needs to be completed, etc etc. Her lectures don't fully cover the homework you are expected to complete, and you have to do online research on your own to do it
She's an amazing accounting teacher! Loved her class. Takes things step by step and gives examples to follow each lecture.
Professor O'Kelly has a great teaching style! I felt like I was learning the material well in class and then having that knowledge reinforced by the online work was really helpful.
quiz and exam are hard

She's absolutely wonderful! Explains things clearly and her in-class lectures and exercises are so helpful. She doesn't put anything surprising on her tests and quizzes. If you put forth the effort you should do pretty well.
Best professor I have had at Northeastern. Her classes are interesting and easy to sit through. You have to take accounting you should absolutely take it with her.
Best professor in acct department. Very clear and helpful. Three exams and four quizs (drop the lowest one probably). Just come to class and do the hw problems you should be fine.
she is a charming person and a very helpful professor
She is a good techer, her explanations are clear, I don't even need to use a textbook! I like this class, it is realtively easy for me

One of the best teachers I have ever had I would recommend her to anyone! she is so clear in the way that she teaches and breaks the class up between problem sets and lecture. She really cares about her students understanding the material. I never used the textbook and still got an A. She's the best!!

She is a good teacher, but you have to try in the class. There are online homeworks and online quizzes every week, which wasn't that bad. The midterm and final were all right, but you absolutely had to study. We also had 2 "Problem Sets" that are just problem packets. I would recommend her.

Don't get tricked into thinking this is an easy A. While the homework is pretty straightforward and easy, the midterm/exams completely were a stark surprise... I mean since it's online you tend to slack but people getting below 70% on the exams were pretty much the norm.. Not an easy A

Great professor who is very knowledgeable in her subject. Accounting is not something fun to me, but she made class interesting with handouts. Connect Assignments are challenging, but she makes the "Check My Work" button available, so that you can check your answers as many times as you want. Tests and quizzes are challenging.

Great professor, best one I had last semester. Very passionate about accounting, explains all the topics very thoroughly and prepares handouts for each lesson to practice what went over during the class. Go to class and pay attention to what she says, and you shouldn't have problems with the material. Takes attendance, so don't skip the classes.
outstanding
great teacher recommendable if you go to class your fine.

Pay Attention and you'll do fine. Not an easy subject,and if you fall behind its EXTREMELY hard to get back up to speed. Not a class to take if your looking for an easy grade. Tough grader on tests/quizzes, never gives a curve or extra credit. Requires a good deal of outside studying to keep up. She knows the material better than any other teacher.
Do the work and pay attention in class and it is an easy class.  She is very clear and cares about her students.

I had her for Managerial Accounting. Her lectures are a bit dry but I liked the class exercises. She hands out exercise papers and gives time during class to do them. And then you go over it. It helped me learn a lot.

Professor O'Kelly is awesome, and anyone who says otherwise is jaded by a bad grade. She very clearly lays out complicated material and offers office hours all the time to help anyone who needs it. She is genuinely interested in helping her students learn and is highly recommended.

Comes across as fake (I see right past her smile) and makes you feel uncomfortable to ask questions.  Also, unclear as to her expectations.  Her explanations are good but tacky.  Clearly rehearses before class and she often makes mistakes on the board which is evidence of her studying her examples without understanding them.
Reads her power point way too much and doesnt work enough problems. I can read the powerpoint myself.  Really nice, but could be so much better if she actually did problems in class and not read.
Great professor, highly recommend. I put in little to no effort and was able to understand all of the material and get an A.

she's not jaded like most profs. im probably getting a C+ in this class and i still like her(class avg is about a b+). don't fall behind on reading if it's a summer class. she'll go the extra mile for you, ex: she customized an explanation for me on her own time and gave it to me the next class. the material is challenging, but you should take her.

Very Clear. Perfect amount of hw, follow the syllabus and it's easy  to keep on top of it. Quizzes/Tests are similar enough to class exercises, no curve balls there. Extremely helpful, extremely nice, and makes sure you know the TA so that resource is available as well.
Clear and concise

Probably the most happiest professor I've seen at northeastern. She loves to teach, extremely friendly, and helpful. The class is much harder than Intermediate accounting 1, so be prepared to do a lot of work. She always curves. Two exams, 1 final, participation, quizzes.

Professor O' Kelly is a very helpful, crystal clear professor. Her mood in class is always positive, encouraging students to participate and making them comfortable asking questions. She also reminds the free tutoring sessions offered by the ACCT department. She also gives quizzes regularly, making sure no one falls behind.
Had her for both financial and managerial accounting.  Very good professor, nice person.  Explains topics very clearly.
Honestly one of the best classes I've taken at Northeastern solely because of Prof O'Kelly. She is very clear, always willing to help, and makes the material interesting.

Very good. Recommended! She is the best accounting teacher at Northeastern University. Very clear and concise. You just need a good logic and you'll be fine. Practice the exercises though, this will help you a lot in the quizzes and exams!

Lectures are clear and concise.  Homework assignments do not take long to complete and helps a lot with understanding.  Reading the textbook before class helps, but she explains everything so well that you'll still understand it even if you don't read.  Reading the text helps with tests though, which are not hard if you study a little bit.

Best prof ive had so far. She really wants you to succeed and is very understanding. I enjoyed going to class and she taught the material very effectively and simplified things. Quizzes and tests were challenging but if you go to class, keep up on the HW, and follow the review sheets and sessions she gives, you will do great in the class.

SO easy, but incredibly boring. You will definitely get a good grade, but you have to be prepared for excruciatingly long, dull lectures.  She always had us do practice problems in class, and gave us 20 min to work them through... and then would work through them completely on the board...so its like doing the same problem twice and its painful.

did not learn anything from this professor- taught all the material to myself... has a nice personality but doesnt seem interested in helping studetnts succeed. you really have to pay attention in class and even if you do its still hard to understand the material.

Prof. O'Kelly is so nice! She is willing to help you out as much as you need. She really wants you to do well in the class, and explains concepts very well. Exams are fair. Work hard and you'll get an A.
Best Professor at Northeastern. Goes beyond just teaching the textbook, makes class interesting and legitmately cares about making sure you're learning what you need to know. She ROCKS!

She's a good teacher. She gives good explainations and she really is concerned about your best interests. However, her Group Field Project (Group Project) is almost a waste of time because its a lot of work and its only worth 10% of your grade.
She's an excellent professor; this is the second time I've had her. Exams are fair, reviews are comprehensive, and she's just a great professor. Highly recommended.
No Comments

BEST professor at northeastern (and not just because she was easy on the eyes)... ONLY O'Kelly could make auditing interesting.  Best thing to do: make sure to ask her for a review before the test and fill out the study guide she posts BEFORE the review so you can check your answers with hers.  I had NO experience with auditing. O'Kelly's awesome!
Fabulous professor. Learned a lot and it wasn't difficult at all!
blah.....don't believe the comments written above
Awesome and amazing, great person with a great personality. I got a great grade all because of her!
No Comments
No Comments
Super Hott!!! kept me interested in class but might have led to my terrible grade

She was an excellent professor; I loved her class. She made the subject so easy and you can tell she loves what she teaches. I definately recommend her!

She is a very nice person and very fair grader. It's not the easiest class but everything she requires can be done. I ended up with a pretty good grade and I didn't do well on everything so just show up for class and try your best and she will make sure you get a good grade.
awesome prof, she relays her information very clearly.  really nice lady, respects hard workers and made accounting somewhat interesting
Great teacher, easy to understand and very helpful. Take her class if you have the chance.

Fairly good class.  Class is not too dificult, however O'Kelly doesn't make it easier.She is one of those professors who simply just reads out of the book,well in her case a powerpoint presentation.Doesn't articulate on much.Her TA is this french man who speaks very poor English so that doesn'help.
She's pretty good. She's not super easy. but if you keep up with the work you'll get a pretty good grade.

She is a good teacher but the way she teaches was more in a presentation format just going by he PowerPoint slides and not really using the book. Plus she only gives 2 quizzes so you don't have much to work with if you do poorly.  I was not satisfied.

She is simple and plain, a great teacher, If you want to learn, take this class, just read, do your work and pay attention and you will do fine.  I have no idea, why that guy on the bottom wrote that about her, maybe he never went to class. I got an A
Peggy is very bubbly which is great for 8AM class when everyone is tired.  Really knows the material and teaches it well. Burps alot.
Easy, plain and simple, watch out for her misbuttoned top though.
No Comments

I LOVE Prof. Painter! His lectures are quite engaging, and you can tell that he is passionate about linguistics. He is funny, understanding, and really loves his students. If you get the chance to take any ling course with Painter, DO IT.

Professor Painter is my favorite lecturer I've had so far at Northeastern. He covers every subject in sufficient depth and very thoroughly responds to questions. Participation is very mandatory, but he is also very reasonable about it. Really cares about his students and seems invested in what you learn from the course.

He has very organized class/lectures. You can tell he's passionate about linguistics. He's accessible outside of class and gives good assignments/feedback. He also rallies student participation a lot. The class (intro linguistics) is pretty easy

Ling2350 is a lot of work, the final writing project is not something you can procrastinate. He grades harshly but is fair. The quizzes are all free response but not too hard if you study. Put lots of work into your writing and meet in office hours frequently and you can get an A. He is an amazing professor and you will learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Painter is awesome. He grades quickly and has very clear criteria for his expectations. His class is very easy and you learn a lot. I took it with 2 high courseload classes and had a very easy time. Take Professor Painter!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: 1150 is easy but know that he will nerf your grade if you don't participate or miss class without an excuse

He's extremely kind, engaging, intelligent, and endlessly forgiving. His lectures are a delight even if you aren't enraptured by the material. I'm incredibly grateful to have experienced his teaching---the ling path sometimes feels like the wrong move at NU, but the ling dept---and perhaps Painter, most of all---make all the difference in the world
Super nice guy and really cares about his students. HW, midterm, and final are all take home and as long as you pay attention in class, you should do well on them.

I have had Dr. Painter now for 2 classes and he is by far my favorite prof. He is so organized, clear, and passionate about ling. Even if the work you're doing at the moment seems dull, it doesn't matter because he is so excited about it. He really wants people to success and is very reasonable and helpful in terms of assignments. Take his classes!

I've had Dr. Painter a few times now, and he's phenomenal. He's always super prepared for class (having it scheduled down to the minute), his lectures are very clear, and he's always available via email or office hours. My only piece of criticism is that sometimes he goes very fast which can make it somewhat hard to follow.

Dr. Painter is extremely thorough during his lectures for Intro to Ling, and always gave me tons of written feedback on my homework assignments. There's some work that has to go in each homework assignment but there's only 5 or 6 in the semester and they're scheduled out. He is super sweet and will make sure you understand all the concepts

Professor Painter is extremely fair. Attendance was not mandatory, but in such a small class, he knows if you go or not. Grading was based on 5 or 6 homework assignments, which took long but were graded clearly, with opportunity to make up lost points. There was a midterm and a final, both lengthy but both take home. He is great! Very funny.

Linguistics is not easy, but Prof Painter makes it fun and clear-cut. He gets to know his students and is very obviously passionate about what he's teaching. He can be a little strict but he's a fair grader and will work with you if you need help. Would definitely take another class with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Painter's classes are hard but you learn a lot, and he's very willing and available to help when you're having trouble. I learned more in linguistic analysis than I have in any other class to date, and I truly enjoyed the assignments, difficult as they were.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Painter is one of the best teachers I've ever had. He genuinely cares about each of his students and is willing to work with you when you run into a problem. The homework/midterms/final are all take home, open note/open book and due in a week or so. His lectures were great and he's pretty funny. I highly recommend taking him if you can.

Ling analysis is a hard class, and professor painter makes it fun. He's a great professor and very knowledgable, and I've heard that he's the only one who allows you to do the course project using books rather than speaking to native speakers to collect your own data (although, I'm not sure if that's entirely true).
Dr. Painter is an extremely knowledgeable and effective professor. LING 1150 is very manageable if you attend class. I highly recommend. Make sure to be respectful and professional.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great guy with a great demeanor. He's very accessible outside of class if you need help and he makes lectures fun. The grade is entirely out of class assignments which tend to be graded a bit harshly, but it's not unreasonable and you'll get by. There were three extra credit opportunities for those that needed them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Definitely one of my favorite professors because of his eagerness to help students. Lectures are heavy but its usually interesting information. You will go through a lot of slides but concentrating in class will save you a lot of time. I highly recommend taking intro to ling with Robert Painter.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Painter's morphology class was something quite interesting for me. Although the in class lectures are not the most entertaining things, there is a lot of material covered and it's crucial that students attend each class. The homework assignments are also aligned quite well with the subject matter. Be prepared to learn about 100+ languages.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Painter is one of my favorite professors at Northeastern! The class can be tricky if Linguistics is not your area of expertise but he is always available outside of class to help and he keeps the lectures interesting. You will have one assignment per week and will need the textbook to complete them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: First of all, Professor Painter really cares about his students learning the material. Although this class requires a tremendous amount of writing for a 2000 level class (he calls it the Navy Seals Bootcamp), the writing assignments are totally worth it. Be prepared to learn, write and question a lot, but this class is totally worth it with him
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I really hated the class and I think Professor Painter is kind of boring, but I have to admit, I learned a lot.  You have to work and somethings just don't make sense, but he's really helpful and if you do the work and ask questions if you don't understand, you will get an A.

Wonderful professor. He's the reason I made it through Ling Analysis. Any other professor and I'm pretty sure I would have failed that class. He's helpful, very clear in his lectures, and gives a lot of feedback. He'll help students in any way he can. Try to seek him out if you're going to take LING 2350 or any Linguistics course.

Lectures are fast-paced, but he is witty and clearly enthusiastic about his specialties. Weekly homework assignments, and he'll give a take-home assignment over an exam, especially if the class pushes for it. Easy grader as long as you are organized and follow the assignment.

Robert Painter is my favorite professor at Northeastern. His classes are pretty dense - it helps to read the assigned materials, even though you're never tested on them. Difficult assignments each week, but no "midterm" or "final" in the form of an actual test. Very willing to help, clearly wants students to succeed.
love this guy he so nice

Genuinely so sweet, works office hours around if students need it, and wants students to succeed. Heavy hw but it is easy to get 100% on. For each of 15 ch's, 1 pre-lecture vid, 1 learning curve, 1 20Q hw. Gives practice exams for each chapter to review concepts and exam is very similar. You'll learn a lot and likely end w an A if you do the work.

Pr. Piao's class had lots of easy homework assignments that made up 40% of our grade. Tests were kinda difficult but manageable. His lectures were boring but he was very caring and enthusiastic about the class. I'd recommend! Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Most of your grade is made up by homework so as long as you do that you have an automatic A in the class. Three tests, each 10% each, and if you do the chapter review questions before the exam you're golden. The tests are super easy, so nothing to stress about. Although boring sometimes, Dr. Piao is so so nice and wholesome, tries to make class fun

Dr. Piao is simply an incredible professor. His slides are gorgeous, he's a good lecturer, a fair grader, and he's very understanding. He teaches at a reasonable pace and will always make his grading criteria very clear. He'll also go over tests with you in great detail if you go to office hours. Northeastern's lucky to have him.

take micro with him. no final and you only have 3 tests (which altogether still count less than the homework assignments). He assigns a lot of work but its pretty easy to get done so most people will have 98-100% in homework assignment grades which will save your grade for any score on the exams. Hes also very nice and always responds to emails.
GOAT, will take his class again if possible. Interesting class and easy grader.
He is the goat. Genuinely such a kind, communicative, and caring professor.

reviews.comment: Goat. Fav prof at NEU and I've had some great ones

Professor Piao was amazing for Macro during Summer 1. Ton of work; however, he gave time to do so. Unlimited attempts on most of the Macmillan assignments. Lots of mini projects and sometimes the peer reviews would not pop up until last minute, likely due to errors from Canvas. Great professor that gives full marks for completion of assignments.

Dr. Piao is a great professor! His lectures were sometimes long, however, he brings in great examples to try and keep us engaged. There are many assignments and mini-projects, but easy grade boosters. Tests are online and every similar to the practice exams. The final was semi-open note. He is accessible outside of class and very understanding!!

He puts so, so much effort into his presentations and lectures. The class is pretty easy but there's a lot of busy work in Achieve. This professor is so accommodating and cares about students. I regret not getting to know him more. Class material is pretty boring but he tries to bring in fun examples. Take him!!!
Legend, awesome guy.
The absolute GOAT! Caring, intelligent, and passionate, take his class!

Offers tons of office hours and extra help. Tests aren't super difficult and have a semester group project that helps get your grade up. Really willing to help out students and super nice. He also answers emails really often and is very flexible.

Professor Piao is a great guy who clearly cares deeply about his work. The amount of effort he puts in his slideshows are crazy and his lectures are straightforward and easy to follow. Sometimes the homework can be hard and if you are not a fan of multiple choice tests then I would avoid, but other than that his teaching style is great

reviews.comment: Very caring professor who wants you to understand the material. Relies on slideshows so just show up to class

reviews.comment: I took econ 2316 with him before and econ4691 information economics and game theory this semester but it was not on the list. Professor Piao was very helpful during office hours and was extremely generous on grading exams. Like, he only took 1 point out of 5 even you got more than half of your answers wrong. Highly recommended.

3 exams (noncumulative) add up to 55% of total grade. The rest is a group project and biweekly assignment. Very accessible after class and willing to help. Exams are very manageable, and the questions are derived from biweekly homework questions. If you are answering the homework questions easily, this class should be easy most of the time.
Love him. Extremely nice guy.
Tests were very much difficult. homework only before tests and one group project. Seemed very disorganized and wasn't that helpful. However, he's very kind and truly tries his best.

professor piao is v nice and flexible! had issues with my group mates and he was very understanding and dropped one of my grades for the group project. very funny and charismatic guy. you could probably get away with not going to lectures if you read the slides or are familiar with material. practice quizzes will have problems that are on tests!!!
Tests were extremely difficult, not much homework.

Professor Piao is honestly a really kind guy. I've never made a review on here before but he's definitely my favorite professor I've had so far and I hope I can take another class with him. His teaching style is really great, he is funny and you can tell he really cares about getting students to actually understand the material, overall I recommend
He's a G
Great professor but a heavy workload, however, as long as you do it, full marks are given

reviews.comment: Professor Piao is always available if you email him and super understanding.
Very nice professor, he is good at teaching.
Really nice guy who knows what he's talking about. The class was very easy, I did not do anything outside of class besides homework.
Best prof ever!!!!!Easy classes, fair grading, can't expect anything better!

Very kind person who helps you through email, office hours,in person, etc. He might be nervous at times, but he really is a kindhearted soul that want to help all his students pass with nothing less than a A. Get this man and your on your way to nothing less than an 4.0 freshman year.
Great man!
her lectures are somewhat drawn out and she often contradicts herself.

This is my second semester with her. One of the most intelligent professors I have ever had. Her reviews are so unfair because anatomy is HARD not her fault. Slides are clear and detailed. Exams are all MCQ, you need to study, and you will do well. She gives points back on questions that were unfair, and gives extra credit.
Honestly isn't much of the problem, this is just an intense course with a lot of material. She makes her lectures very wordy and speaks very quickly which can be hard to keep up with.

She absolutely clocked the class on cheating yesterday and it was iconic #puttingherfootdown. 10/10 experience watching everyone who cheats panic, and she didn't stutter ONCE, ate and left no crumbs. A&P is hard so you have to study, but she at least makes it clear what to know. I rather get an 85% with studying then with cheating.

I loved her. I took her for both A&P 1 and 2 with her and she was great for both. All of the info you need is on the slides and if you actually study its an easy A. The labs also weren't as bad as everyone made it seem, I would study the day before and went to office hours one a week and got an A on every quiz/exam.

I sat in this class wondering if I would live to see the end of it. It's like sitting through a presentation that was prepared the night before. On the bright side, I had time to do the crossword 3x a week.

Genuinely seems like she doesn't know what she's talking about. She just reads off the slides and only chooses to answer questions that are on the slides. She gives many tests that are just so conceptual and not straightforward, so prepare to study a lot. It's only difficult because she struggles to teach in an effective manner. It's ridiculous...

All the bad ratings are for the lab which she has nothing to do with! This class is super easy the exams are right from the slides and theres plenty of ways to get participation credit (including ways outside of class). She's great, the lab is hell

Honestly she's like fine ig she's just a big pushover and everyone used chat on her exams cause they're all online and she doesn't have proctors which was annoying. Also her lectures are basically just reading off the slides w/ some small additions so don't really need to go to class tbh. Participation activities were kind of just checking a box
Lectures are decent and exams are fair, nothing really special about her teaching but I dont think its as horrible as everyone says it is.

Her low rating is unfair. She's VERY straight forward & intelligent, its clear what you need to know, very willing to clarify what will be on exams. Exams are all MCQ, you need to put in effort as A&P itself is very difficult, but people take their frustration out on her by low ratings. 100% recommend taking her class she is amazing. #queenpeacock

I don't get why her rating is so low. She's organized and makes it clear what you need to know, offering reviews and clarifying what lectures will be on exams. All exams are MC, and you're given plenty of time to finish. A&P itself can be very difficult, and people take their frustration out on her by low ratings. 100% recommend taking her class.

True honesty, I think she gets a bad rep and she's overhated. Peacock is organized and clear on how she grades, and she gives so many resources to help study: lecture videos, free textbook, weekly, short, open note take-home quizzes, etc. I understand how the course in itself can be difficult once you find a study method it'll be worth it.

Honestly think she gets a bad rep but she's not that awful. As long as you make sure to stay on top of participation that will help boost your grade. Course had 4 midterm exams throughout the semester that were each 50 MCQ. Each midterm usually covered around 5 lecture topics, so usually studying a few days in advance would help.
I think she's being unfairly rated here. The exams are based solely on the lectures, and as long as you follow along, you'd be fine for the exams. It's very lecture-heavy, so be prepared to study.

I've really enjoyed Dr. Peacock and her course! You do have to do participation activities every week, but they're easy to do. Lectures are fairly easy to follow and she truly wants people to understand. Exams are mainly application, but its MCQ and she does review sessions the class before an exam. As long as you put in effort you'll be fine!

honestly a fair professor, exams are usually straight forward. A&P is a hard class which in general requires a lot of studying so if you put the work in its fine. my only thing is that sometimes she doesnt super clearly explain things, but she keeps a poll everywhere open so you can ask questions which i like.

Overall, your going to find yourself studying to survive, not to actually learn and retain the information which sucks. Tests are made to trick you, not for you to succeed. At first, it bothered me that students would cheat in order to pass her tests, and although I still believe it's wrong and wouldn't do it myself, I understood why.

Her slides makes it really easy to understand and is much better than the other professor, she makes the slides simple while the other professor copies off the online textbook and doesn't explain as clear as Professor Peacock. Take her class instead of the other professor

I loved this class and I loved having her as a professor. I don't know if she changed her style or the course but after having her for both 1 and 2 I think she's a great professor. Exams are straight forward and she gives you practice before each one including the final. If you actually study and put in the effort it's actually pretty easy

Idk why everyone hates her but she's great. I had her for both a&p 1+2. Her lectures are clear and straightforward and the exam was exactly her lectures. She provided a practice exam for every one on topics that students have the most trouble on. If you actually study it's really easy. I loved her class and truly didn't think it was bad at all

i don't think professor peacock's low rating is fair. as long as you pay attention to lectures, it is easy to do well. i never saw an exam Q that i had no clue how to answer. she gives a lot of options to do well (exams, participation, quizzes, etc). she was accommodating when i had to reschedule an exam for an emergency. highly recommend her.

While Professor Peacock is not the best professor I've ever had, she is certainly not the worst, and I think her rating on here is completely unfair. The course is hard, but I don't think her exams are unfair - all of the material you need to know is in her slides.

I dont think Dr. Peacock deserves the hate she gets. Class participation is required 2x per week. Exams are pretty difficult and more complex than the slides, but if you study its fine. People rating her badly are freshmen who have never taken a college class before. It's as difficult as any other STEM class. Don't be scared by her reviews.

Professor Peacock is a great professor! It is very doable to get an A in this class. Everyone who gave her a 1 or 2, did not try enough. In class she said PEOPLE SHOULD PUT IN EXTRA TIME FOR THIS CLASS. If you studied each lecture, meaning you did not just memorize, then you should be able to get an A in this class. I would take this class again!

The slides, which she reads straight off of, are too simple to make a student gain the complex knowledge required for her tests. I recommend skipping class and going through the slides slowly and chatgpt concepts that are unclear (which is most of it). Lectures feel like watching a teenager that prepared for the presentation the night before.

Dr. Peacock really just is too nervous to teach in a college setting. She seems to be very timid when she is teaching, causing her to just read from the slides in a monotone voice while never explaining any definitions. A free online textbook is provided but doesn't provide any help at all and isn't used.

Overall, Dr. Peacock is a good professor. Her tests were hard but doable & it helped to rewatch lectures and note-take on each lecture. Exams are weighted heavily but there is an opportunity for corrections and she factors in participation. FYI Lab is a different animal & somehow harder than the lecture course! I spent more time studying for lab...

lectures aren't the best; they provide the material but exams sometimes don't correlate and it seems like questions are purposely trying to trick you rather than test your understanding. reads straight off the slides even when answering questions. explains concepts in a very convoluted way. i think she is a good person, but not a good professor.

Peacock is the worst professor I've ever had. She doesn't communicate with students and either takes days to reply or doesn't respond at all. What we study in class is never reflected on the exams, making it difficult to prepare and succeed.

Dr. Peacock is a great professor and I think she explains the content really well and is super organized with the way she structures her class. It's anatomy so it's supposed to be hard but if you put in the time to memorizing you will do well. I think a lot of the complaints here come from the lab (which another professor runs...).

The real problem with A and P is the lab. This lab is the worst thing conjured from the depths of hell. The class so far is much easier. In the first month, you will have to memorize every part of every bone and muscle for humans AND rats. It's like learning a new language and the expectation is you become fluent within a month.

As a third year bio student, I think that these reviews are because this is a class that mostly first year nursing students take. Adjusting to college is HARD and I mean no hate at all- class felt impossible at first. But if you take time to figure out what study methods work for you, doing well in this class won't be a problem.

Overall, Dr. Peacock is a good professor. Her rating is unfounded on here. Taking A&P 2 with her over the summer wasn't really a challenge, as the material on the tests aligned well with the content taught in class. Engagement is key to performing well, and she makes expectations clear for content on the exams. Would take another class with her!

This class is definitely manageable. There are 4 non-cumulative tests, all multiple choice and you have plenty of time to answer the questions. My advice is too make sure you focus on the content on the slides. Be familiar with definitions and make sure that you really understand more complicated topics by searching supplemental content on youtube.

Took over summer 1, very easy class. Look over slides, exams all multiple choice, final is non cumulative. No homework besides weekly multiple choice quizzes with 3 attempts. Gives very few extra credit points. Memorize as much from the slides, not textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. P doesnt deserve the hate she gets! Had her for A&P 1+2 & loved her class. She does a great job at breaking down difficult topics. Her tests can be tricky but they test your knowledge & I aced them by studying slides+lecture content (focus on what she says when notetaking!). She cares & offers opps to boost ur grade (participation, team tests).

Ms. Peacock is an overall lazy teacher that explain complex concepts poorly. If you ask her to further explain something she will just read exactly what it says on the slide. Tests were entirely multiple choice and online, but she would hide the grades and not release them until a week after we took them which was very frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Reads directly off of slides and rushes through content. Records all lectures but requires participation which wastes class time since this is a large lecture. Can only do well if you teach yourself the material. Tests are all MC and often strange scenarios so even if you know the content you can get easily confused.

I honestly pray for any one who takes this class. This class is extremely hard to pass unless you study extremely hard. I do not recommend her. Multiple people ended up retaking the course due to her heavy lecture and very minimal explanation. I wish the exams were open notes to make an easier exam .
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Utilize the textbook honestly cause all this professor does is read off of slides and not explain content in simple manner.

The class itself wasn't super hard but her exams made absolutely no sense at all. They were loosely based on our lectures but it goes way beyond them. (The question will touch on a topic but the answers make little to no sense). Her communication wasn't great and she didn't answer questions properly; she would direct you back to the slides.

Never seems to know what she's talking about and repeats the same concept like 3 times but in different ways making it hard to understand -she sometimes contradicts herself too. Lectures are lengthy but she speaks quickly. Exams are mostly based on what she says so make sure to take notes on that. She does record her lectures though. don't take her

You won't know what information is important or what to study for so you lowkey have to cram for a test and then when the test comes the questions make no sense and are situational types of questions. This class isn't for learning... it's for passing.

Would basically just read from the slides, and if you asked her a curiosity question she probably wouldn't be able to answer it. The exams weren't too difficult though, and she made sure to provide practice exams before each one.

Lectures are garbage. If you have a question about a section you didn't understand, she will read off the slide again in the exact way she did the first time. Your grade is based on 3 midterms and then the final. During lectures, she will say many extra pieces of info that are not on the slides and unimportant, but then pick two to add to the exams

reviews.comment: The lectures are her reading off the slides and the overall grading layout makes it next to impossible to get an A. reviews.comment: This is the only A&P teacher but my advice is to not slack on participation it can be the saving grace for your grade at the end of the sem. Weekly quizzes also act as grade savers in my opinion. She's not horrible but like you have to teach yourself everything so... Good luck!

Peacock does not know what she's teaching...you will have to teach yourself the topics because she overcomplicates them in lectures. Her tests are extremely hard and discussion questions are answered by her own students, who supposedly do not have the same knowledge as someone with a PhD. Please avoid this class or professor if you can.

Avoid this professor at all cost, if you do end up in her class, I wish the the best of luck.

Exam questions are very conceptual, and are nothing like the examples we are given during lectures. Like those tiktoks going "lecture, homework, then exam" where the exam is impossible, that is exactly how this class is like.

Worst professor I will ever have. Things that are taught in class, homework problems, and test questions are all styled completely, so how confident you are on what you learn/practice will not translate to the exam.

Her lectures are just you sitting there for an hour while you get even more confused. She expects that you know a lot of "general" chem knowledge, but it isn't as "general".  What helped me towards the end was taking my own notes from the textbook. She gives a lot of extra credit opportunities which is nice. It's a weed-out class.

She uses an insane grading scheme and an unreasonable amount of drops to make up for the fact that she is not qualified to teach 2 semesters of chem in 1. And she can act like we're the ones doing the poor job. Avoid her at all costs for 1151.

no

Professor Seo has easily been one of the best teachers/professors I have ever had in my life. She really cares about what she is teaching and takes the time to answer your questions. This is the second class I've had Seo for and I like her a lot. She is usually very clear about what she wants you to know and what you will be graded on. She goes pretty fast, so if you don't have time to go to extra help or learn by working through things, this may not be for you. But I still regard as a very solid choice. Responds to emails well
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Sumi is a caring and friendly person. She is always willing to help.

Fantastic professor. I had her for Calc 3 and her lectures were amazing. She's willing to answer any questions, or meet outside of class. Grading was based only on quizzes, the two exams, and the final, so you have to stay on top of the material. Easiest way to do that is by showing up. She keeps lectures interesting and leaves time to take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She was a great professor who was glad to help students. Her class was not hard and she's a easy grader.

Professor Seo is clearly a very smart teacher, qualified mathematically. She is definitely enthusiastic about her subject. At first I was shocked at the fast pace of the class and a bit struggling with her accent but I learned after a few weeks. Lectures were mostly some instruction and lots of problems (examples). Go to her office hours help!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Seo was a great professor, I would really recommend taking Calc 3 with her, as long as you do the homework and quiz/exam reviews you should be well prepared.

I took Calculus two my first semester of college with Sumi, and it was an amazing introduction to college classes. Sumi is an amazing teachers who explains things in a way I could understand. She also pretty much tells you what's going to be on the quizzes and tests. Just pay attention in class, which she makes sure you do, and you'll be fine.
