Prof. Williams is the BEST math teacher I've ever had, and probably one of the best professors I've had in general. Lots of math professors are super passionate about math, but it's rare that they can translate that enthusiasm & knowledge to students like Prof. Williams was able to. Great and caring lecturer, highly recommend, just put the work in.

Professor Williams is the best professor I have ever had. She is an excellent lecturer; all of the notes she posts are easy to follow and straightforward. All of my emails were answered quickly, too. If you have the opportunity to take a class with her, I highly recommend doing so.

Abby Williams is the best! I had a horrible calc 1 professor and was nervous about calc 2, but Abby Williams really cares about her students, and even though the material can be somewhat complex she simplifies it and does not add extra information that would make it more confusing. Professor Williams is the best professor I have had at Northeastern. She is so enthusiastic about math and makes lectures less boring. Prof. was enthusiastic & kind every day of class! Made sure to answer all questions & be available in & out of class. Always kind & ready to re-explain concepts to us when needed. She is really kind and knowledgeable and she was very helpful at office hours. Her lectures are pretty well set-up too. Prof. Williams is probably the best Math professor i've had in a REALLY long time. She cares about the success of her students and is always open for questions at any times. The worst Professor I have ever had. She made comments to students that were inappropriate/racist. The work she assigned was inconsistent between students. Her pop quizzes often had typos. He was a super understanding and fair professor. If you are to take an online course for political science take his. I've never had such an organized professor, nevermind being online. Great guy.

Professor Agatstein cares so much about his students, explains things clearly, gives relevant examples, is very understanding about giving extensions + grades kindly. He would have a class every couple of weeks dedicated to letting us access his knowledge + ask him about things going on in the world from an IR perspective. Best professor I've had.

Professor Agatstein is an intelligent, organized, and kind professor. Overall, if you are looking for a good, chill class with a Professor who knows his stuff, take his class!! He is excellent at considering each student's needs while being fair to the entire class. His specialty in humanitarian crises is fascinating.

He's super chill. The class was weekly essays, and the same went for the final project. He's a really fair grader and was super understanding. Definitely a great online course, and managed everything well.

Great professor! The classes are discussion-based, and he always makes sure to explain the material thoroughly. Provides study guides for exams and posts all lecture presentations, which is super helpful!

I have never rated a professor before, but I have to, for Dr. Agatstein was amazing. I loved his discussions, as they were always interesting and relevant. He doesn't force you to reply. All assignments are argumentative essays, which I love. He responds quickly and gives great constructive feedback. Great class to take for NU Path or for credit.

SO SO passionate about finance and really knows his shit. Exams are hard though they've got a sweet curve. Probably the only 8am I consistently attended. Take him if you actually want to learn. What an incredible guy.

He's a great guy, lectures feel long but you will always learn a lot. If you miss a few you fall behind very quickly. Tests are few, but very difficult. Heavy curves on tests, you'll do fine as long as you do the homework

He is so passionate about the subject and I learned a lot about finance from this course. A+ professor! I have never found a professor who cares as much about the subject as he does and is as passionate as he is. wifi issues during the final which many people will rate him poorly for, but it was not his fault, and these people are just upset they did poorly on the final and trying to find an excuse. Take him if you want to learn!
like wow
the best it gets. No 1 finance professor. I learnt so much. He loves finance and will make u love It. He went to Harvard and yale

reviews.comment: If you want a real software job, build real projects. This course makes you play pretend as a developer on a toy project that a single AI prompt can finish. The professor is obsessive about requirements that don't reflect actual industry standards. More docs than code and a waste of AI credits.

The class itself is very heavily project based, and one midterm. Bhutta is a good prof, but his lectures are a bit monotonous at times. A lot of things in the class require more practice on your own time, and the projects do take a while, so don't make the same mistake I did about procrastination. Overall, good prof but the course itself is hard.

It's like a speed run of OOD but in a more complicated language. Each homework assignment given feels like a whole project, and they're usually assigned with 6 hours of lectures to watch, 5+ readings, and two practice activities. It is difficult to balance with other responsibilities.

It's an insane amount of work if you have responsibilities outside of this class. It's nonsensical as to why so much work is assigned each week. I find myself constantly trying to finish the assignments rather than learning and absorbing the material. I'd try to avoid this class if you aren't good at time management.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is a ton of work and not a lot of leniency. I understand that the Professor expects 20+ hours of time commitment per week for quality learning, but the EXTREMELY harsh grading criteria and little to no exceptions given make it very difficult for students with obligations outside of the class. If you have another class or worse, a job, then GL
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had the pleasure of taking your CS3520 during Summer 2024. Throughout the course, I consistently attended TA office hours to deepen my understanding and improve my programming skills, and I greatly appreciated the support and guidance from the course staff. Course was both challenging and rewarding, significantly enhancing my proficiency in C++.

I took CS 4530 in spring 2024. Taking this class helped me develop strong programming, design, and development skills. Because of the final project I completed in this class I felt ready for graduate-level work and improved my proficiency in coding.

I truly enjoyed the C++ course, where I earned an A, and I'm currently in Software engineering class, where I expect to achieve the same. These courses have strengthened my programming and problem-solving skills, and I deeply appreciate the insights I've gained from his teaching.

It was a great semester. I genuinely learnt so much from this class, and it was one of my favorite CS classes. I have grown so much as a person having learnt the skills that I did in this class. I appreciated all of the lectures very much, so thank you Professor Bhutta for giving us such a wholistic view of software engineering.

Thank you so much for an amazing semester. It's been a blast learning with Professor Adeel and I can't believe how much I've learned in such a small period of time. This class has been so rewarding and I enjoyed a lot.

This professor and his entire team of TAs are so unhelpful. It's a summer class, so things move pretty quickly, so the support of TAs and the professor is critical. However, these TAs would answer every one of my questions with "I can't tell you that" or "You're going to have to figure that out yourself" which I found bizarre.
This professor gives a LOT of work.

At first I could not tell if I liked the guy or not, but eventually realized he was a good lecturer, very professional, and treated the students like adults. The class was very fair. Not really anything to complain about.

Excellent course. Lecture were insightful and rewarding. It was a great learning experience. Projects were not too difficult but I would recommend giving yourself time to work on them. Professor was very kind.

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS, it's a waste of money time and effort. He makes rude jokes and makes the lecture very boring. You also don't really learn much from the lectures, I basically had to watch tutorials to self-teach myself.

Programming in C++ was a hard class with a lot of assignments. Despite this, the class was not horrible because the professor was a good lecturer and a great person. Attendance is taken once a week, but if you are sick or have any issue (even the smallest one), just email him and he will mark you excused. He is kind, understanding, and helpful.

Everything that you need to know for tests was done in lectures, no work outside of class except a weekly homework with group (if that), felt like I actually learned a lot in this class great prof would highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: good professor. really cares about what he's teaching, and wants his students to learn and understand. strict in class, makes up for it with bad dad jokes. class is mostly determined by midterms and final. covers a lot of content, from residential to commercial while including legal. test questions are also incredibly specific. review all slides

Adonis is an amazing professor. He cares about his students and genuinely wants them to do well. He can be strict sometimes, but it's because he cares. There were 2 20 question midterms and a 10 question final, non cumulative. Very interesting content and he definitely has been one of my favorite professors. Take this class if you can get a seat.

A great professor!! Super passionate about the class & really wants you to learn. The class is difficult, but if you put in the work it will be rewarding. Homework, case deliverables, & finance in practices are all groups assignments so make sure to get a good group at the beginning. There is midterm & final of 20 mc question & get a ref sheet.

One of the best profs at Northeastern. Cares about his students and subject matter a lot. Class isn't easy but nothing too bad and he makes expectations clear plus is very willing to help. He is also a very clear lecturer and goes to great lengths to make sure that everyone is on the same page.

Prof. Antoniades is a bit of a hardo in that he expects a lot out of his students, but if you put in the work you will be well rewarded. He's a great teacher and a super nice guy. All work is group work so make sure you know someone in your class/meet people early. Once you get used to his style this course is not too difficult and youll learn lots

Adonis is a very good teacher. He will challenge you, but the class is very rewarding if you put in the work. He emphasizes group work so taking this class with a friend would be smart. Tests are multiple choice on paper. Homework is also on paper. Overall, best professor I've had at Northeastern.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: All you have to do is show up to class. He does talk a lot, and it's very easy to get lost in what he's saying, but he did have interesting things to say, and he's clearly very passionate/experienced with the subject. Lots of field trips around the city, which were cool.
Basic intro to arch class, lots of fun field trips, some boring guest speakers, only graded on attendance
Attendance is mandatory but all he does it talk, super easy
fun and relaxed professor, very passionate about architecture!

Dan Adams is one of the most inspirational teachers Ive ever had. His lectures are interesting and his perspectives are really helpful in critiques. Hes also funny and laid back. I absolutely recommend taking his classes even if you dont plan on majoring in architecture.
Very inspirational and knowledgeable teacher in design tactics, highly recommend him for that course.  Get him to show you his projects in his firm, it is very interesting!
Wish he still taught the fundamentals studio.  Dan was amazing!
I had a great freshmen year studio experience with him. Wrote me a stunning recommendation letter for co-op. Very thankful for him.
Very good.

Talks like a machine gun but he's an interesting person. Make sure you don't put mulches in your design because he hates mulches. Very knowledgable and goes beyond the syllabus. The down side is that the class often finishes late, which is quite frustrating sometimes. Overall he's a great professor who has a good sense of humor.

He's very knowledgable, probably one of the best architecture professors in Northeastern University. But you will need to put in a lot of good and hard work to impress him. He also talks a lot so you'll always need to stay behind after class for at least an hour.

He's a good teacher who knows what he's talking about but he talks so much that you are sometimes forced to stay over an hour after class before he critiques you.  You'll learn the most from him but you're also assigned the most work.
Great professor, lots of fun, and very interesting. Assigns a lot of work and is quite tough with the grading but is very informative.

This studio teacher is such a jerk. The amount of work he assigns is nearly impossible to complete in the allotted time. He'll look at your work for 2 seconds, laugh in your face, and tell you that your work is hard to look at.

She is not knowledgable in Python, Matlab, Auto Cad, Solidworks (All the things she is supposed to be teaching us). She does not grade any of her own assignments because she does not know the softwares and is really unhelpful.

I am shocked that Northeastern hired Dr. Yeaman. She is the most clueless professor I've ever had. We even caught her answering a student's question with AI. Class is a waste of time, unless you want to make friends, but in terms of learning, there was almost none done in class. Very nice teacher, but nothing going on up there.

Terrible teacher. Completely Clueless. She know none of the course content and has no critical thinking skills. Literally useless. Do Not Take Her Class. She will literally bog down your engineering level. The final project was incredibly stupid and because of that will definitely impact co-op interviews. Should be fired. How did she get a degree??

真的很差了。DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS
1. She knows nothing
2. She never prepares for class (especially AutoCAD and Python; she always did something wrong and could not find her errors).
3. BAD Communication (essay-style instruction for each homework, has to be read very carefully, otherwise F is waiting for YOU)
4. The left brain attacks the right brain

Unfortunately, she does not know what she is teaching. Although she is a great person and cares for her students, I had to learn all the course material myself because she cannot teach. 

Great person, horrible teacher.
The professor is very sweet and approachable, but she's not very skilled at teaching and the class can be confusing. You will have to spend time outside of class to learn the materials yourself.

Don't believe the haters. Prof. Yeaman is awesome. She is super caring and works hard to teach us everyday. When she doesn't know something she admits it and then figures it out and updates us quickly. It's rare to find a teacher this caring and humble.

Yeaman is a sweet and kind soul, but barely knows what's going on herself. You can tell she cares for her students, but is just often time confused on the concepts as she is teaching them. Grading is pretty clear, and she does allow you to see what your grade is throughout the semester.

Professor Yeaman is very kind and sweet, but she knows nothing. Assignment take weeks to be graded, lectures are completely useless, and she's lost the entire time. If you genuinely want to learn, DON'T TAKE HER CLASS. If you just want an easy grade and have a basic understanding of the concepts, take it.
Does not have any knowledge of the material. Always lost.

You can tell Mrs. Yeaman is genuinely a kind soul, but she doesn't know what she is doing. Answering questions only leads to more confusion and she has stated that she is "learning with us". Grading is light so nobody is failing, but nobody has learned from class. Classes at Northeastern are expensive, and I didn't get anything out of this one.

Professor Yeaman is extremely kind but unfortunately she seems to not know any of the course material. Hopefully this is just a result of it being her first time teaching the course, but as it stands she is unable to make it through a lesson without confusing herself and the class.

doesn't really know what she is doing; class can get confusing if you don't know the material already. however, but she's super nice and the class is chill. grading is not too hard and assignments are easy; workload is not bad at all. tests are take home but can be confusing.

The pace is extremely slow, and yet she fails to understand the concepts of what she is teaching. Its as if she's learning with us and is seeing the slides for the first time while presenting. If you don't understand the basics of coding and CAD going in, she won't help you. You can watch a 10 min video to learn the same thing as an hour class
Best professor i've had at Northeastern for SURE. A must take. He cares and you learn things that you actually will use.
Good guy. He's super understanding. Class isn't super hard. A 2.0 in difficulty sounds about right.

Prof Adam was great. He kept class as entertaining as he could and would let us out early. All the quizzes were at home online and there was no final exam. Workload was light. He does take attendance but very understanding.

ling2350 was the hardest class i took last year. very tedious work which was cool in the end, but so time consuming. very niche in depth papers ~biweekly but u get very detailed feedback and peer editing time etc. hes very nice but so so boring i fell asleep. so knowledgable id recommend taking one of his classes at least onc
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Intro to Ling can be tedious--it is a hard subject to teach and a lot of other people are taking the class for credit and aren't very interested. For all other Ling classes, I have only good things to say about the course content and Dr. Cooper--caring, well-respected, accessible, provides thoughtful answers to questions, opportunity for extra cred

Prof. Cooper was great! He's very knowledgeable in linguistics and wants to share his love for the subject with his students. Our class (through the Explore Program) covered intro topics not in much detail but it was still interesting to learn about and I looked forward to our classes. Assignments are reasonable and fun to complete - I recommend!

Prof Cooper is the best intro linguistics prof one could ask for! Hes flexible, willing to help with homework, and overall a very reasonable, down-to-earth guy. The lectures are engaging and fun, and all quizzes/final are open book/note. Be prepared to dedicate a substantial amount of time to hw tho as there is a decent amount. Highly recommend!

Dr. Cooper is a nice guy, but he is extremely boring. His canvas is super clear but the material is tedious. He puts everything on canvas after class and all the assignments including the final, were take home.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was a fine professor but I was always incredibly bored in his class which made me want to skip lectures (rough cause he takes attendance for credit). His slides are very detailed, he puts absolutely everything on blackboard, and he gives meticulous feeback on homework assignments. If you show up to class you'll have no problem getting an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper is a great professor. His lectures are always very detailed and well planned and his assignments have clear criteria and generous grading. I do have to say though that he tends to go very slowly, and he recaps the previous class every day, meaning class can sometimes get boring, especially in the beginning.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper is a really good professor. He is not a harsh grader and is super accessible outside of class (go to his office hours and you'll be sure to get answers to your questions!). My only complaint is that I found lectures could be a little boring, but that could just be due to me not loving the subject matter.

It's been a while since I took a class with him, but I needed to leave a review because Cooper is the GOAT. He is super knowledgeable, his lectures are always well thought-out and run smoothly, he's a really fair grader, accessible outside of class, and he's funny. People need to appreciate this prof more because he's the best in the department.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper is a wonderful professor! He makes his material accessible and interesting, I always looked forward to class with him. He will pay attention to student feedback; helped make the class environment feel unified and provided a platform for everyone to participate.  Class with him was fun, insightful, and productive.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper has the clearest lectures out of any professor I have ever had. You always know what you are learning, and each topic is clearly defined and discussed. he begins every lecture with a concise summary of the last class, and then he tells you what is on the agenda for the day. Not an exciting speaker, but he is still a good lecturer.

There are homework assignments about every week and a half.  In general they are pretty easy but kind of long.  There is a lot of extra credit so getting an A is fairly easy.  There was only 1 midterm and then the final so not too many tests.

He's relatively monotone when speaking but his powerpoints are great and he explains things really well. He's also very accessible and will quickly respond to a question sent through email with a clear and thorough explanation. The material can be difficult but the way the class is structured enables you to do well

Really great prof. Funny, engaging & cares about his students. Easy class to do well in even if you are not confident in math because he's so helpful and your grade is a result of attendance + homework + quizzes + exams. Couldn't recommend him enough.

Professor Adams was very good and helpful. Attendance is mandatory but for most classes you end up leaving early anyways. He cares about his students and understands that Statistics is a somewhat boring class and he tries to make it fun. He sounds scary when you read the syllabus, but he is super nice in person and just has a few expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you're taking considering taking Dr. Adams, you totally should! Although attendance is mandatory, it is literally impossible not to get an A in this class since it is worth 30% of your grade. I enjoyed going to his class at 8am since he is very engaging and knows the subject well. I promise, he is super approachable and an overall great prof!

Genuinely a great professor. News flash: lectures are not supposed to be for your entertainment. They are supposed to be informational and might be boring sometimes, but Dr. Adams does his best to include fun demonstrations and stories to help students understand the topics better. Exams were not hard. Loved this class as my 8am.

Why is attendance mandatory if we're going word for word of the slides? Like genuinely the entire class could be an email.... Also, he is not funny so idk why ppl are saying that. Idk tbh I'd take a different prof

Prof. Adams is a great teacher! He does cold call on people very often so be ready for that, but other than that, lectures feel pretty light and has weekly McGraw Hill reading assignments that could take some time.

Attendance is very mandatory but prof adams is a really funny guy so they were enjoyable. Exams were easy and based solely on his lectures so you have to pay attention in class, and there is no final. Only thing is there was a lot of Mcgraw Hill homework that took hours and wasn't even tested, but, it was graded on a completion scale and worth 20%
TAKE HIS CLASS!!! Adam's is the best.

Lecture time was not used efficiently, lots of rants. He also loves to cold call so you can even zone out during those rants. The McGraw assignments are long and annoying. His “humor” is also very elementary but if you're into middle school banter you'll love him.

Social psychology with Dr. Adams was hands down the best class I have taken at Northeastern. He is super understanding about late assignments as long as they are not regular and you show effort in class. He is clearly very passionate about his area of study and it comes across in lectures!
He's super flexible and open to correcting things. Also memorized everyone's names on the first day, never forgot one.

Best professor I've had at Northeastern, and I had this class in my 6th semester at this school. I've never had better attendance, despite this one being at 9:15 AM, because I wanted to go to class. He truly wants you to learn, and if you participate, engage, and show you want to learn the material, you'll do well. I would pick him again every time

There wasn't a lecture where Prof. Adam's didn't make the entire class laugh. He always kept things lighthearted and spoke to the class with engaging and often hilarious anecdotes and examples. There were quite a few exams but all multiple choice and very similar to homework questions. He sets up homework in a very helpful way. Definitely take him!

If you can't handle his mildly inappropriate jokes that he makes because we are all ADULTS... go back to middle school. His sense of humour and ability to connect to us makes this class so much easier to understand and way more bearable. Attendance is HUGE, and so is something called SPSS.
His lectures were a bit squirrely, but he was super chill and nice. I did good
Really fun lectures, gives interesting demonstrations, keeps lectures interesting, exams are cumulative but simple. Fun guy. Accommodating. Take him :p
easy class

Professor Adams was a very good teacher. He made lectures very entertaining and interactive. Attendance is worth 30% of the course which can significantly help your grade if you attend class. He is also very accommodating when it comes to making time outside office hours to meet if you have class and for time to makeup work if you miss exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Adams is pretty mean. Whenever his students are having difficulties due to his sloppy teaching style, he'll outwardly call them out and moan his frustrations when he's the one who can't teach effectively. His lectures are awfuland all over the place usually not including things that are on the hw. Dont listen to the other reviews. Dont take him.

Dr. Adams is a great professor! The class is graded more heavy on attendance, but his lectures are super interactive and engaging so I always look forward to his class before all my others. He is very knowledgable and passionate about psychology and you will learn a lot from him! We love Dr. Adams :) 
(Also hello Ms. Adams your son is amazing!!)

If you don't take Dr. Adams, you're missing out. One of the funniest, most real, understanding, and passionate professors (his enthusiasm is contagious). Lectures are always captivating- his in-class demonstrations are hilarious and help us retain information. Exams are cumulative, encouraging us to TRULY learn and remember the content. Take him!

Dr Adams was a great teacher, very funny, his lectures are very engaging. He makes the class fun. I took it at 9:15 and managed to not miss a single class since I would look forward to his lectures before the rest of my classes. His passion for the topics makes them easy to digest, and the interactiveness of his lectures helps absorb the material.

Dr. Adams is a great professor. Attendance is mandatory, but every lecture is captivating and worthwhile, so it is easy to want to show up to class. He was very helpful and understanding, I would definitely take a class with him again!

Dr. Adams is amazing. Great teacher and a great person. He is the best professor I've had at Northeastern so far. The lectures are engaging even when there is a lot of information to cover. He is always happy to answer questions. His tests are fair and based on the slides and the quizzes. There are no surprises.

Professor Adams is great he really understands how boring statistics is and wants his students to be engaged. He also really cares about student feedback and keeps trying to improve his class the longer he is here at Northeastern. The only thing I wish he did was round up grades or include extra credit. Attendance is also mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Overall a great prof. I went to every lecture and felt like most, if not all of them were worth my time. Statistics are boring, and he acknowledges that and does his best to make it engaging. Offered some extra credit opportunities, and made himself available to help every student in and out of class. Very kind and funny, would highly recommend :)

Despite his efforts, he contradicts himself by constantly forgetting to provide quizzes throughout the semester and then dropping a large quiz at the end to test us on everything. His jokes are, at times, inappropriate for a classroom setting. A lot of content is confusing. Half of the class failed the second quiz, so he had to provide a retake.
He is a super funny professor, and he makes it very easy to succeed in his class. If you're taking Intro Psych, definitely take his section!

Dr.Adams teaches with enthusiasm, and although attendance is mandatory, his sense of humor makes the class worth attending. Attendance is also 30% of your grade, and the homework is very similar to the questions on the exams given. He does cold call so be aware.

He is really great and engaging in class. It is clear he loves to teach and that he loves psychology which makes the course engaging. He is very patient and does not give a lot of work which is why it is important you take notes in class to stay up to date. His classes are funny and you feel welcome to participate.

Professor Adams manages to make every lecture engaging and  we laugh at least once a lecture. Attendance is 30%, important but a HUGE grade boost. Only 4 mcq exams throughout the semester but all of them are cumulative so this can sometimes pose as a challenge to study for but there is no final. Very easy A and a great understanding professor!

He is amazing, he cares about if you learn the information and there is tons of resources he provides if you dont. Very few quizes/tests that are not hard if you study for. The only thing graded a bit harsh is the SPSS assignments, but he only takes of minimal points to give feedback.
Such an entertaining time, attendance is required but the actual class makes it worth it.
Dr. Adams is awesome. He's super down to earth and is really passionate about psych. He's funny and is an engaging lecturer. I look forward to his class!

I have never written anything on Rate My Professor, but Prof Adams is amazing. I've never taken a psyc course before but, so far, he has made everything so easy to understand and very engaging. Highly, highly recommend. It is an earlier class for me, but I still manage to wake up because I know the class will be so interesting.

This was Professor Adams's first semester at Northeastern, so he was a bit disorganized as he was trying to get settled into the new environment. However, he is a very nice guy who cares deeply for his students' success, if you meet up with him during office hours he is more than willing to go above and beyond for you if you ask!

He's a nice guy and is very knowledgeable about math. However, the course was poorly managed. Lectures were not very helpful for homework purposes. I'll admit that stats is not easy to learn (at least for me), but if the class is disorganized and the lectures are rushed through, it is hard to absorb all this. It was just an OK sort of experience.

He can't clearly communicate to students and lecture slides are confusing. Homework's helpful, but you kinda have to reteach yourself everything since he speeds through lectures and doesn't emphasize important info. Also dropped a huge exam on us after realizing he forgot to test us basically the whole semester and just overcomplicated the course.
John Adams is a great professor and allows stats to be digestible and enjoyable

Pretty disorganized prof. Rarely gives feedback for work which makes it difficult to understand how to do better. Not really helpful in communication. Waits until the last moment to post important info about projects. When she does post, its very short and lacks detail, unlike other profs. Doesn't seem like she really knows how to be a prof.

horrible professor. not only does she not actually teach anything (no lectures/ppts/videos/etc.), she is rude and dismissive over email. not once have i gotten a real and useful email response from her. i have never had a professor this bad at neu. if there's another prof available for digital marketing, take the other professor
rude and unhelpful

Her 3 exam is worth 75% of your grade, other grades comes from discussion post. attendance isn't mandatory but if you don't come you are not gonna do good on the exam. Lectures are extremely boring and dry. This is not a typical easy A elective.

as someone taking this as an elective, it was great there wasn't much work. you only need to do 5/10 discussion posts and 3 exams. however, this course is 100% memorization, which is time consuming to study for the exams. overall, she made the lectures interesting, even at times when the content wasn't.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Media Culture and Society was a very interesting class. It was a large lecture so I wasn't expecting it to be the most engaging, but Prof Ahnert was a great speaker and listening was never monotonous. She provided a clear study guide before the 2 multiple-choice exams.

lectures are well paced and thought out, wish we got to engage more since its such a large lecture. i have a brain that prefers smaller classes, but i am (for the most part) easily focused in her lectures even tho they are huge. chill class though not too much work. go to the lectures though, your attendance is graded
Her exams were online and open note and she was very nice. She was passionate about the information she taught.

Professor Ahnert wasn't very good at giving clear instructions with projects and essays, and would just take off a bunch of points after during grading. Her classes were very boring, but attendance was mandatory. She never gave feedback also after taking points off, like she took 8 points off and wrote "good work" and didn't give feedback.
This class is an easy addition to a schedule. She is very passionate about the topic and created all of her slideshows. The workload is light, and the midterms/finals are open note.

Prof Ahnert is a really respectable person. The course was pretty straight forward, but 75% of the course was based on 3 exams, so that isn't great when the exams are 25 questions each. Overall a great prof who gives detailed info about the courses she teaches.

AMAZING professor! Lectures were interesting and I never dreaded going to class. She is a very easy grader and the assignments are also very easy. She is extremely caring about extensions and midterms are not bad. I especially liked how much she cared about the subject and everyone's opinions and thoughts on the films. Defs one of the best at NU!

Absolutely awesome professor!  Dr. Ahnert taught awesome lectures. The course was extremely enjoyable and work was very manageable. She was a clear grader and was very flexible with deadlines. You could tell she was very passionate about the content which made the course very enjoyable and fun, would definitely take again.

I LOVED this class. The professor has so many good ideas and I learned so much from this class. She creates a safe space to share your ideas and discuss important topics relating to race and social justice. Just go to class and do the work and you will learn a lot and won't have to put in too much work. Would definitely take this class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is an amazing professor. Despite somewhat heavy lectures overall, you can do it very well with his lecture notes and his discussion. His subjects are also worthwhile to take. He is also willing to discuss during office hours. I can say he is an incredible professor who is good to students and good at teaching.

Professor Coskun was difficult to work with compared to other professors. If you get stuck with him I would take Thermodynamics later. He shoo's you away to TAs during officehours. You can't be sick and take quizzes/tests at another time or you will get an oral exam which is unfair. The professor is not understanding of extenuating circumstances.
good professor, hw is a lot but helpful for tests. He pretty much just goes off slides for lectures but its clear and he makes it easy to understand given that its a hardish class

Coskun is a solid choice. There isn't a better option than him so might as well take him. I never attended the lectures and still got a good grade because of the textbook. He prerecords all his lectures so you can take it fully asynchronously if you want. His lectures are very detailed PowerPoints so they are a good reference. Class concepts hard.

Coskun is a knowledgable professor who knows how to break something down step-by-step when explaining it to you. Ask lots of questions and he always has an answer. Thermo is a difficult subject if you don't put time into it, but if you put in the time then Coskun will help you succeed. Also, every section has homework due every class, not just his.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Coskun is an amazing professor. Thermo is an extremely hard course with difficult concepts and his lectures do a great job of making it understandable. He is super nice and easy to find after class and is very good about answering question. Also hes just an absolute savage so gotta love coskun.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He uses Power Point heavily in lectures, but that is actually very helpful because you can easily see the correct equations without trying to understand handwriting. I went to his office hours several times and he was very helpful and also gave good feedback on the Midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring and hard to follow. Teacher goes on ppt slides and doesn not write anything on the board. He teaches the class as if you already know the material.

His lectures are so boring. Thermo is a cool class but he makes sure that you hate it by the end of the semester. If it weren't for the homework due every class it would be a lot easier to just learn from the textbook than listen to him.

Professor has the most boring of lectures. Unfortunately you have to go three of three times a week just to turn your homework in. Yes, he has homework due EVERY class. As far as I'm concerned, his lectures are useless and the book is much more helpful.

Thermodynamics is an extrememly hard class. coskun makes this class even harder with his boring lectures, incomprehensible powerpoint presentations. willing to help though. smart. knows his stuff. but not good at teaching. thermo was very boring and hard with him.

awesome class, of course, for engineering majors. i enjoyed it, he was very clear on what he wanted and laid everything out for us so material was relatively easy to learn as long as you just paid attention and showed up. always in a good mood. didnt mind if i played computer games on my downtime. looked forward to class.
I really enjoyed Amal's class. She was chill and very patient. Her class was very interesting. You have to pay attention to lectures and work hard on homework to receive good grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I loved Amal! She was super passionate about the material. Her lectures did get a little boring near the end of the semester, but that was more of me being burnt out. If you want a good grade, make sure you show up to lectures. The homework got REALLY tough near the end of the year, but if you stick with it you'll do fine.
As long as you go to lecture and pay attention you'll be fine. She's super into what she teaches and gets really excited about new material so the lectures are never really boring.

As mentioned by the other reviewers, it's not required to go to lectures, but if you choose to skip on lectures, you'll need to read the textbook. I never touched the textbook and entirely went to lectures. The homework is tough but doable and very rewarding. Overall, she's an engaging lecturer so pay attention and you'll be fine.

only lectures worth coming are new topics. homework is 10 times harder than the lectures. please get lucky with your partner or be ready to do all your work by yourself. come to office hours a lot. final project (similar topic with her research i assume) was useless - try to do good on your homeworks so that you can skip one at the end.
just read the textbook, really no point in coming to lectures. if you have questions go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Really great teacher. Got me excited about computer science and inspired to pursue it.

Really animated teacher. Keeps the lectures interesting and explains everything well. The problem setsexams are tough for some but the TAs are always there to help.  Textbook reading is unnecessary, lectures and problem sets cover all you'll need to know.
Great teacher! Makes class very engaging.
Moves kind of fast, not organized.
I loved him so much. Got to know everyone's names week 1. As long as you do the homework and use that to study you should be okay on the quizzes.

Professor Ahn is a wonderful professor to take. He made Accounting clear and understandable whilst also providing useful background experience. Grading is generous and you will do fine provided you understand the assigned homework. I wish he could teach my second accounting course here.

Professor Ahn is an amazing, respectful teacher. His lectures are clear, the course Canvas page is organized, he gives review materials for each chapter, and he offers consistent office hours. The course has two midterms, each worth 15%, a final worth 30%, four quizzes worth 10%, connect homework assignments, participation, and a project.

Professor Ahn is the best professor that I have had at Northeastern so far. He is clearly very knowledgable about the material, passionate for teaching, and super kind. He grades generously and fairly. The class itself is pretty difficult but Professor Ahn gives you all the tools needed to succeed and all tests/quizzes are curved.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Goat, best accounting teacher. 4 quizzes out of 50 that are usually curved heavily (split between like 10 MCQ and actual problems), drop the lowest. 2 midterms, one final ( not really curved), and one group project. Teaches really thoroughly and is accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, is available all the time for office hours and is very kind

Accounting in general is a hard course so I can't hate too much. Professor Ahn was great at first. His quizzes were okay and he went through content slowly. When we got to the more difficult chapters, he went too fast for my liking. Very exam heavy! However, he is kind and welcoming and made an effort to get to known everyone's names.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Super nice teacher and very easy grader. Makes an effort to know everybody's name. If you go to the lectures you will get a good grade in the class. Only one group project and isn't difficult.

A great professor for grading—quizzes get a nice curve, but exams don't. Lectures can be dull, but that's just the class. He's kind with selective office hours. Given accounting's difficulty, he grades generously. Multiple choice is key on exams, making up half the quiz points. Struggling? Watch Tony Bell's FA videos—they match the class perfectly.
awesome professor.

He is super knowledgable on accounting and you can tell he loves his job. Amazing professor, lectures can be a little boring but he makes them very straightforward and easy to understand. Tests and quizzes aren't too difficult as long as you study and do the homework. Might be my favorite professor so far.
the goat and the only reason i passed accounting after failing it before. Take him no questions asked. THE GOAT.
This dude is the goat.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very laid-back guy, very nice. Learns everyone's names. Straightforward lectures with practice sheets. Homework is very helpful for your understanding, too. Highly recommend.

4 quizzes and drops the lowest, 2 exams and one final, and one group project thats very doable with competent partners. Class is hard becasue of content but he makes it easy to understand. A VERY nice grader, as long as you show some effort you can easily get a B- on every assesment/assignment. HW can take a bit but just go to office hours for that

Professor Ahn cares about his students understanding the concepts, and definitely prepares you extremely well for every assessment. He is a rather lenient grader, and is not out to get you on docking points which, if you are not a great test taker, is a plus. His lectures are a good pace, and he is accessible outside of class. Pretty Easy A.

Professor Ahn is an incredible teacher for accounting. He is kind, lectures very concisely and slow enough to where you don't really have to study to do good. Overall GOAT and I would choose to take his class again even if I forgot everything about accounting.

Professor Ahn was one of my favorite professors this semester. There were weekly homework assignments and quizzes, but never any surprises on any quiz/exam. He dropped the lowest quiz grade, and exams are always curved. He is an extremely fair grader and replies to emails fast. There is also one group project that will definitely help your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a really good teacher and makes complicated topics easy to understand. He does a lot of examples in class and explains everything multiple times so you really get it. Quizzes and tests are in line with the in-class problems and slides. He is around for help outside of class if needed. Overall great professor.

Ahn is a pretty chill guy. Although the lectures aren't the most entertaining, neither is accounting as a subject itself. He explains things very thoroughly when asked to clarify things and is available outside of class most of the time. Go to his office hours too!

Professor Ahn wasn't the most upbeat or enthusiastic professor, but he possesses a rare ability to understand your questions and walk you through them thoroughly. Also has some solid dry humor, and if you pay attention and do your homework it's a shoe-in A-.

He is really caring about his student although his lecture is quite boring. He always tries his best to make the lecture as much understandable as possible, and his practice sheets for every class are very helpful for the midterm. His test is straightforward and fair grader. I would love taking his class again :)

Professor Jaehan Ahn is very understanding and caring. He gives practice sheets every class to perfectly prepare you to the midterms and final exam. If you want to enjoy Accounnting, you should take this Professor!

His lecture could be a little boring and he is very quiet. But his lectures are very straightforward and slide heavy. I did not always understand the lectures or content, but he was trying his best to teach. He was available during office hours to explain. He provided plenty of homework and study materials and his exams were fair & nice grader.

Great Professor who wants students to understand the material. He came across as slightly boring at the beginning of the semester but is a very nice guy and the class was definitely not boring. Four quizzes and drops the lowest grade of the four. 

Participation	10%
Connect HW	10%
Quiz	10%
Group project	10%
Exam 1	15%
Exam 2	15%
Final Exam	30%

Wonderful professor who really showed he cared for his students by learning our names early in the semester. Very supportive environment but it's a tricky subject matter and was a little scary to speak up. Class very lecture-based. Generous grader. Be warned he uses Excel a lot which can make the class feel even faster-paced.

Incredibly clear professor. As far as the intro to accounting class goes I'd say he's the best professor in the department. He made a notoriously boring subject understandable and interesting enough and the problems you go over in class prepare you well for the quizzes and exams. If you study a moderate amount you can do well in this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, he really cares about his students learning and always includes plenty of examples so that everyone understands. Tests can be tricky but if you study the homework and notes, you will be fine. Highly recommend for ACCT1201

Incredibly knowledgeable man who explains everything well. PowerPoints are extremely useful. Super nice and wants to see you do well. Classes involve a lecture, then working on a handout he provides. He has an amazing voice that can be extremely easy to let become calming background noise, but if you pay attention you will be rewarded.

His lecture could be a little boring because he is a quiet person, but his lectures are very straightforward. As a result, he taught us a very difficult concept in a clear, concise manner. He advised me on my future path in the accounting profession, making him a helpful person to reach out to if you have any questions.
Super straight forward and always gets to the point! Tests are very similar to the handouts he gives and additional questions he suggests doing from the textbook. Generous and fair grader.

These reviews got my hopes up about this prof. Maybe bc it's an online class during a rough pandemic, but he doesn't seem engaged. Very monotone and lectures are hard to sit through. Tests are like examples and homework but still quite difficult and not enough time to finish. I'll cut him some slack for the circumstances the world is in right now.
Professor Ahn was amazing at explaining difficult topics, and his exams were very similar to the worksheets given during class.

My friend and I were definitely surprised when he WASN'T AS FANTASTIC as these comments made him out to be, but he was still DECENT. Very respectable guy - nothing seemed incredibly great about him but he did all the basics pretty well - clear, helpful, compassionate - should feel safe taking a class with him.

Professor Ahn is super friendly and caring to students. As prior comments have mentioned he is typically lenient to students who try and make an effort to understand the topic. He also tries to break down accounting into the smaller segments for easier understanding. I like that there are in class examples and worksheets to practice on.

Out of all my professors this semester, he was the best. His lecture slides and the example questions are very helpful. There are a lot of assignments, but quizzes are more like the example questions. Advice: Just go to class and you'll understand the material better
Best professor ever!!!!!!!
Loved this professor. Best professor with the best humor around. He makes accounting truly enjoyable. Made me concentrate in finance and accounting.

A really great guy who wants you to succeed in his class, and will take the time in lecture to help you understand the material. Reading from the textbook is helpful for some chapters but definitely not mandatory for all.

Took his Financial Accounting class. He is a great guy, who wants you to receive a good grade. When he saw me struggling with some topics on quizzes, he even raised my grade by a bit. Explains the material well, though you may have some troubles with understanding his accent. Listen to his lectures, skim through the textbook and you'll do fine.
Best professor at NEU. I was intimidated by him at first but he turned out to be the funniest professor I've ever had. Makes you understand everything.

He is a great professor! Really wants his students to learn and always clarifies topics when people dont understand. Totally recommend this professor for anyone who nervous about taking accounting!! Hes also very nice. Loved him
What an amazing guy. He makes accounting an enjoyable topics and he's the cutest professor around.
She should go home

I am not a conspiracy theorist, but I do believe with all my heart that Aisulu is an angel. When I am not looking in her direction, I swear I see wings sprouting out behind her back, and dare I say, the glimmer of a halo on her head. Aisulu cares deeply about her students and real learning. She has a beautiful respect for the field of linguistics.

She was a great professor. She was very lecture driven but she is always willing to make sure that you understand. She will incorporate practice problems into her lectures so you have a better idea of what she is teaching us. Her homework is pretty easy if you review the lecture slides. She is very lenient and is always to help accommodate you.

The professor is extremely nice, she wants to make sure you actually learn the material. There is only 1 test. The homework is graded fairly with great feedback and she does not really mind latework. The lectures in class are long and can be boring but you will understand everything from her with no studying. I 100% recommend taking her class.

Very negative experience regarding the course and the handling of intellectual property. Students should be extremely cautious about protecting their original work with Michal Aibin. Avoid at any cost.

Beyond the severe ethical red flags, the instructor's professional standard is alarmingly subpar.

The teaching quality is honestly very poor. He often seems confused and doesn't explain things clearly, which makes me doubt if he even understands the material. It feels like he is just doing the bare minimum to get by, without caring about the students at all.
Very negative experience regarding the course and handling of intellectual property. Students should be extremely cautious about protecting their original work with Michal Aibin. Avoid at any cost.
Lots of positive feedback and ideas how to do projects - helps learn how to do research.

The best Capstone Prof by far. Lots of knowledge, industry connections and applied, hands-on approach. We build disaster management tools for wildfires and got internships after in the industry. Strongly recommend!

Very hard to understand because of his thick accent. A lot of graphs and charts. The book should help you through the course. Pretty sure he copy and pastes questions from the Internet on to the quizzes. He's not engaging and just a very dry course avoid him if you can.
Guy is hard.

Average professor.  Very dry.  His lectures aren't particularly helpful, but they aren't confusing, either.  His assessments are fairly easy, but the online MC ones can be rough.  He doesn't take attendance, so your grade really depends on how you do on tests (especially the final).

Not one of my more interesting classes but thats microeconomics for you. Prof Saranjam did a great job of using relative examples that made things easier to understand but the material was still challenging. I would highly reccomend staying up with the readings as Saranjam only goes over the graphs and charts whereas the book does vocab.

This is your stereotypical lecture class. I am a good student, but this class was extremely boring to the extent that I lost interest. The teacher does not know who you are, nor keeps attendance. Quizes are all online and can be Googled. Midterm and Final requires looking at his notes and the book. Boring class, but not that hard.

A solid micro teacher. Has a funny accent, and is a bland person, but is quite clear and provides a lot of interesting real-world examples. Also, his quizzes are great because they're online, and you can do them twice in a period of 48 hours. Quick warning: he uses a lot of tables and math, so maybe not the best for the math-challenged.
4 online quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 final. No homework. Not very friendly. His notes are extremely basic so you need to study with the book. Cancels class/doesn't show up sometimes. Not very accessible.

I took him last semster and he stopped giving the answers to the midterm and final ahead of time ... but there are online quizzes and the midterm was really easy (only 7 q's) but the final was really hard but much harder than midterm) however class is easy and he gives you an extra credit option im a poli sci major and this was an easy econ class

If the below description fits you then you should get an A. Good luck, I did it.             - Dont alway's like to go to class                     - Strong memorization skills (hands out     questions for tests beforehand)                   - Can study for long periods of time just right before a test        GOOD GUY

class  is easy. take home quizzes. gives you the questions for the midterm ahead of time. but he is not helpful or understanding with anything. i never wen to class. i got a 79.6 because i totally bombed the final and he wouldn't even round it up to an 80 to give me a B-.

Macro = asy easy class. Take home quizzes with all the answers right in the textbook. Super easy midterm. Tons of easy extra credit assignments. Went to class a total of 10 times all year and still got an A-. Grades the final kind of hard, but he's a really nice guy who will answer whatever questions you have.

I hated him the first couple classes but now i absolutely adore him. he's really funny, has a thick accent but isn't hard to understand. all quizzes are take home and you can take them up to 3 times. midterm was really easy. don't need to go to class. most of the stuff is in the book.

saranjam on toast is HILARIOUS. he says funny things like that the shoes he bought were "twice money" and "bagels the size of pizza." so classic. i spent most of class drawing and writing down his quotes and still got a good grade. ahmad is really straight forward and loves to ask rhetorical questions that nobody answers-but it's ok, he's adorable.

This man is my life. He's hot, he's hilarious, and he knows it secretly. Sexy accent; it's like having Santa Claus teach me (plus some Owl and Cat like features). His class is fun and straightforward and he makes jokes that he giggles at (because they're hilarious). He uses GM in all of his "Exam-Pail"s. Love. him. Hope he's single <333333333

I love this man. His tests and quizes are very easy if you read the book and some of them are even online. He knows what he's talking about and thoroughly explains everything. Plus, his classes are always like 45 minutes long and he doesn't ever take attendance.
Great Professor. Usually puts the quizzes online with unlimited time to do it.  Try to go to class, if not everything is pretty straight foward out of the textbbook.
You wouldn't think he's as good of a lecture professor as he is- he's pretty incredible and making macro sensible and easy to understand. Loved his class, would take it again if I had to.

I struggled with this online class, I thought the amount of work was endless!  By the end of the class i really appreciated how much I had learned.  He graded very fairly and always answered questions.  He really wants you to learn and to do well!  Loved him!

Although not necessary to go to class, he does give useful notes. Still, reading the book is mandatory since the quizzes reference examples from the book. Good professor though, explains stuff well. One thing to keep in mind about him is that he doesn't like to fight so if you feel as though he did something wrong CALL HIM OUT ON IT.

he is really clear and writes everything on the bored...you might want to read the book unless your happy with a B-...the exams are easy if you study the review sheet....I enjoyed going to class because i understood the material and was way better than my macro teacher...plus he lets you out like 30 minutes early almost every day

All he does is lecture. What he teaches is identical to what's in the book, so a lot of people don't go to class, and just study from the book and do fine on the quizzes. Extra credit essays add ten points to each quiz grade if you have the time to do them. Midterm & Final were easy essay questions taken straight from the chapter reviews.
Really kind person, decent class.

I'm not an economics major, so this class was really boring for me.  I didn't like this guy at first, but he got better as the semester went on.  If you do all of the homeworks and take good notes, you should be ok.

Saranjam was a pretty ok teacher. Seriously, I rarely showed up for the class. 5 quizzes @ 10%, 2 exams at 25%. i read the book before the quizzes and got B+ as lowest grade. I studied for a multiple choice midterm and was handed an essay question exam and failed. Thus, i got a D+. Besides that he was great!
He adjust his test to the capability of the overall class.  Big on extra credit.  The notes mimic the text so going to class is optional.  Pretty good guy.

its the average college course. i got a C+ and all i did was show up. i never took notes or studied or paid that much attention. if i did, i would of had an A, guaranteed. so, dont get lazy in this class. he's a good teacher

This guy knows his stuff and makes the class pretty easy by only teaching basics. His teaching style is very clear and the classes are all notes on the board except when he asks questions and no one answers; then he answers himself. The tests are all based on the notes and for midterm and final he gives you the questions to do before the test.
he lost my final and gave me the class avg which screwed me. other then the fact that he is a meathead the class is easy
Ahmed is the man...that is all...take his class trust me you wont regret it

this guy knows his material quite well, class format is static, quiz and exam formats basic. read read read, take notes in class, and make use of anything he puts out on blackboard, and you should do well.

very smart man, a pretty good teacher, once you get past the accent.  he offers extra credit and his tests are fair and based on what he taught/whats in the book.  hes good to go to for extra help, too.
No Comments
thick accent but good guy and good teacher.  alot of wasted classes, alot of movies, alot of cancellations.  more than average amount of quizzes help stabalize grade, easy material.
nice easy grader, thick accent but good teacher bi-monthly quizzes help to even out grade
Very easy material. Tests on book. Easy midterm. Take home final. Boring lectures. Good way to raise average if you don't mind reading the book.

My teacher left in the middle of the semester and I got stuck with him, he messed up all the grades from the previous teacher and I was sick in the hospital during an exam and gave me so many problems for making up the exam and still gave me an incomplete until a few weeks after grades came out.
Can't stay awake!!!!!!!!!!!!  Econ just sucks as a subject in general... but with him, its worse...
this guy knows his****. bases quizes on 40 ques but gives 50, so 1st 10 have no penalty. great way to boost average if u read the book.
Very boring during an 8am lecture, but fairly easy nonetheless...Read the book, don't even bother going to class.
really easy, he lets you use a notecard on all of the tests. classes are boring but if you take good notes you'll know most everything for the test

he's a good guy. a little boring but if you know how to take his tests then you're fine. on the notecard just write down all the definitions for those chapters....also read the chapters before the test he doesnt always go over everything
No Comments
This guy is too monotone but gave me a good nap every morning.  Also on tests his questions are really twisted and tricky
No Comments

Personally, I hate mono-tone foreigners that teach, but this guy makes life easy as cake.  If you take a quiz, you can have 10 problems wrong out of 50 and still get a 100.  Very Approachable. This was definetely a cake-walk class.

Nicest professor at northeastern. She truly cares about her work, her contribution to science, her students, her place within the university, and as the editor of the Northeastern Journal of Linguistics. Amazing human. Amazing professor.

She's the NICEST lady! Super caring and understanding - I had to join her class online during the summer, and she was really accommodating. She gives great feedback and is really passionate about what she teaches. The class was super engaging and you learn a lot, yet the workload is manageable - take her class!

Aisulu Raspayeva is a WONDERFUL professor who genuinely cares about her students. She wants you to be as passionate about linguistics as she is. The workload in manageable and contributes to the content of the class. I recommend taking something with her if you have the opportunity.

She's a very accommodating professor who's generally open to whatever you need, as long as you can explain your reasoning. The assignments are flexible, you can miss class or arrive late if you communicate with her. She's extremely understanding and creates a comfortable classroom atmosphere where you can work at your own pace, listen to music.

Very sweet professor, is usually okay with anything you do as long as you have a good enough reason. Assignments are flexible and you can skip class or come in late of you just tell her why. Very understanding and good class environment - you can have music on while you work, go at your own pace, etc.

I did great in her class but she is the kind to tell you what is wrong with your artwork in front of everyone. I was doing a presentation and made me stop because of something I said was "wrong" and proceeded to tell the entire class why what I said was wrong, basically called me stupid and that I didn't know what I was talking about while laughing
very kind, easy class, can draw or paint anything if you have a clear enough profession of your work or enough reasoning, very process oriented.
Pretty rude, talked down to me because I couldn't draw certain styles. Very unclear of what we are doing in class that day and grading scale is wack.

She clearly has favorites. After missing two weeks for personal reasons, she developed a weird vendetta against me, even making remarks about me in class. Though I put A LOT effort into my work (mind u this is an 8am 2 credit course) and followed her guidelines, she graded unfairly. For my final, I met all requirements but still ended up with a B.

Judgemental + pretentious. Will grade you on how much SHE likes it/match her style, not if you did it right. Her suggestions are basically mandatory fixes if you want a good grade. Clear favoritism. She often singles people out for not having art knowledge or doing the project wrong (will make people come look at your work and explain why its bad)

Good at at teaching art but she likes to give her thoughts on things when she thinks you are wrong. Graded by very few things, but very picky if you are late. I think her grading was unfair at times. But she was an easy class for me.

She was a fun person, depending who you were. She is picky on art style at times and said she didn't like the way I drew a project on my style. She could tell I wasn't a good at the type of art she gave.

She always singled people out. When I participated in her class at the beginning, she pointed out my apparent difference. And she always treated me differently, and when everyone introduced themselves, she gave positive feedback. When it was my turn, she ignored me. She only ignored me.

i was sick and could not come in for the midterm, emailed and nothing back. midterms are by appointment and i came in and she gave me a 0 for it, later on a guy in my class said he just overslept and she just gave him an A.

not good at all types of art? don't even think of getting an A in this class. she singled out people in the class and would laugh it off when no one laughed with her. also drew all over on and on back side of my art piece in sharpie of what she didn't like about my work.

she has her fav in students and has double standards. she is very passive aggressive when it came to people artwork. i had her as a 8am and she would shame students that would come late (by 5 mins) and say that there was no excuse of being late when she got there at 6am. gave me a C on a project because she didn't like my style i drew something.
She's trying to make me the minority, I feel isolated by her words.
An incident where she commented on physical differences between students left me feeling marginalized and uncomfortable. Her approach lacked sensitivity, which significantly affected my ability.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A specific interaction in class involved comments that emphasized personal differences in a way that felt isolating and inappropriate.

The professor's teaching style made it challenging for me to engage with the material. While she is knowledgeable, her approach to addressing students at times felt dismissive and uncomfortable. An interaction during class left me feeling singled out due to unnecessary comments about differences.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a student currently in Professor Ainslie's Color and Comp course, I've found that her passion for her work and creativity enhance your learning experience tenfold. She approaches issues with empathy and kindness. Communication and effort are key in this course; you cannot half-ass your work, but it is absolutely worth it in the end!!

If you are not someone who has fundamental art skills don't go with this professor. She is dismissive in communication and is very vague in terms of how she grades your assignments. She never gives clear feedback or instructions on the projects in class.

Grades are based on projects and attendance. There are 3-4 projects during the semester, most of which have a quick turnaround time. you will have it put in a LOT of time and effort outside of class; even then, you are not guaranteed an A. she does not grade by effort, she grades it based on what she thinks of your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I didn't have the best experience with Sophia in this class. You will have to put a lot of time aside to do the projects she assigned. Sophia was a very harsh grader, even if you did do the work or you participated in class, there was always going to be something she had to say.

You'll need to spend a lot of time doing the project every week, get ready for it. She is a hard grader even you put a lot of effort into work, you may still not an A. She can have so many to say about your work, so don't be afraid.

The only 8 AM class I actually enjoy and attend every single class. Very friendly, encouraging, good teacher, but somewhat harsh grading if you're used to easy As. Has some trouble with lectures assuming previous knowledge, but does answer questions and is willing to talk about it further with individual students if asked to. Overall, great teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Sophia is phenomenal! Always very encouraging and full of ideas. I didn't come into the class an artist, but she made sure I left with a passion for art. Her enthusiasm is contagious

She either gives very vague feedback or she tells you exactly what to do, but then still gives you a low grade even if you follow the feedback perfectly.  A very kind and understanding woman, who wants to help.  She seems to be very proficient at art itself, but maybe not at teaching art. She says "push the work" as the main feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Sophia is funny, upbeat, and really nice, so she's willing to help you if you ask. She's also a really tough grader, and though you can always revise your work, expect to spend a lot of time on your projects.
Hard class, lots of work, but pays off. Best teacher I've had at Northeastern. Sweet, funny, and willing to help.

Sophia is the best teacher I have ever had.She accepts everyones technique and style and is excited to explore it.She is extremely down to earth and understands that students have other work and gives a fair workload. She gives a lot of personal attention and will rearrange her schedule even to meet with you and she wants to see individual progress

nice person, but just ok professor. she was a bit harsh with her grading, and she was also a bit hard to please.  projects were sort of hit or miss, either she liked what you did or she didn't.  if you take her 2d class, make sure tone is a key element of your pieces, she definitely focuses on that the most, and subtlety in tone works against you.
