reviews.comment: NO THX

I had him for precalculus and for my entire 21 years of life I had never understood math until I took this course. He's funny and creates a very intimate class setting where it feels comfortable to ask questions. Totally suggest him

Professor Eigen was the best math teacher that I have had my entire school career! I had him for Precalculus and he was very clear and thorough and basically covered everything that I needed for Calculus. Quizes are very easy and resemble the homework. He has a great sense of humor that adds to the class! Take him if you can!!
I took Stanley's Precalculus class. He was a really cool guy. The quizzes were really easy and if you didn't understand something he always took the time to explain it to you one-on-one.
Easy quizes, good style of teaching, and overall a great professor. Stan is the man.

This is NOT precalculus! This is an ALGEBRA class! If you already know your algebra, this class is POINTLESS. I thought we were actually going to do trig, but I was wrong. It's a waste of time for those who already learned from high school algebra.
Extremely easy. Actual quizzes are almost the same as the practice ones.
Great teacher
His awesome, easy class. All you have to do is the HW because its same as the quizzes. He helps a lot. Strange sense of humor. Great teacher easy A.
VERY easy class. He isn't very helpful but he will explain it and give practice quizes that are ALMOST IDENTICAL to the actual quiz.

very easy. quiz every week. gives you a practice quiz and the quiz is EXACTLY the same as the practice quiz. if you can do the practice i promise you can do the quiz. no surprises at all. funny guy, kinda a dork, but i liked him. oh and if you knwo what you are doing you can leave like a half hour early :)
Teacher is very rude. When I went for help after he did very little to help in anyway.
No Comments

Very easy if you put in the time. Ask questions after class or during office hours if you need help. Rewards you in the form of overlooking algebra errors on quizzes if he notices you putting in work.

easy class. hes scatterbrained but somehow he explains things really well. nothing unexpected. homework and a quiz every week. each class was like 20 minutes long with the rest reserved for people who needed extra help. if you need precalc, pick him.

kind of a jerk to his students.  very harsh and doesn't always explain things in the best way.  overall an easy class, if you stick to the homework and listen, he will give you all the tools you need to get by.  don't expect a lot of help if you don't understand something though.

Funny man.... horrible teacher.  He sounds like Woody Allen, he dresses like a lumber-jack (with his patented flanel shirts) and teaches like a genius who has no idea how to relate to his students. Get a tutor fast.
Not so good.
omg this guy is just funny to look at and watch...what other professor comes to class in flannel shirts and his hair everywhere? he's crazy man..but he sucks at teaching, so find a good tutor lol

VERY EASY MATERIAL!! However this professor is no help whatsoever.  He is rude when you ask questions and thinks lowly of his students.  As a person I hated him.  The one good thing about him was his sense of humor.
He really cares about the students. He is fun and approachable. Tests and projects are very straightforward.

has weekly quizzes and sends the week previous discussing the material for the following quiz. has a clear-cut segmented teaching schedule and, really, he explains things in a way that allows you to truly understand the material. Try to attend all the classes in order to practice the formulas. 10 quizzes (40% of grade) and 1 final (60% of grade).
He is extremely helpful and very good at explaining problems.
Bad prof

Class is horrible. Completely disorganized teaching methods, ridiculous tests, such a radical feminist who does not know how to effectively explain her opinions or how to accept student opinions. Stay away!

Serious issues regarding the grading system of this course. The main thing: it makes no sense. People who did not attend or participate got rewarded in their final mark, because since they didn't say anything in class, there was nothing the Prof. could scrutinize and  heavily base your final grade on. DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE!!! u will not be happy

Cant believe she was ever hired. Radical feminist. Completely lacks clarity both in assignments and on tests. I am a good student and have never been so frustrated with a class this ridiculous before. Drop this class for your own good. It will hurt your GPA.

IF YOU ARE IN THIS CLASS DROP IT NOW!! She is not clear on what she expects. Does not explain anything in class. When it comes to the midterm and final your looking at things you have never seen before. No class Structure. Numerous problems with gradding issues for roughly everyone in the class. And the journals are rediculous.

This woman is out of her mind...if you accidentally find your way into this class drop it. You basically debate her crazy theories in class and she tries to test you on something you didnt a) talk about in class and b) was not in the readings. The woman flat out has no bussiness teaching at NU

Have had a lot of professors, none as poor as this one. Her teaching methods are highly ineffective, never demonstrating any clarity. This miscommunication ends up hurting student's grades severely. Her grading is very controversial, raising heated dispute amongst students. I dont understand how this professor has a degree. Would not recommend.
Very knowledgeable, learned loads!

If you can live with 3.3, then it's ok to take his class. He won't bump you up even a single point. His grading standard is inconsistent. He will took many points off for just some rediculous reasons. Obviously,  He doesn't understand the meaning of 100 class that it should be easy and there was no point talking to him. He doesn't care!!!

Nice guy. Never seen anyone get 100% on any paper though. In general the class is laid back, but he is a tough grader. I found it obnoxious how I had over a little over a 89% in his class but he refused to bump me to a 3.7 and made me take the 3.3. He's the only professor i've heard of and even encountered that doesn't show that type of sympathy.
the professor is very helpful and clear.

Eijmberts is amazing! He is not only the nicest professor you'll ever have, but he is also genuinely interesting and he is very helpful outside of class as well. I would definitely take another class with him. Exams aren't too difficult at all if you study and they are very fair. Take his class if you can!!

comparative politics with him was great... so chill and laid back... makes alot of jokes and he is a really easy grader... everything in lectures will be on the test... I never read the book and I finished the class with an A-... take this class with him... great prof really chill and cool... def recommend
Very nice and helpful. Dressed very nicely every single time.
very helpful and easy professor

Not a great experience with this Professor. Didn't seem to grasp writing styles other than her own. One on one meetings not consistent with her grading and the class was very uninteresting. Prepare to learn more about theories in the book than how to write better.

Very easy teacher, grades based on content of work, grammar does not really affect grade. She may be boring but its freshman writing, its already boring. I never got an A/A- paper but that was because I always did the papers the day they were due so I didn't expect a high grade(had 4:35 class and settled with a B+).
super nice, could be unclear sometimes but always willing to help you out
She teaches the Psych Freshman English Writing class.  She grades fairly on content and style, but not grammar.  She's always willing to help, but not exactly interesting.

Great teacher, sets you up for success with clear lectures. Quizzes and discussion posts every week with other assorted papers, all easy As if you complete them as instructed. Very encouraging and easy-going.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Botchkovar is absolutely amazing. I adore her because not only is she intelligent, witty, and caring, but she is also a brilliant criminologist! That probably sounds forced but I just really enjoyed her teaching and I immediately liked her when the class began. I am not a general pushover so the fact that I adored her was meaningful!
She is an angel on this earth.  So accommodating to any conflicts with the class.  Tests are pretty easy and class is interesting.  Love her to death. Wish she was my grandmother.

Super sweet teacher. Cares about how you're doing in the class. Make sure to use the extra credit opportunities because the mid-term and final are worth over half of your grade. Also, make sure you try to participate in class, it goes a long way.
Took two classes with her and liked both a lot.

I am still puzzled by this teacher. She gives the impression that you're doing great and then hits you with a low grade. She is not at all specific about expectations. Her feedback on tests usually doesn't make any sense and it's like she takes points off for not dumbing down your work. As a grad student, I think we're beyond that.

She is one of the best professors I have had in my 4 years! She is excited about the subject (gender and crime). She used video clips and, while long, very interesting readings! She encourages participation and loves class discussion! Highly recommend!
Loved the class!

Tough to follow anything she's saying between thick Russian accent and condescending manner of questioning the classroom every few minutes. Mandatory attendance because of random pop quizzes. Zero discussion and class involvement. Was a very painful class and I would not recommend.

Amazing professor, interesting topics, interesting readings assigned, fair grader and tests, attendance is encouraged as there may be a pop a quiz at any time...this professor came to class with such enthusiasm every time, even brought candy a few times to encourage students to participate and get excited about the material.
Great professor! Very enthusiastic, interesting class material, straightforward tests, lots of reading, 1 project a mid-term and a final plus class participation and multiple reading respons papers

One of the best teachers at NU. Always there to help her students and truly wants everyone to do well. You can email her any question you have and she always gets back to you as fast as she can. A really nice person - definitely take one of her classes

She is very, very nice and really enjoys what she teaches.  The content is pretty interesting.  The journals are kind of a pain and heavy on the reading but you can get by without doing all of it.  She is very willing to help outside of class and really wants you to learn. Class participation is very important and there are some pop quizzes.
Botchkovar really knows her stuff and is extremely helpful. The class is long but its not too bad half od it is discussion. Take her class its not very hard as long as you go to class and to the work

Seems knowledgeable about subject but is poor at emphasizing this.  Lengthy class discussions lead nowhere and she does a very poor job at getting the class to the point.  Easy class but poor teaching.  Attending class is excruciatingly boring.  If we are going to have so many discussions let us discuss more and try not to lead us so much.
No Comments

Mid-term, final, paper. That is the entire class. You are allowed to use a cheat sheet for the tests-essay form. Ten page paper. Overall a really repetitive subject; boring teacher, but potential to do well in class.

She's a great professor. The class itself isn't too hard; you just have to actually understand everything and know a lot of definitions. Her final was easy too, just questions pulled from exams 1-3. Lectures are funny/engaging, and the material is interesting.

Prof. Greiner structures the course around three in-person exams with multiple-choice and open-response questions. Exam content is taken directly from the slides and study guides. The cumulative final is based on material from the previous exams, which helps with preparation. Lectures are engaging, and extra credit opportunities are available.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i really liked this class! there is a LOT of material but she makes study guides that are pretty accurate and help a lot. the final only had one question that wasn't on a previous exam which was really nice. very interesting class!!

Dr. Greiner is an excellent professor! She's down to earth, kind, and the most knowledgeable prof I've had. You can tell she's very passionate about the field and wants her students to learn and succeed. There is a lot of material, so her classes are lecture-heavy but super interesting. Definitely use the study guides and go to her review sessions!

very passionate and knows material well. tests on paper in class (i had 500-600 flashcards for each test (3). If you work hard, you will do well. Only annoying thing was that the final was repeat qs (i get it was to pull up grades) but as someone who already had a high grade in the class, it felt like a waste of time to re-memorize old test answers
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she's very personable and flexible, i loved taking this class lowkey. grade is calculated off 3 tests, final, and attendance. lecture is engaging but there is SO MUCH material, and can be overwhelming sometimes. however the final is only made up of past test questions, so it kinda balances out. also all exams are half MCQ and half short response.

I defended my dissertation with no revisions! Committee says she is a qualitative chair with a quantitative mind, exceptionally sharp and analytically precise. I had a very difficult committee member, and she addressed the situation directly and effectively. She is highly organized, straightforward, and tells you exactly what needs to be done.

Amazing Chair! She tells you how she works before accepting you, is very consistent. That said, she's very selective about who she agrees to work with. If she agrees to work with you, you're a lucky winner. The committee respects her, and having her as your chair makes everything go more smoothly.

Dr. Elias is awesome! She's such a chill, friendly, and nice doctoral chair and professor. She's super organized and keeps things consistent. Plus, she's down-to-earth and easy to talk to. With her experience, you know you're getting honest advice. I highly recommend her! She's the best!

I had the privilege of working with Dr. Elias as my doctoral professor and chair. She is an exemplary doctoral professor and dissertation chair who displays exceptional care, expertise, and dedication to her students. She fostered a supportive learning environment, provided invaluable guidance, and genuinely prioritized students' well-being.

MY CHAIR! I just love Dr. Elias, she is the kindest most understanding faculty member I have dealt with during my dissertation process. She is very easy going and provides precise directions. She is well respected by the committee and very knowledgeable about data analysis processes and coding.
Best dissertation chair. She is smart and very good with Interpretative Phenomenology and coding process in general. Good chair/ committee member, committee respects her opinion.
Excellent dissertation Chair, easy to deal with as she provides great direction, guidance and knows how to align your study.
Simone is very polite and all students adore her. I wish she could teach all Edd courses. She is a very bright professor.

Dr. Elias is an excellent professor. She is accessible, understanding and very inteligent. She has been  my favorite professor in the doctoral program and a very popular professor. She is very thorough and consistent, students trust her and want her to chair their dissertations.
Simone is intelligent, yet very humble about her knowledge. Everyone loves her and her courses are very popular. You'll learn a lot in her classes.
Simone is wicked smart, intelligent, and very patient with her students. She is a great adviser and the best prof I had at NU.
Just heard that Dr. Elias left NU I had her for a DS class and she was my friend's advisor. I can only say good things about her ways of teaching, very intelligent and happy person.
Simone is a wonderful professor. She is extremely nice, and she gives great feedback.

Friendly, happy, funny, intelligent, warm, neat, caring... gotta love this professor.  She makes everything enjoyable to work on. Super nice woman,  definitely one of the best professors that I've ever had.
She's wicked smart and my favorite professor.
She does a lot of reviewing and really makes sure you understand the material. I would highly recommend this class to everyone!
She helps you to be a better person. You learn a lot from her, she is always happy and is very organized and smart.
Simone is awesome!  3
Dynamic and happy professor - Would take again.

Mrs Eilias is a good person with a good heart to help her students to be the best they can be, she is able to get something complicate and make simple to understand- Only northeastern professor I will miss after graduation probably the only one that replies e:mails, knows y name and stops to say hi and ask how y are doing when she sees you around.
Best professor @ Northeastern.

Simone rocks- and I plan to take all my electives with her because she is a kind, smart, and happy professor that helps you learn without getting burned out- you actually use what you learn in her class in real life.

She is an A+ prof! Her syllabus can be intimidating ( 25+ pages) but the way she structures the course really makes sense at the end and I never felt overwhelmed. You need to work and meet her deadlines, but she is always willing to accommodate students and help! Highly recommend. She is the best.
SUPERB teacher!!

Simone is very approachable, intelligent and has a pleasant personality, everyone loves her.  Once you are her student she will always help you. I am not even taking Portuguese anymore bc my schedule does not allow but I often visit her.  Most organized professor I know at Northeastern.

She is phenomenal, just an excellent professor  I even don't like languages but I like her class. I like the logical manner  she presents the material and how she is always happy, it makes you want to go to class, she is very knowledgeable smart and intelligent.

Nicest and coolest professor I have ever had!! She knows how to teach portuguese and she makes good emphasis on accent. If you are willing to learn, you will certainly and easily will. TAKE THE CLASS!!
Simone is the BEST!!!!!!!
She is spectacular. I also went to her dialogue to Brazil, just amazing.
She is very clear and the most organized professor I've had. Very smart.
SHE IS THE BEST!!!!!!!!

She is simply the best professor at Northeastern. Period. She is a good person, very intelligent and an amazing professor. That kind of professor you will remember your whole life. I graduated and I am still in touch with her. She is happy to offer good advice and love seeing her students succeed. I highly recommend.

Simone is a very understanding professor. I had several personal challenges during the semester and she was there for me. I even felt I did not deserve it but she is so kind. She is not only the best professor at Northeastern but also the kindest person I know.  Very smart and intelligent woman too.
Best professor at Neu ! Would recommend her to anyone who wants to learn portugues!

She is organized and business-like. I am an engineering major. Tons of business and engineering majors in her classes.  Learned a lot without the stress. No bad surprises in her class she walks the talk. 5 starts.

Best professor at nu. Her class fills fast, very fast. She was kind enough to meet with me and help me to figure out what I want to do after I graduate. Great mentor. I will declare a Portuguese minor bc of her.  NU should hire more professors like her.  She goes above and beyond to help you with everything not only Portuguese.
I LOVE  her!!!!! She is awesome. Will take her again.

Simone is amazing. She is there for you, you will see that she loves what she does and it reflects on her teaching and the way she treats everyone. All grades are posted within two days.
